Archived Version: Discord Advertising IAB Addendum - December 18 2024

Archived Version: This version of the Discord Addendum is archived as of May 16, 2025. You can find the current version of Discord Advertising IAB Addendum here.

This Discord Advertising IAB Addendum (this “Discord Addendum”), which amends and supplements the IAB STANDARD TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR INTERNET ADVERTISING FOR MEDIA BUYS ONE YEAR OR LESS VERSION 3.0 (the “IAB Terms” and collectively with this Discord Addendum, the “Campaign Terms”), governs and forms a part of any applicable insertion order (the “IO”) signed by and between Discord Inc. (“Media Company”) and the advertiser designated on an IO (“Advertiser”), or, if applicable, Advertiser’s agency designated on an IO (“Agency”). The terms of this Discord Addendum will control over and fully supersede any similar, conflicting, inconsistent or overlapping terms in the IAB Terms or other parts of an IO; however, if an IO expressly states that certain terms set forth in the IO are intended to supersede the terms of this Discord Addendum, then, in the event of conflict, those terms of the applicable IO will control only for that IO and only to the extent of such conflict. Any purchase order terms, “clickthrough” or other online agreements, or other similar documents made available to Media Company by Advertiser or Agency are hereby rejected by Media Company and will not apply to any Quest. Capitalized terms used but not defined herein will have the meanings given to such terms in the IAB Terms.

Where Advertiser is purchasing directly from Media Company, (i) Section 2 and any references to Agency herein will be deemed deleted and will not apply; and (ii) all references in the IAB Terms to Agency, will be deemed to be references to Advertiser.

  1. Quest Terms.

  1. Quests. Media Company will implement a promotional campaign on its platform (the “Discord Platform”) for Advertiser’s applicable property designated on an IO (the “Advertiser Property”) where eligible users of the Discord Platform will be able to complete certain agreed-upon tasks relating to the Advertiser Property and earn certain agreed-upon rewards (“Rewards”), as further detailed in an applicable IO (each such campaign, a “Quest”).

  2. Quest T&Cs. Media Company will, in consultation with Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, establish the specific terms and requirements for users governing each Quest (“Quest T&Cs”), and will publish the Quest T&Cs to users in connection with such Quest. The Quest T&Cs will address, at a minimum (i) user eligibility requirements and any criteria and tasks that must be satisfied by a user in order to receive a Reward; (ii) the nature of the applicable Reward, including whether the Reward will be supplied by Media Company (each, a “Media Company Reward”) or Advertiser (each, an “Advertiser Reward”); and (iv) any other terms, conditions and limitations pertaining to the redemption and use of the Reward.

  3. Advertiser Rewards. Unless otherwise indicated on an IO, the Reward will be an Advertiser Reward approved by Media Company and either the Advertiser or Agency, as applicable. For any Quest with an Advertiser Reward: (i) reasonably in advance of the applicable flight dates for a Quest, the parties will agree in writing (email to suffice) on and implement the fulfillment and redemption mechanics for the Advertiser Reward, which may consist of the delivery to Media Company of a sufficient number of redemption codes for users to redeem for Advertiser Rewards; (ii) Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, will ensure that the Advertiser Reward and the redemption process is consistent with the Quest T&Cs; and (iii) in the event of any fulfillment or redemption issues (including, without limitation, insufficient or defective redemption codes) in connection with a Quest, Media Company may suspend such Quest until such issues are resolved. For clarity, Advertiser is solely responsible for the Advertiser Rewards and any associated fraud, losses, or other issues in connection with such Advertiser Rewards.

  4. Media Company Rewards. For any Quest where the applicable IO indicates there will be a Media Company Reward, Media Company will (i) ensure that such Media Company Reward and redemption process is consistent with the Quest T&Cs; and (ii) will have responsibility (unless otherwise agreed in the IO) and control over the design and creation of such Media Company Reward. Media Company will obtain Advertiser’s or Agency’s approval (not to be unreasonably withheld) for any Media Company Reward that contains or is derived from Advertising Materials. Media Company Rewards may not be available to users in certain regions where not supported by the Discord Platform. Advertiser and Agency may not terminate for convenience any Quest with (i) a Media Company Reward that contains or is derived from Advertising Materials or (ii) any other custom Media Company Reward created specifically for the Quest.

  5. Advertiser Marks License.

  6. Advertiser and Agency hereby grant Media Company a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use and display Advertiser’s name, designated trademarks and associated logos, and any names, trademarks or logos associated with the Advertiser Property (the “Advertiser Marks”) in connection with the implementation of a Quest, the performance of Media Company’s obligations under the Campaign Terms and any IO, or as otherwise approved in writing by Advertiser or Agency.

  1. All goodwill and improved reputation generated by Media Company’s use of the Advertiser Marks inures to the exclusive benefit of Advertiser. Media Company will use the Advertiser Marks in a manner consistent with any branding guidelines provided by Advertiser to Media Company in writing.

  1. Advertising Materials. Advertiser and Agency hereby grant Media Company a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use, display, adapt, translate, modify, copy, publicly perform, transmit and distribute the Advertising Materials in connection with the implementation or promotion of a Quest, the performance of Media Company’s obligations under the Campaign Terms or as otherwise approved by Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, including, without limitation, in connection with the development, distribution and making available of applicable Media Company Rewards containing or derived from such Advertising Materials. The licenses set forth herein are sublicensable by Media Company to its affiliates, agents, and subcontractors in connection with Media Company performance hereunder (and, with respect to Media Company Rewards containing or derived from Advertising Materials, to end users who claim any such Media Company Rewards in connection with a Quest). Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, will, at its own cost and expense, obtain all necessary licenses, consents, approvals and permissions from any third party required for Media Company to exercise its rights under the foregoing license. For purposes of the Campaign Terms, “Advertising Materials” means any content, materials, copy, branding, images, names, audio, music, video, artwork, designs, descriptions, specifications, and other elements made available by Advertiser or Agency to Media Company for use in connection with a Quest, including, without limitation, any elements, materials, assets or intellectual property from the Advertiser Property.

  2. Cooperation. Media Company’s ability to implement the Quest and its obligations under the Campaign Terms and any IO (including, without limitation, the ability to meet the applicable timeframes and schedules for a Quest as specified in an IO) will be contingent upon the timely provision of cooperation from Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, in connection with the Quest, which cooperation includes, without limitation, providing any redemption codes, Advertising Materials and/or Advertiser Rewards as required by Media Company with sufficient lead time for the applicable Quest, compliance with applicable Policies or other campaign and asset specifications, and timely feedback, reviews and approvals for any items and matters requiring approval or input in connection with a Quest. Advertiser and Agency will adhere to any Policies and other agreed upon timeframes, campaign specifications, and development schedules in connection with the foregoing. Media Company will not be liable or responsible for any delays or issues caused by Advertiser’s or Agency’s failure or delay in providing such cooperation.

  3. Quest Prompts. Media Company will be responsible for developing, producing, and displaying prompts or notifications promoting the availability of a Quest (“Quest Prompts”) to certain users on applicable surfaces within the Discord Platform. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, Media Company will have ultimate authority and control over the content, placement, frequency, delivery, timing and accompanying disclosures in connection with all Quest Prompts on the Discord Platform. Media Company reserves the right to suspend or cancel the targeting, personalization, and/or delivery of Quest Prompts in connection with any Quest.

  4. Reporting. For each Quest, Media Company will provide summary reports to Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, regarding certain estimated performance metrics, insights and KPIs within a reasonable timeframe after the midpoint and end date of such Quest. The information in such reports may be used by Advertiser solely for its own internal business purposes but will otherwise be considered Media Company’s Confidential Information.

  5. Estimates. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, any impression or reach numbers, impression-related commitments, targeting parameters, geographies or estimates provided on an IO and any information provided in connection with any report delivered by Media Company with respect to any Quest are provided by Media Company solely on an “AS IS” basis as estimates for informational purposes based on the data reasonably available to Media Company and are not guaranteed or considered binding by the parties in connection with any Quest. Media Company will not be liable (or required to offer any makegood) for any errors, shortfalls, inaccuracies or omissions in connection with any of the foregoing.

  1. Agency Authority. Agency represents, warrants and covenants that it has obtained and will maintain all consents, approvals and authorizations from Advertiser necessary for Agency to (i) bind Advertiser to the Campaign Terms and any IO, act on behalf of Advertiser and otherwise comply with its obligations in connection with the Campaign Terms and any IO, including, without limitation, with respect to (a) the execution of any IOs on Advertiser’s behalf, (b) the ability to pay Media Company for any Quest; (c) the ability to share Advertiser’s Confidential Information with Media Company; and (c) the management and provision of any and all approvals, feedback and reviews in connection with the Campaign Terms and any IO (e.g., the review and approval of Rewards and other Quest elements, press releases, promotional materials, or creative assets); and (ii) grant the licenses set forth in the Campaign Terms and any IO, including, without limitation, any such licenses to Advertiser Marks and Advertising Materials set forth herein. Media Company will be entitled to rely on any documents executed, instructions provided or approvals granted by Agency on an Advertiser’s behalf in connection with the Campaign Terms and any IO. Agency will indemnify and hold Media Company harmless from and against any losses or unpaid obligations under any IOs arising from Agency’s violation of this Section.

  2. Taxes. Unless otherwise stated in an IO, Media Company’s fees do not include any direct or indirect local, state, federal or foreign taxes, levies, duties or similar governmental assessments of any nature, including value-added, use, sales or withholding taxes collected by any jurisdiction. Each party is responsible for all of its own business taxes (including, but not limited to, net income, gross receipts, franchise, or other similar business taxes) arising as a result of or in connection with any IO. Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, is responsible for self-assessing any transaction taxes (e.g. sales tax, VAT, GST or similar taxes) due with respect to any IO. Media Company will collect, and Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, will pay any applicable transaction taxes if Media Company determines that it has a duty to collect such taxes. Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, is responsible for any transaction taxes on user rewards redeemed outside of the Discord Platform. For transaction tax purposes, Quests will be treated as services related to promotional advertising campaigns. To the extent withholding tax is required by applicable law, Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, will be responsible for collecting and remitting such taxes to the appropriate tax authorities. Additionally, Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, will provide Media Company an original receipt or documentation from the tax authority for the withholding tax payments.

  3. Amendments to IAB Terms.

  1. General Acknowledgements. The parties acknowledge and agree that: (i) Quests are treated as flat-fee based Deliverables delivered on the Discord Platform for purposes of the IAB Terms; (ii) the terms of the IAB Terms relating to inventory availability, delivery schedule, ad placement and positioning, use of collected data, and reporting will be superseded and governed by the applicable terms of Section 1 of this Discord Addendum and any IO; and (iii) Quests do not use or involve any Third Party Ad Server and any associated terms in the IAB Terms do not apply.

  2. Specific Amendments.

  3. Section X(b) of the IAB Terms is hereby amended to add the following new subclauses (iv) and (v):

“(iv) allegations that the Advertising Materials or Advertiser Marks infringe, misappropriate or otherwise violate any intellectual property rights of a third party; or (v) Advertiser Rewards, including, without limitation, any claims from users that Advertiser Rewards were misleading or inaccurate or that they were not properly fulfilled.”

  1. Section XI of the IAB Terms is hereby amended and restated as follows:

“Excluding Agency’s, Advertiser’s, and Media Company’s respective indemnification obligations under the Campaign Terms, damages that result from a breach of Section XII, or intentional misconduct by Agency, Advertiser, or Media Company, in no event will any party be liable (i) for any consequential, indirect, incidental, punitive, special, or exemplary damages whatsoever or any damages for loss of profits, business interruption, loss of information, and the like, incurred by another party arising out of an IO, even if such party has been advised of the possibility of such damages; or (ii) in the aggregate in connection with these Campaign Terms or the IO in excess of the amount paid or payable by Agency or Advertiser to Media Company hereunder.”

  1. For purposes of Section XIV(d) of the IAB Terms, the choice of law governing any IO will be the State of New York without reference to its choice of law rules, and all claims, legal proceedings or litigations arising in connection with the Campaign Terms will be brought solely in state and federal courts located in New York City.

  2. Section XIV.e of the IAB Terms is hereby amended and restated as follows:

“All notices of termination or breach must be in English, in writing and addressed to the other party’s legal department (with a copy to any contact listed on an IO). The email address for notices being sent to the Media Company legal department is legal.notices@discordapp.com. All other notices must be in English, in writing (including email) and addressed to the other party’s applicable notice information designated on an IO. Notice will be treated as given on receipt, as verified by written or automated receipt or by electronic log (as applicable).”

Billing Help

Chargebacks FAQ

Fraudulently issuing chargebacks for purchases made on Discord violates our Terms of Service.

We may suspend accounts following a chargeback being filed to protect your account, our community, or our payment systems from potential abuse or fraud.

To avoid violating this policy, all refund or billing inquiry requests should be directed to our support team at dis.gd/billing instead.⁠⁠

However, if your account has been suspended for this violation, you may appeal the suspension by submitting an appeal to Discord’s Trust & Safety Team at dis.gd/request.

What this article covers:

  • What is a Chargeback
  • What This Policy States
  • How to Avoid Violating This Policy
  • How to Appeal a Chargeback Ban on Your Account

What is a Chargeback

A chargeback occurs when a transaction is reported to a payment issuer as incorrect or unrecognized.

Filing a chargeback against a transaction made on Discord may result in account suspension pending further investigation on our end. This suspension is in line with Discord’s Terms of Service which prohibits actions that may cause harm to Discord and others.

This policy aims to maintain a safe and secure environment for our community while preventing potential abuse or fraud through our payment systems.

What This Policy States

Don’t use the services to do harm to Discord.

Among other things, this includes trying to gain access to or attacking our systems, scraping our services without our written consent, transmitting viruses or other malicious code to our services, abusing or defrauding us or our payment systems, copying our product or using our intellectual property without permission, and misusing our reporting or customer service mechanisms.

How to Avoid Violating This Policy

We take violations of this policy seriously due to the potential harm they may cause to Discord and others. Discord’s right to terminate an account following such a violation is stated in our Terms of Service.

If you require a refund due to a payment issue or unrecognized activity, or if you have any billing questions, please contact our support team at dis.gd/billing. Our team will assist you according to our policies and guidelines.

How to Appeal a Chargeback Ban on Your Account

We value transparency and are committed to protecting Discord and others from harm. If your account has been suspended due to a violation of this policy, you can appeal the enforcement action taken through our support form.

On the form, select “Appeal an action taken on my account or bot” from the “How can we help?” dropdown menu.

In the “What would you like to appeal?” section, select “An action taken on my account”.

To assist with our investigation, please provide the following information in your appeal:

  • The reason the chargeback was filed
  • If applicable, evidence of chargeback claim withdrawal
  • Screenshot of the disputed transaction on your billing statement.
    • Please ensure the screenshot displays the amount and date of transaction along with the descriptor. Important:
  • We do not accept Discord receipts as proof as payment and this screenshot must be directly from the payment source.
  • Please note that all data associated with accounts suspended for chargebacks is deleted or anonymized 90 days after the suspension process begins.
  • If you submit your appeal after this 90-day period, we will no longer have any record of the account’s existence and, consequently, will be unable to process your appeal.

Country/Region Setting

Country/Region is a setting on your Discord account that determines your shopping experience, including what prices and currencies you see, and which payment methods you can add and use.

What this article covers:

  • What is the Country/Region Setting?
  • How is Country/Region Determined
  • Changing Your Country/Region
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What is the Country/Region Setting?

Note: The Country/Region Setting is currently a desktop experiment and is only available to a limited number of users at this time.

Country/Region is a setting on your Discord account that sets your account to a specific location. It determines:

  • The prices and currencies you see in app
  • Which payment methods you can add and use
Country/Region under the Billing tab

How is Country/Region Determined

Your Country/Region is set the first time you complete a purchase on Discord. Once set, it can only be changed once every 90 days.

  • Your Country/Region is determined automatically based on your location and any saved payment methods.
  • Your Country/Region and billing address country must always match to make purchases.
  • On mobile, your region is determined by your device system settings and the app store.

How to Change Your Country/Region

You can update your Country/Region on your own once every 90 days. To do so, you must:

  1. Be located in the new country

  2. Add a valid payment method from that country

  3. Complete a successful purchase with that payment method

Keep in mind you can only add payment methods that match your Country/Region. If you have a saved method from a different country, it may not work for new purchases once your Country/Region is set.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What happens to my active subscriptions if I change my Country/Region?

A: Your existing subscriptions won’t be immediately affected, and they’ll keep charging to your original payment method. If that method fails, you’ll need to update your payment method and may be asked to acknowledge any pricing differences for your new Country/Region.

Q: I’m traveling and can’t complete a purchase. What do I do?

A: This is most likely to happen if you haven’t made a purchase on Discord before. On desktop, if your payment method’s billing address doesn’t match your current location, you’ll need to wait until you’re back home to complete a purchase. Otherwise, you can try making a purchase through the mobile app.

Q: What if I need to update my Country/Region before 90 days?

A: There are very few exceptions that we will grant early changes for. The following are not eligible reasons for an early change:

  • Moving, relocating, or traveling
  • Accidental or unintended past purchases made with a payment method from the wrong region If your situation falls under one of these reasons, you’ll need to wait the full 90 days before trying again. For anything else, reach out to our support team at dis.gd/contact.

Q: Why is my payment method not available at checkout?

A: Payment methods need to match your account’s Country/Region. If there’s a mismatch, you’ll need to use one that matches your current region.

Early Fraud Warning (EFW) Suspensions FAQ

Abusing or defrauding Discord or our payment system violates our Terms of Service.

When we receive a fraud report from your financial institution about a purchase made on Discord, we may suspend your account to protect you, our community, and our payment systems from potential abuse.

To avoid violating this policy, please direct all refund, fraud, or billing inquiries to our support team at dis.gd/billing instead of contacting your financial institution.

If your account has already been suspended for this violation, you can appeal by submitting a request to Discord’s Trust & Safety Team at dis.gd/request.

What this article covers:

  • What is an Early Fraud Warning (EFW)?
  • Why did I get an EFW notice?
  • What happens after an Early Fraud Warning?
    • For Low-Risk Early Fraud Warnings
    • For High-Risk Early Fraud Warnings
  • How can I avoid an EFW or suspension?
  • What should I do if I think an EFW notice is wrong?
    • For Low-Risk EFWs
    • For High-Risk EFWs

What is an Early Fraud Warning (EFW)?

An Early Fraud Warning (EFW) is a notification Discord receives from your financial institution (such as your bank or card issuer) that one or more transactions made on your Discord account were reported as potentially fraudulent.

This does not always mean your account has been compromised, but it does indicate your payment method was flagged for unusual or suspicious activity.

We take these reports seriously to protect both you and our community from potential fraud and abuse.

Why did I get an EFW notice?

You may have received an EFW notice because:

  • A purchase on your account was reported to Discord as fraudulent by your bank or card issuer.
  • Your payment method was reported to Discord as being used without your authorization.
  • Your account may have been compromised, and someone else made purchases without permission.
  • A billing dispute or refund request was filed with your bank instead of contacting Discord Support.

What happens after an Early Fraud Warning?

There are two possible outcomes:

For Low-Risk Early Fraud Warnings:
  • You’ll receive an email notifying you of the fraud report.
  • If the report was made in error, contact your financial institution to resolve it.
  • Additional fraud reports in the future may lead to account suspension for review.
  • Filing chargebacks or refund requests directly with your bank may also result in account suspension. For more details, review our Chargebacks FAQ. Important: If you have received this low-risk violation, no immediate action is required from you.

However, if fraud has occurred on your account or payment source, please submit a support inquiry directly to Discord. You can refer to our Reporting Unauthorized Discord Transactions article for more information.

For High-Risk Early Fraud Warnings:
  • Your account will be suspended pending further investigation.
  • You’ll receive an email explaining the suspension and instructions for appeal.
  • To appeal, submit a request via dis.gd/request and select Appeals & Age Update Requests under What can we help you with?.
  • Please make sure to include the following in your appeal:
    • The reason for the fraud report
    • Evidence of withdrawal (if applicable)
    • A screenshot of the reported transaction from your billing statement (amount, date, descriptor) Note: Discord receipts are not accepted as proof of payment. Screenshots must be from your payment source.

How can I avoid an EFW or suspension?

  • Use payment methods that you are authorized to use
  • Keep your Discord account secure with Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
  • If you have billing issues, contact Discord Support instead of filing a dispute with your bank
  • Monitor your account activity regularly for unauthorized charges

What should I do if I think an EFW notice is wrong?

For Low-Risk EFWs:
  • Contact your bank to resolve the report. If you have billing concerns, reach out to Discord Support.
For High-Risk EFWs:

  • Follow the appeal process in your suspension email. For more information, see these resources:

  • Discord’s Terms of Service

  • Reporting Unauthorized Discord Transactions

  • Chargebacks FAQ

Fraudulent Charge Suspension FAQ

Abusing or defrauding Discord or our payment system violates our Terms of Service.

If your account was suspended for Fraudulent Charge, it means our systems identified fraudulent activity related to payments made through your account.

We take these violations seriously. When Discord detects or is notified of fraud linked to an account, we may suspend the account to maintain a safe and secure environment for our community while preventing potential abuse or fraud through our payment systems.

What this article covers:

  • Discord’s Policy on Fraudulent Charges
  • How do I appeal a fraudulent charge suspension?
  • How can I avoid a fraudulent charge suspension in the future?
  • For More Information

Discord’s Policy on Fraudulent Charges

Don’t use the services to do harm to Discord.

Among other things, this includes trying to gain access to or attacking our systems, scraping our services without our written consent, transmitting viruses or other malicious code to our services, abusing or defrauding us or our payment systems, copying our product or using our intellectual property without permission, and misusing our reporting or customer service mechanisms.

How do I appeal a fraudulent charge suspension?

If your account has been found in violation of our Terms of Service due to a Fraudulent Charge, the suspension is considered permanent and is not eligible for appeal.

How can I avoid a fraudulent charge suspension in the future?

Only use payment methods that you are authorized to use.

For More Information

How to Report an Unrecognized Charge on Your Discord Account

If you have a charge you do not recognize on your Discord account, we’re here to help. Please read through the rest of this Help Center article to ensure a thorough resolution.

Before you proceed, please refer to our Reporting Unauthorized Discord Transactions article for more information on how to accurately submit your support request.

Steps to Take if Your Discord Account Has Unrecognized Charges

First, check if the charge appears on any of your Discord accounts (including any alternate accounts) before contacting our support team about an unrecognized payment. This step ensures we can take appropriate account-level actions that match your situation.

If you can’t find the charge on your Discord account(s), this may indicate that your payment method (credit card, PayPal, CashApp, etc.) was used without your permission.

Important: Please contact our billing team before filing a dispute with your bank. Filing a dispute or refund request directly with your bank for any Discord transactions may result in account suspension pending further investigation. For more information, please review our Chargeback FAQ.

How to Report Unrecognized Charges that Appear on Your Discord Account

To report unrecognized charges on your Discord account, follow the steps that match your situation:

Discord Account with Access to Email Address

If you’ve confirmed the unrecognized charges are from your Discord account and you have access to the email address associated with the account, follow these steps to report them:

  1. Submit a ticket using our support form

  2. Under Type of Billing Issue?, select “I have a question/issue regarding an unauthorized transaction”

  3. Select “I do not recognize a charge on my Discord account” under the Type of Issue category

  4. Select “Yes” when asked if you’re using the email address linked to your Discord account

Discord Account without Access to Email Address

If you do not have access to the email address associated with your Discord account, please take the following steps:

  1. Submit a ticket using our support form

  2. Under Type of Billing Issue?, select “I have a question/issue regarding an unauthorized transaction”

  3. Select “I do not recognize a charge on my Discord account” under the Type of Issue category

  4. Select “No” when asked if you’re using the email address linked to your Discord account

  5. Select “No” again when asked if you can submit a ticket from your Discord account’s email

Possible Hacked Account with Email Change

If you believe your Discord account has been hacked/compromised and someone has changed your email tied to the account:

  1. Submit a ticket using our support form

  2. Choose “Hacked Account” from the What can we help you with? drop-down menu

  3. Enter your email address

  4. Enter the username and email address originally associated with the Discord account before the account was compromised. (Please also include the UserID associated with the Discord account if possible)

  5. Select the reason for how you believe the account was compromised from the dropdown menu

  6. Select “Yes” when asked if your email associated with the Discord account was changed

This will forward your request to the team that is best equipped to help with account recovery.

Additional Payment Details to Include in Your Support Request

To help us resolve your case quickly, please provide:

  • Transaction date and amount
  • Payment method (credit card, PayPal, Cash App, Venmo, etc.)
  • Payment identifier (last 4 digits of credit card, PayPal invoice ID, $Cashtag, Venmo User ID, etc.)
  • Screenshots of the Discord charges on your bank statement Any missing payment information may delay the resolution of your case.
Example of Submitting a Support Request

While we aim to resolve requests within 72 hours, some cases may take longer. To ensure the fastest possible response, please submit only one support ticket per issue—multiple tickets can delay our response time.

  • Reporting Unauthorized Discord Transactions
  • Discord’s Refund Policy
  • Safe Ways to Shop on Discord

How to Report Unauthorized Discord Charges Made by Someone You Know

If someone you know, including a family member, friend, partner, etc., has used your payment information to make a purchase on their Discord account without your authorization, we’re here to help.

Before you proceed, please refer to our Reporting Unauthorized Discord Transactions article for more information on how to submit your support request accurately.

Important: Please contact our billing team before filing a dispute with your bank. Filing a dispute or refund request directly with your bank for any Discord transactions may result in account suspension pending further investigation.

For more information, please review our Chargeback FAQ.

What this article covers:

  • What To Check First
  • What to Do When Someone You Know Makes an Unauthorized Discord Charge on Your Account
    • If the Charges are on Your Own Discord Account
    • If the Charges are on Someone Else’s Discord Account
    • If You Have Access to Their Email
    • If You Cannot Access Their Email or Contact the Account Owner
  • What to Include in Your Support Request

What To Check First

Before submitting a support request, take a moment to review your recent transactions and purchases. Follow these steps to identify the Discord charges to ensure we provide the right assistance:

  • Look for “DISCORD*” or “PAYPAL DISCORD” on your bank statement—these are the official Discord payment descriptors.
  • For any unrecognized purchases made on Discord using your iOS device, you will need to request a refund for those purchases directly from the iOS App Store.
  • For any unrecognized purchases made on Discord using Google Play, you will also need to request a refund directly from the Google Play Store.

What to Do When Someone You Know Makes an Unauthorized Discord Charge on Your Account

To report unrecognized charges on your Discord account made by someone you know, follow the steps that match your situation:

If the Charges are on Your Own Discord Account

Check if the unrecognized charges appear on your own Discord account. If so, follow these steps:

  1. Submit a ticket using our support form.

  2. Select “I have a question regarding my purchase/payment method” under Type of Billing Issue.

  3. Select “I want a refund” under “How can we help you with your purchase?”.

If the Charges are on Someone Else’s Discord Account

If the charges appear on another person’s Discord account, have them submit a refund request at dis.gd using the email address associated with their account.

If You Have Access to Their Email

If the charges are on someone else’s account and they can’t submit a support request themselves, you can submit one on their behalf using the email address linked to their Discord account:

  1. In the support form, select “I have a question/issue regarding an unauthorized transaction” under Type of Billing Issue.

  2. Select “Family Member of a user” under Type of Issue.

  3. Select “Yes” when asked “Is the email provided associated with your family member’s Discord account?”.

If You Cannot Access Their Email or Contact the Account Owner

If you can’t submit a support request from the email address associated with the Discord account or contact the account owner directly, follow these steps:

  1. In the support form, select “I have a question/issue regarding an unauthorized transaction” under Type of Billing Issue.

  2. Select “Family Member of a user” under Type of Issue.

  3. Select “No” when asked “Is the email provided associated with your family member’s Discord account?”.

  4. Select “No” when asked “Do you have access to the email associated with your family member’s Discord account?”. This will help us direct your request to the appropriate support team for further assistance.

Any refunds outside our standard refund policy may result in disabling your Discord account per our terms.

What to Include in Your Support Request

To help us resolve your case quickly, please provide:

  • Transaction date and amount
  • Purchase method (iOS App Store, Google Play Store, Other)
  • Payment method (credit card, PayPal, Cash App, Venmo, etc.)
  • Payment identifier (e.g., last 4 digits of credit card, PayPal invoice ID, $Cashtag, or Venmo User ID, etc.)
  • Screenshots of the Discord charges on your bank statement or PayPal statement Please ensure the screenshot or photo displays the amount, date of transaction, and the merchant descriptor showing as DISCORD* or PAYPAL DISCORD on your bank statement.

For security and privacy reasons, unless you are writing in from the Discord account associated with the unrecognized charges, we do not accept Discord receipts as proof of payment. This screenshot must be directly from the payment source.

Any missing payment information may delay the resolution of your case.

Example of Submitting a Support Request

While we aim to resolve requests within 72 hours, some cases may take longer. To ensure the fastest possible response, please submit only one support ticket per issue—multiple tickets can delay our response time.

For more information, see these resources:

  • Reporting Unauthorized Discord Transactions
  • Discord’s Refund Policy
  • Safe Ways to Shop on Discord
  • Chargebacks FAQ These resources cover unrecognized transactions, refund policies, and safe shopping practices on Discord.

How to Find your Payment ID

Before submitting a request for a refund, you’ll need to make sure you have the payment ID for the purchase that you’d like refunded. This helps us process your request quickly and ensure we refund the correct purchase.

Desktop/Browser
  1. Head into your User Settings by pressing the cogwheel [] icon.
Cogwheel Icon on Desktop/Browser

  1. Tap Billing, then select the purchase for which you need the payment ID.

Mobile

In order to get your payment ID for a mobile purchase, please refer to the confirmation email you received with your purchase. This will include the payment ID.

For Android users, you can provide a payment ID, however, another option that provides a quicker turnaround is your GPA number from your Google Play Store confirmation email. If you’re unable to find your confirmation email from Google Play, you can check out their guide here on how to locate the GPA number.

If you can’t locate your confirmation email, you can obtain your payment ID through the desktop app or browser by following the steps above.

Confirmation email showing the Payment ID after making a purchase

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How can I request a refund for my Discord subscription?

A: You can request a refund by finding your payment ID and submitting a request to the Discord Billing Support Team. Make sure your request meets the Refund Policy requirements.

Q: What do I need before requesting a refund?

A: You need to:

  • Review the Discord Refund Policy to ensure your purchase is eligible
  • Have your payment ID ready
  • Use the email address associated with your Discord account Q: How do I find my payment ID on desktop/browser?

  1. Open User Settings via the cogwheel icon

  2. Go to Billing and select the relevant purchase

  3. Find the payment ID in the dropdown menu

Q: What if I made purchases on iOS or Android?

A: To request a refund from Apple, you will need to request a refund for those purchases via the iOS App Store.

Android users need to provide the GPA number from their Google Play Store confirmation email instead of a payment ID. If you’re unable to find your confirmation email from Google Play, you can check out their guide here on how to locate the GPA number.

Q: What happens after I submit my refund request?

A: You’ll receive:

  • An immediate confirmation email of your ticket submitted to our Support team
  • A response once your ticket has been processed Q: What if I can’t find my payment ID?

A: If you can’t locate your payment ID in the Billing tab, you can obtain it from the confirmation email. If you still can’t locate it, please submit a request to the Discord Support team under the email address tied to your Discord account.

How to Request Tax and VAT Exemption Status on Discord

If your organization is claiming exemption from tax based on your tax-exempt status, resale purposes, or other qualifying reasons permitted by law, you’ll need to submit proper documentation through our team.

What this article covers:

  • What are Tax Exemptions?
  • Required Documentation
    • VAT Exemptions
    • US Tax Exemptions
    • Other Tax Exemptions
  • How to Validate Tax Exemption
  • What Happens After Submission?
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What are Tax Exemptions?

A tax exemption is a specific legal provision that releases certain goods, services, organizations, or individuals from paying the standard tax (i.e. sales tax, VAT, and similar taxes) that would normally apply to a purchase. For Discord users and businesses, this means they may be eligible to have certain taxes not charged to their Discord purchases. These exemptions vary by state, country and jurisdiction.

Required Documentation

Info: It is your responsibility to submit all required information for a tax exemption before making any qualifying purchases. Submitting a tax exemption request does not guarantee you will receive this exemption. Discord will review your documents and relevant tax authority records to determine whether an exemption should be applied.

To help you submit the correct documentation for your tax exemption request, review the section below that applies to your situation:

VAT Exemptions

If you’re requesting a VAT exemption, you’ll need to provide:

  • Your valid VAT ID number - this must be active and verifiable
  • Your country of registration
  • Complete invoice details including your registered business name and address
US Tax Exemptions

For organizations based in the United States, please provide:

  • Your sales tax exemption certificate with all required fields completed. Forms will vary by state, so please be sure to provide us with the form applicable to your state.
  • Your state code - this is required for proper processing
  • Complete invoice information matching your tax-exempt organization
Other Tax Exemptions

For all other types of tax exemptions, you’ll need:

  • A valid Tax ID number from your local tax authority
  • Your country of registration
  • Complete invoice details that match your registration Info: We verify the documentation for accuracy and validity. If necessary, we may contact the issuing state’s or country’s tax authority to confirm legitimacy.

How to Validate Tax Exemption

Info: Tax exemptions apply only from the date of approval onward—previous purchases cannot be adjusted. Once validated, the exemption automatically applies to all future purchases.

To help you get your tax exemption approved quickly, here’s what we look for when reviewing your request:

  • Valid ID Check: We’ll verify your VAT/Tax ID with the official tax authorities to ensure it’s current and valid.
  • Regional Verification: Your tax exemption must be applicable in your specific country or region.
  • Matching Addresses: For your security, your payment method’s billing address needs to match the country where your tax exemption is registered.
  • Documentation Review: We’ll check that all your invoice details align with our verification records.
  • Final Review: Our Support team will carefully review your application to ensure everything is in order. Info: Having all these items ready before submission can help speed up the approval process.

What Happens After Submission?

Once you submit your tax exemption request, our dedicated Support team will carefully review your application. Here’s what you can expect:

If Your Request is Approved:

  • Our Support team will process your exemption within 5-7 business days

  • You’ll receive a confirmation email with your exemption details

  • All future purchases will automatically be tax-exempt

  • We may periodically verify that your tax exemption is still valid

  • You can view your tax-exempt status in your account settings If Your Request Needs Additional Information:

  • Our team will reach out via email with specific instructions

  • You’ll have 30 days to provide the requested documentation

  • Your application will remain pending during this time If Your Request is Not Approved:

  • You’ll receive an email explaining why your request wasn’t approved

  • Your purchases will continue to include applicable taxes Contact Us: Our support team is always here to assist you with any questions about your tax exemption status.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How long does the tax exemption approval process take?

A: The standard processing time is 5-7 business days after submission of a complete application with all required documentation.

Q: Can I get a refund for taxes paid before my exemption was approved?

A: No, tax exemptions only apply to future purchases from the date of approval. Previous purchases cannot be adjusted retroactively.

Q: What happens if my tax ID or status changes?

A: You must notify our Support team immediately of any changes to your tax status or ID. This may require submitting a new application with updated documentation.

Q: Can I use my tax exemption for multiple Discord accounts?

A: Each tax exemption is tied to a specific account and billing address. Separate applications are required for different accounts or organizations.

Q: What if I need to update my business information?

A: Contact our support team with any changes to your business details. Some updates may require new documentation or re-verification of your tax-exempt status.

Q: How do I know if my organization qualifies for tax exemption?

A: Qualification depends on your organization’s legal status and local tax regulations. We recommend consulting with your tax advisor or reviewing your local tax authority guidelines.

Q: Can I get a tax exemption for purchases I made through Apple and/or Google Play?

A: We cannot assist with tax exemption requests for purchases made through Apple or Google Play.

Localized Pricing on Discord

NOTE:

The Euro is available in the following countries on Desktop only at this time: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, and Switzerland.

We’re continually working to make our subscriptions more accessible so you can have more fun on Discord. We offer localized pricing for certain subscriptions and Discord purchases in some countries on the desktop, mobile, and web apps.

What this article covers:

  • How do I get local pricing?
  • Localized Prices
  • Frequently Asked Questions
    • General Localized Pricing Information
    • Specific Location-Based Information

How do I get local pricing?

  • To get localized pricing, you must have a payment method based in a country where Discord offers localized pricing.
  • JCB, Discover, Diners Club, UnionPay, and AMEX currently do not support localized pricing. Additionally, certain Brazilian banks do not support BRL.
  • If you are using an eligible payment method, you will automatically switch to the new price + currency. The change will take effect at your next billing cycle.
  • If you use a payment method that does not support, or are located in a region where Discord doesn’t offer localized pricing, our system will automatically charge in USD instead. Looking for region specific payment methods? Check out this article here for a list of acceptable payment methods.

Localized Prices

Discord periodically adjusts prices to ensure alignment with local markets. We offer localized pricing in a variety of currencies within Brazil, Turkey, Poland, Australia, Peru, Philippines, Colombia, Chile, Japan, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Mexico, Great Britain, Canada, and Korea.

If localized pricing is available in your region, it may apply to certain purchase, such as:

  • Nitro and Nitro Basic subscriptions
  • Server Boosts and Server Boosting subscriptions
  • Discord Shop purchases Some gifts, including Nitro and Shop gifts, are not available at localized prices. Select regions can pay in their local currency, but the cost will still correspond to the standard USD price.

Frequently Asked Questions

This FAQ is divided into two sections:

  • General Localized Pricing Information
  • Specific Location-Based Information
General Localized Pricing Information

Q: What about other countries?

A: We’re always looking to improve Nitro, but we have no updates to share on pricing in other countries at this time.

Q: I’m a desktop subscriber in one of these countries, how come I don’t have localized prices?

A: Go to the Subscriptions page - if you don’t see the localized price listed for your subscription, make sure you have a valid payment method and that the payment method is issued by a bank in one of the eligible countries. You should then receive a popup asking you to confirm your localized price.

Q: How can I see if I am receiving a localized price?

A: The desktop subscriptions settings page will show you what price you are receiving for Nitro. If it doesn’t currently show the localized price, you may still be eligible. Please note that only certain Nitro tiers are eligible for localized pricing at this time, not all.

Q: Why is my price for Nitro different from my friends?

A: Discord regularly reviews and updates prices based on factors like your location, local market conditions, currency exchange rates, and regional operating costs. We also test different pricing approaches to better understand what works best for our community.

If your subscription price changes, we’ll always notify you in advance so you know what to expect and can manage your subscription before any new prices take effect.

Q: When does the new price take effect?

A: At your next billing cycle.

Q: Do Nitro Gifts and Shop gifts have localized pricing?

A: Some gifted items, both Shop items and Nitro gifts of all tiers, are available at localized prices.

If paying in your local currency is unavailable, the purchase will default to USD ($). You can see at the final checkout whether your purchase is in localized pricing or USD ($) if you see the relevant currency symbol adjacent to the price. A purchase in USD looks like: “$X.XX”.

Q: I still can’t pay for my Discord purchases or subscriptions because [X] (e.g. you don’t accept my payment method).

A: We’re trying to improve support for purchasing Discord subscriptions, including Nitro, Nitro Basic, and Server Boosting, as well as purchases from the Discord shop in various countries.

Q: Why were there additional fees or taxes on my purchase in a localized pricing country?

A: When making a purchase in a country where localized pricing is available, mandatory fees and/or taxes may be imposed. Please reach out to your bank or payment processor if you have questions about taxes or fees.

Q: I purchased a Nitro/Nitro Classic Monthly or Yearly subscription before localized pricing became available in my country. Can I get a refund?

A: We are happy to issue a refund for your purchase if it falls within our Refund Policy. If your purchase falls within the refund policy, you can reach out to our support team here to request a refund: dis.gd/billing

If your purchase falls outside the refund policy, our team is unable to issue a refund. However, your subscription will automatically be updated to the new localized price upon the next renewal date. We appreciate your understanding!

Q: How do I know if a price is in my local currency?

A: Each currency displays with its specific currency code (for example, €, ฿, ¥) or in format CA$X.XX. If you’re in a region with localized pricing, any USD-denominated pricing will be presented with $, USD, or US$. beside the price.

Specific Location-Based Information

Q: Why was I charged in USD for my purchase despite being in a region where localized pricing is available?

A: To clarify, you may have been charged in USD for a purchase (including Nitro, Server Boosts, or Shop items) despite localized pricing being available in your region for any of the following reasons:

  • Your payment method on file does not originate from the proper region where localized pricing is available.
  • Your payment method does not support the currency you’re attempting to pay with (for example, PayPal.)
  • You’re using a VPN, which may affect proper recognition of your location.
  • You’re purchasing through a third party vendor, such as Google Play, that does not support transactions in all currencies.
  • You purchased a gift. Gifts are not currently available in all localized prices, and will cost the equivalent of the USD price, or default to USD, depending on your region.
  • You manually selected USD as your currency in the “Pay for it with” menu during the checkout process. Q: My bank in Brazil won’t process my payment in BRL. What should I do?

A: We are aware of this issue and working on a fix with our payment providers. We apologize for any inconvenience! In the meantime, you can try switching to an alternative payment method, which may resolve the issue.

Q: Why did the PLN pricing in Poland change after December 14, 2022?

A: To clarify, on December 14, 2022, we grandfathered our previous Polish prices as we expanded Euro pricing availability to our Polish users.

If you subscribed to Nitro, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting before this date, you will keep your current pricing as long as you don’t make any further subscription changes. Such changes include but are not limited to: changing billing frequency, changing plan tier, changing payment methods, adding or removing boosts, requesting a refund, or any other changes to your subscription features, price, or billing period.

If you’d like to cancel your subscription, you can do so by going to User Settings > Subscriptions. However, keep in mind that canceling your subscription will also result in a loss of grandfathered prices once your subscription ends.

Q: Is localized pricing available for ARS/Argentina?

A: As of February 15, 2024, we began the deprecation of ARS pricing and it is no longer available when purchasing Nitro, Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, and/or Server Boosting. If you are a Discord user in Argentina and currently have a Nitro, Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, and/or Server Boosting subscription, you will receive a notification of this change through the email associated with your Discord account about how this change will impact your subscription.

If you would like to cancel your Discord subscription, you can go to your User Settings > Subscription to cancel your current subscription(s).

Q: I lost my grandfathered pricing on my subscription, how can I get it back?

A: Unfortunately, once grandfathered pricing is lost, Discord Support cannot restore it to your subscription. This typically happens when you make changes to your subscription.

Changes that affect grandfathered pricing include: changing your billing frequency, switching plan tiers, updating payment methods, modifying boosts, requesting refunds, or making any adjustments to your subscription’s features, price, or billing period.

Q: Did the TRY/Turkey pricing change for Discord subscriptions?

A: On February 21, 2024, we made a price adjustment to the TRY pricing for our Discord subscriptions, which is in effect for all new purchases of Nitro, Nitro Basic, and Nitro Classic in Turkey. For current subscribers of Nitro, Nitro Basic, and Nitro Classic in Turkey, you should see a notification of this change through the email associated with your Discord account about its impact on your subscription.

If you would like to cancel your Discord subscription, you can go to your User Settings > Subscriptions to cancel your current subscription(s).

If you are currently subscribed to Nitro, Nitro Basic, and Nitro Classic through the Apple App Store or the Google Play Store and you are based in Turkey with the TRY pricing, you will maintain the legacy subscription prices so long as you are still subscribed through the mobile app.

Q: I’m in Great Britain or Canada and I see my price is now localized. When did this happen?

A: As of April 2026, we transitioned pricing in Great Britain and Canada to local currencies. This change standardizes pricing across these regions and provides a more consistent and simplified purchasing experience.

Where to Manage all of Your Active Subscriptions

Subscriptions Tab in User Settings on Desktop

When you’ve purchased a Nitro subscription, or maybe added some Server Boosts to your account, you can manage those subscriptions and find information about them in your Subscriptions.

  1. Head into your User Settings by pressing the cogwheel [] icon.

  2. Then, select the Subscriptions tab.

Once there, you can find information about:

  • Any active subscriptions;
  • The renewal dates and amounts you’ll be charged;
  • Options to manage your subscriptions, including canceling or switching plans;
  • Any gift subscription credits you’ve received. For more information on how to cancel a subscription, please check out one of these relevant articles depending on your subscription type: Nitro subscription, Server Boosting, Server subscription, or Premium App.

Billing Information and History

You can find your payment methods on file, as well as your payment history, under User Settings > Billing.

Billing Tab in User Settings on Desktop
How do I add or edit payment methods?

You can add a new payment method or edit any pre-existing payment methods in the Billing tab.

To add a payment method, select the Add Payment Method button and complete the prompts.

Example of Adding a Payment Method

If you would like to make changes to a pre-existing payment method, select the Edit button to the right of the payment method. From there, you will be able to view the payment method information.

Default Tag and Edit Button for Payment Method

You can also set a payment method as default. The default payment method will be the first payment method that appears when making new purchases. To select which payment method shows as default:

  1. Select Edit next to the payment method you’d like to set as the default, or Add a new payment method.

  2. Select Make this my default payment method at the bottom.

  3. Press Save.

Make this my default payment method Checkbox
How do I change my payment method for my subscription?

You can find the payment method associated with any subscriptions in User Settings > Subscriptions. This section will show the payment method you first purchased a subscription with.

If you’d like to change the payment method for your ongoing subscription payments:

  1. Open User Settings > Subscriptions.

  2. Find the Pay for it With section.

  3. Select a payment method.

Note: Updating your subscription payment method does not automatically change which payment method is set as your default payment method. If you’d like to set one card as both your default and subscription payment methods, you will need to update both settings to the same card.

Pay for it with Dropdown

If you have a Nitro or Boost subscription, the payment method set under the Pay for it With section will show a corresponding Subscription tag under User Settings > Billing.

Subscription Tag
How do I remove a payment method?

  1. To remove a payment method, head over to your User Settings > Billing.

  2. Then, select Edit located to the right of the payment method.

  3. While reviewing your payment method details, select Delete Payment Method to remove it.

Delete Payment Method Button

Note: If you have an active subscription, we require you to have at least one saved payment method. If you’d like to cancel your subscription and remove your cards on file, be sure to cancel your subscription first.

Where can I download my tax invoice or purchase receipt?

  1. You can locate either your purchase receipt or tax invoice by heading into your User Settings > Billing.

  2. Then, select a transaction within your Transaction History to review your Purchase Details.

  3. Within your Purchase Details, depending on which document you have available, you will see Download Tax Invoice or Download extended purchase receipt > Download PDF. Once the download is complete, you will be able to review the document.

You may see either the “Download extended purchase receipt” or “Download tax invoice” within this section.

What payment methods are accepted?

To make a purchase, you will need a valid payment method linked to your account.

We currently accept the following payment methods:

Available globally:

  • PayPal

  • Apple Pay

  • Google Pay Available by region:

  • KakaoPay (South Korea)

  • Pix (Brazil)

  • Przelewy24 (Poland)

  • Venmo (United States) Important: When selecting your payment method, please note we are unable to provide refunds for purchases made with Paysafecards.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: My payments are failing, and/or I see pending transactions in my bank statement. What should I do?

A: Visit our Help Center article to learn more about how to handle failed payments.

Q: I want to remove all my payment methods, but I can’t. What’s going on?

A: Removing payment methods does not end a subscription for you. In order to remove all payment methods, you will need to cancel any remaining active subscriptions first. Visit our Help Center article here for how to cancel your subscriptions.

Q: What does “proration” mean?

A: Proration for a subscription means adjusting the cost based on how much of the subscription period you’ve used. Discord uses this to ensure you’re being charged the correct amount when adding subscriptions or removing subscriptions on your account, and in situations like when accepting a special offer or discount.

Q: I have a Nitro Monthly subscription, but I just purchased a Nitro Yearly subscription. Can I get a refund?

A: Your original Nitro Monthly subscription was used as proration credit toward your Nitro Yearly subscription upgrade. This means the amount you paid for Nitro Yearly was not the full amount as you paid the prorated charge. When the subscription renews, you will be charged the full price of the subscription. To check your receipt, check User Settings > Billing.

Q: What’s the difference between the default payment method and my subscription payment method?

A: The default payment method determines which payment will show first when making new purchases on Discord. However, your subscription payment method is what’s used to pay for your recurring Nitro and Boost subscriptions.

You can set the same payment method for both by following the steps to update your default payment method and updating your subscription payment method.

Please note that the payment method used to pay for server and app subscriptions specifically will not show a Subscription tag within the Billing tab, and these subscriptions will charge from either the original payment method selected or the payment method set for the specific App subscription in the Premium App Subscriptions list.

Q: What happens if I previously purchased a Server Boost subscription, and now I’m buying an additional Nitro Yearly subscription?

A: If you have purchased any additional subscription with a different billing cycle, Discord will unify all of your subscription payment dates. This means that your subscription type may change from a monthly cycle to a yearly cycle if you have purchased additional subscriptions with a yearly cycle.

Additionally, if you purchase an application or server subscription, your Server Boost subscription cycle won’t be affected.

For example, if you initially had a Server Boost Monthly subscription, purchasing an additional Nitro Yearly subscription will convert the current Server Boost Monthly subscription to a Server Boost Yearly subscription in order to simplify all subscription charges to one payment date.

Q: When making a purchase, I see something called “adjustments.” What is this?

A: Adjustments can be added to a purchase for a few reasons when signing up for additional subscription purchases, such as:

  • If you’re changing your billing plan from monthly to yearly
  • If your payment is being prorated
  • If you are getting a discount Q: I’m receiving a “Billing address is invalid” error when making purchase. How do I fix this?

A: If you see this error while attempting to make a purchase, this means that the billing address associated with the card you are trying to use does not match the address filed with your bank. Please check User Settings > Billing > Select the card > Edit and update your billing address.

Q: Why do I still have server boosts when I canceled my Nitro subscription?

A: Server Boosts are a separate monthly subscription, and it’s possible that you have one or more Server Boost subscriptions active. To manage the subscription, you would need to go to your User Settings > Subscriptions.

Q: I have a new Discord account, can I transfer my Nitro subscription to another account?

A: Unfortunately, Discord doesn’t currently support transferring Nitro subscriptions between accounts. We understand this might be a bit inconvenient, and we appreciate your understanding.

Q: I got a notice that my Nitro price is decreasing, why is that?

A: Discord regularly reviews and updates prices based on factors like your location, local market conditions, currency exchange rates, and regional operating costs. We also test different pricing approaches to better understand what works best for our community.

As part of this process, we lowered the price of the Nitro plan for a small number of subscribers in the US and Canada on November 12, 2025.

Refund Policy

We understand that you may not love everything that you purchase. That’s why we’re keeping our refund policy simple and straightforward.

Please note that all refund requests submitted under this Policy are reviewed by Discord on a case-by-case basis and eligibility is determined at our sole discretion.

    • Paysafecards
    • Orbs

    • Exceptions

  • DLC, Profile Cosmetics and In-App
  • Game Shop
  • Purchases from Users and Developers
    • Server Subscription Refunds
    • Server Shop Purchase Refunds
    • Premium App Refunds
  • How to Submit a Refund Request Important Note:

Refunds for purchases described in this Refund Policy are one-time refunds only, unless we explicitly state otherwise in this Policy. This means that you are only eligible for one refund under each purchase category.

For example, if you have previously received a refund for any Nitro subscription, you will not be eligible for any other Nitro subscription refund in the future.

Refunds by Payment Type

iOS App Store Purchases

For any purchases you made on Discord using your iOS device, such as an iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch, you will need to request a refund for those purchases via the iOS App Store.

More information on iOS App Store refunds is available here.

Paysafecards

We are unable to provide any refunds for purchases made with Paysafecards.

Orbs

We are unable to provide any refunds for any purchases made with Orbs. However, if you are concerned that any Orbs you’ve accumulated have been spent without your permission, please submit a ticket through dis.gd/billing.

Nitro and Server Boosts

If you would like to request a refund for any Nitro or Server Boost purchase you’ve made, you must reach out to our Support Team and provide all requested information associated with your purchase within 5 days of your initial purchase at dis.gd/billing. Our Support Team will review your request and notify you of the outcome of your request.

Exceptions

Subscriber Promotions

If you have redeemed or received any promotional items from Discord or from a Discord partner promotion (ex. Free Xbox Game Pass) within 5 days of your Nitro membership renewing or becoming a new Nitro subscriber, you will not be eligible for a Nitro membership refund.

Nitro Gifts

If the Nitro gift you purchased was self-claimed (claimed on the same account you purchased the gift from), you can request a refund.

The refund counts towards the one-time refund for Nitro purchases and follows the same refund policy.

We are unable to provide a refund for a Nitro gift purchase once the gift has been claimed by another user.

However, for unclaimed Nitro gifts purchased on Discord on desktop/web/Android, you will have 5 days from the initial purchase date to request a refund with our Support Team.

Any promotional offers you receive in connection with your purchase of a Nitro gift may be revoked if you receive a refund for the underlying gift purchase.

DLC, Profile Cosmetics and In-App Purchases

We are unable to provide refunds or exchanges for purchases of downloadable content (DLC), profile cosmetics like Avatar Decorations and Profile Effects, in-app purchases (IAP) within Discord, including potions, as well as any gift purchases of these items made within a Premium App.

For profile cosmetic purchases made in the Shop on an iOS device/through the Apple App Store, please contact Apple for any purchasing issues here.

Purchases from Users and Developers

With some Discord features, we allow you to purchase server subscriptions, premium apps, and other offerings from other users and developers on Discord. While these users and developers are responsible for these offerings, we may offer refunds in our sole discretion in the situations outlined below.

Game Shop

Refunds for items purchased from the Game Shop are limited. Discord may issue a refund if you’re unable to claim the in-game item on a supported platform.

If you or your gift recipient attempt to claim an item you already own in-game within 14 days of purchase, a refund will be automatically issued to the original purchaser. Eligible refunds are processed back to your original payment method within 5–10 business days.

Experiencing an issue with your purchase? Contact us at dis.gd/billing within 14 days of purchase.

Server Subscription Refunds

If you would like to request a refund for a Server Subscription purchase you’ve made, you must reach out to our Support Team within 5 days of your initial purchase at dis.gd/billing

For any refund requests or issues not covered by the above, please contact the creator or admin of the applicable server. If you are unable to address your issue directly with the creator or server admin, you can reach out to our Support Team.

Server Shop Purchase Refunds

We are unable to provide refunds for items purchased from a Server Shop. If your Server Shop purchase is defective or you’re experiencing problems with the purchase, please contact us at dis.gd/billing.

Premium App Refunds

One-time Premium App purchases are non-refundable.

If you would like to request a refund for a Premium App Subscription purchase you’ve made, you must reach out to our Support Team within 5 days of your initial purchase of the subscription at dis.gd/billing

In addition, if an app you’ve purchased a Premium App Subscription for is removed from the applicable server by us or the developer, you may also request a pro-rated refund for the remainder of the subscription within 5 days of such event.

For any refund requests or issues not covered by the above, please contact the developer of the applicable app.

How to Submit a Refund Request

To submit a refund request, or for any questions related to billing, please fill out the request form using the email address associated with your Discord account here.

Make sure to keep the following information in mind when submitting your refund request:

  • Select the correct product category that you’re requesting a refund for.
    • For example, if you are requesting a refund for a Premium App Subscription, select Premium Apps” from the Type of Billing Issue dropdown menu.
  • Provide all of the requested information relevant to the purchase you’re seeking a refund for.
    • Failure to provide this information within the refund eligibility period may result in a denial of your request. If you have any questions for our Support Team regarding billing issues or refund requests, please submit your support request here.

Reporting Unauthorized Discord Transactions

If you notice charges from Discord that you don’t recognize, we’re here to help. Before submitting a support ticket, please review this article and check for the following key details first.

What this article covers:

  • What to Check First
  • How to Report an Unauthorized Charge
  • Submitting Your Support Request

What to Check First

Before diving into the specific items to check, take a moment to review your recent transactions and purchases. Try these steps to identify your Discord charges and make sure we get you the right support:

  • Look for “DISCORD*” or “PAYPAL DISCORD” on your bank statement—these are the official Discord payment descriptors
  • Check if a family member or friend made the purchase
  • Verify if it’s a pending charge that hasn’t been fully processed
  • Check if the charge appears in any of your other Discord accounts
  • Confirm whether the charge is from an automatic subscription renewal or trial period Important: Please contact our billing team before filing a dispute with your bank. Filing a dispute or refund request directly with your bank for any Discord transactions may result in account suspension pending further investigation.

For more information, please review our Chargeback FAQ.

How to Report an Unauthorized Charge

When reporting an unauthorized charge, choose the following category that best matches your situation to ensure accurate resolution:

Type of Issue

Description

I do not recognize a charge on my Discord account

Select this option if you notice charges on your Discord account that you didn’t make. This helps us investigate potential unauthorized access to your account.

I am unsure of which Discord account is associated with the unauthorized charges

Select this option if you’re unable to identify which Discord account is linked to the purchase.

I did not want to be charged for a subscription renewal

Select this option if you were charged for a subscription renewal on your Discord account that you did not want or approve.

I do not have a Discord account

Select this option if you see charges labeled “DISCORD*” or “PAYPAL DISCORD” on your bank statement but do not have a Discord account.

Family member of a user

Select this option if a family member used your payment method to make unauthorized purchases on their Discord account.

Other

Select this option if your situation doesn’t match any of the options above. When submitting your request, please provide a detailed description of your specific circumstances.

Important: Any refunds outside our standard refund policy will result in account disablement per our terms.

Submitting Your Support Request

To submit your request:

  1. Visit our support form.

  2. Select Refunds, Cancellations & Payments from the What can we help you with? dropdown.

  3. Enter your email address.

  4. For Type of Billing Issue, select I have a question/issue regarding an unauthorized transaction.

  5. Pick the most relevant type of issue you are running into.

  6. Include these important payment details in the Description:

  • Transaction date and amount
  • Payment method (e.g., credit card, PayPal, Cash App, or Venmo, etc.)
  • Payment identifier (e.g., last 4 digits of credit card, PayPal invoice ID, $Cashtag, or Venmo User ID, etc.)
  • Attach screenshots of the Discord charges on your bank statement Info: If any of the payment information is missing, it may delay the resolution of your case.
Example of submitting a support request
