Attribution & Measurement Terms

Effective Date: September 18, 2026

These Attribution and Measurement Terms (“Attribution Terms”) govern your use of Discord’s attribution and measurement services (the “Attribution Services”). These Attribution Terms incorporate by reference and are subject to the Discord Business Services Terms, available at support.discord.com (the “Business Terms”). In the event of any conflict between these Attribution Terms and the Business Terms, the Attribution Terms shall control solely with respect to the Attribution Services. Any terms not specifically defined herein shall have the meaning ascribed to them in the Business Terms.

Section 1: Scope and Purpose

The parties acknowledge that both Discord and you have independently contracted with the third party attribution or measurement service provider (“Attribution Partner”) for attribution and/or measurement services which you and Discord have mutually agreed in writing to use for the Purpose specified herein. Discord may use and combine Event Data (defined below) with Discord’s own data and other information to create attribution analytics, insights, measurement and reporting (“Attribution Results”) and for Discord’s own internal business purposes, including: (i) providing the advertising services; (ii) developing and providing campaign attribution, conversion tracking, analytics, insights and metrics; (iii) creating custom audience for targeting, targeting and optimizing campaigns; (iv) optimizing Discord’s systems and services; and (v) developing Discord’s advertising products and services, collectively the “Purpose.”

Section 2: Provision of Event Data

You will (or will cause your Attribution Partner to) provide Discord with the mutually agreed upon event data related to the Ad campaign (inclusive of Quests) where attribution will be conducted, including: (i) conversion events (e.g., app installations, in-app purchases, registrations) and their metadata; (ii) campaign identifiers and their metadata; and/or (iii) other attribution data as agreed by the parties and in support of the Purpose (“Event Data”) for Discord’s use in connection with Ad campaign(s).

You agree that you or your Attribution Partner are authorized and permitted to: (i) transmit to Discord all agreed Event Data related to the campaign; and (ii) permit Discord to measure, analyze, match against, and report on conversions or actions of end users regarding your application (e.g., online or mobile game), website, digital or physical products or services (e.g., purchases, bookings, subscriptions, registrations, or ticket sales), or other offerings. You agree that Discord may collect, reproduce, compile, match against, combine with other data, use, and take all necessary actions with the Event Data for the Purpose outlined herein.

Section 3:. Use of Attribution Results

Discord may, in its sole discretion, share certain Attribution Results with you in anonymized and/or aggregated form. Attribution Results shared with you may include aggregated campaign performance metrics, conversion insights, or other analytics derived from the Event Data, but will not include individual user data or non-aggregated information. You may use Attribution Results solely to assess the performance of Ad campaign(s) on Discord’s platform. You will not: (i) share any Attribution Results with any third party; (ii) attempt to reverse engineer or de-aggregate any Attribution Results; or (iii) use Attribution Results for any purpose other than evaluating campaign performance on Discord.

For the avoidance of doubt, Discord owns all right, title, and interest in: (i) any Attribution Results created by Discord; (ii) any insights, analytics, or reports derived from Event Data; and (iii) any improvements or enhancements to Discord’s systems or services resulting from the use of Event Data. Other than the limited right to use Attribution Results as set forth in the paragraph above (if shared by Discord), you have no rights in Discord’s Attribution Results, analytics, insights, or related intellectual property.

In addition to the foregoing, and with respect to any data Discord makes available to you under these Attribution Terms, whether directly or through an attribution or measurement partner, you may use that data solely to assess the performance of your Ad campaigns on the Discord platform, and for no other purpose, and you will not sell, share, or otherwise disclose or make that data available to any third party, except to a third party acting as your processor or service provider solely to carry out that purpose on your behalf.

Section 4:. Roles, Data Protection Obligations

  1. Definitions

“Applicable Data Protection Laws” means all laws, regulations, and binding requirements relating to data protection and privacy applicable to the processing of Personal Data under this Agreement, including but not limited to the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (“GDPR”), the California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”), and other state, federal, and international data protection laws, as applicable.

“Controller”, “Processor”, “Data Subject”, “Personal Data”, “processing” and other similar terms shall have the meanings given to them in the Applicable Data Protection Laws or, where such terms are not defined, shall have meanings consistent with the concepts described in the Applicable Data Protection Laws.

  1. Controller Status

Each Party shall act as an independent Controller with respect to any Personal Data it processes under this Agreement, including the Event Data shared by you with Discord.

  1. Security Measures

Each Party shall implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk presented by processing the Event Data and Attribution Results, including, as appropriate: (i) pseudonymization and encryption of Personal Data; (ii) the ability to ensure the ongoing confidentiality, integrity, availability, and resilience of processing systems and services; (iii) the ability to restore the availability and access to Personal Data in a timely manner in the event of a physical or technical incident; and (iv) a process for regularly testing, assessing, and evaluating the effectiveness of technical and organizational measures for ensuring the security of the processing.

  1. Personnel

Each Party shall ensure that its personnel authorized to process the Event Data have committed themselves to confidentiality or are under an appropriate statutory obligation of confidentiality and terms no less protective than those set forth in these Attribution Terms.

  1. Data Transfer Compliance

Each Party shall ensure that any international transfers of Personal Data comply with Applicable Data Protection Laws.

  1. Data Retention

Discord may retain Event Data and Attribution Results for as long as necessary for Discord’s business purposes or as required by applicable law.

  1. Personal Data Breach Notification and Response

Each Party shall notify the other Party without undue delay and, where feasible, no more than seventy-two (72) hours after becoming aware of a Personal Data breach affecting Event Data or Attribution Results. The notification shall include, to the extent then known: (i) a description of the nature of the Personal Data breach; (ii) the categories and approximate number of Data Subjects concerned; (iii) the categories and approximate number of Personal Data records concerned; (iv) the likely consequences of the Personal Data breach; and (v) measures taken or proposed to be taken to address the Personal Data breach and to mitigate its potential adverse effects. Each Party shall reasonably cooperate with the other Party in investigating, containing, and remediating any Personal Data breach.

  1. Data Subject Rights

Each Party shall individually be responsible for: (i) informing Data Subjects about the processing of their Personal Data in accordance with Applicable Data Protection Laws; and (ii) enabling Data Subjects to exercise their rights under Applicable Data Protection Laws (including rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and objection) with respect to Personal Data for which that Party is the Controller. If a Party receives a Data Subject request relating to Personal Data for which the other Party is the Controller, the receiving Party shall promptly notify and forward such request to the appropriate Party.

  1. International Data Transfers

To the extent Event Data or other Personal Data originating from the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland is transferred to Discord in the United States: (i) such transfers are made in reliance on Discord Inc.’s certification under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, the UK Extension to the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, and the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, with respect to Personal Data within the scope of that certification; and (ii) to the extent any such transfer is not covered by that certification, or the applicable framework is invalidated or Discord’s certification lapses, the Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission (Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/914), Module One (controller to controller), are incorporated by reference and automatically apply to such transfers, with the Annexes deemed completed by the Transfer Description Schedule (Schedule 1) referenced in these Terms; for transfers from the United Kingdom, the UK International Data Transfer Addendum issued by the Information Commissioner’s Office applies; and for transfers from Switzerland, the Standard Contractual Clauses apply as adapted in accordance with the guidance of the Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner. The Parties will promptly adopt any additional or replacement transfer mechanism required by Applicable Data Protection Laws.

Section 5:. Additional Warranties; Indemnification.

You represent and warrant that you: (i) have obtained all necessary consents, permissions, and authorizations from Data Subjects or otherwise have a valid legal basis under Applicable Data Protection Laws to collect and share the Event Data with Discord; (ii) have provided appropriate privacy notices to its users informing them that their data may be shared with Discord for Discord’s business purposes; (iii) will maintain appropriate records of consent or other legal bases as required by Applicable Data Protection Laws; (iv) have implemented appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect the Event Data; (v) will notify Discord without undue delay upon becoming aware of any Personal Data breach affecting Event Data; (vi) will ensure that Event Data will not contain any sensitive information or special category data, including but not limited to: (a) health information; (b) financial information; (c) information about racial or ethnic origin, religious beliefs, sex life or sexual orientation; and (d) any Personal Data relating to users under the age of 13 or the applicable age of consent under Applicable Law in the jurisdiction where such data was collected, whichever is greater; (vii) will promptly notify Discord of any complaints relating to Event Data and will reasonably cooperate with Discord in responding to such complaints; and (viii) will only share the Event Data that is directly related to the specific Ad campaign(s) set forth in the applicable IO and only as necessary and consistent with the Purpose.

You shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Discord and its affiliates, directors, officers, employees, and agents against all claims, liabilities, costs, expenses, damages and losses (including any direct, indirect or consequential losses, loss of profit, loss of reputation and all interest, penalties and legal costs and all other reasonable professional costs and expenses) (“Claims”) arising from or related to: (i) your breach of Applicable Data Protection Laws relating to Event Data; (ii) your collection, processing, or provision of Event Data to Discord (including any claim made by a Data Subject or supervisory authority with respect thereto); (iii) any breach of the warranties set forth in the paragraph above; or (iv) any claim that your provision of Event Data to Discord violates any third party rights or Applicable Data Protection Laws.

Section 6. Data Clean Rooms.

If agreed by the parties in writing (an email shall suffice), the parties may use a third-party data clean room or similar secure computing environment approved by Discord (“Data Clean Room”) to receive Attribution Results or conduct additional analysis. If you use a Data Clean Room, you agree that you: (a) will not use the Data Clean Room to engage in practices otherwise prohibited by these Attribution Terms or any terms in an IO; (b) will be bound by all restrictions on Attribution Results set forth in these Attribution Terms with respect to any results, metrics, or insights received via the Data Clean Room; and (c) represent and warrant that any data you contribute to the Data Clean Room has been collected and processed in compliance with Applicable Data Protection Laws and does not include any sensitive or special category data.

Custom Audience Terms

Effective Date: January 22, 2026

Custom Audience Terms

These Custom Audience Terms (“Custom Audience Terms”) govern your use of Discord’s Custom Audience services (the “Custom Audience Services”). These Custom Audience Terms incorporate by reference and are subject to the Discord Business Services Terms, available at support.discord.com (the “Business Terms”). In the event of any conflict between these Custom Audience Terms and the Business Terms, the Custom Audience Terms shall control solely with respect to the Custom Audience Services. Any terms not specifically defined herein shall have the meaning ascribed to them in the Business Terms.

Section 1: Definitions

  1. “Applicable Data Protection Laws” means all laws, regulations, and binding requirements relating to data protection and privacy applicable to the processing of Personal Data under this Agreement, including but not limited to the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (“GDPR”), the California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”), and other state, federal, and international data protection laws, as applicable.

  2. “Custom Audiences” means audiences created by matching Customer Data with Discord user accounts for the purpose of targeting advertising or other communications to those matched users on the Discord platform.

  3. “Customer Data” means Personal Data provided by you to Discord that enables Discord to match individuals with Discord user accounts to create Custom Audiences.

  4. “Discord User Data” refers to the Personal Information and usage data collected by Discord from its users, all as further described in Discord’s Privacy Policy (www.discord.com/privacy).

  5. “Controller”, “Processor”, “Data Subject”, “Personal Data”, “processing”, and other similar terms shall have the meanings given to them in the Applicable Data Protection Laws or, where such terms are not defined, shall have meanings consistent with the concepts described in the Applicable Data Protection Laws.

Section 2: Purpose and Scope

This Agreement governs your use of Discord’s Custom Audience Services related to the Ad campaign (inclusive of Quests) as specified in the applicable IO. To create Custom Audiences, you will provide Customer Data to Discord, which Discord will match with Discord User Data. Discord may also create lookalike targeting audiences of Discord users with similar characteristics to the members of your Custom Audiences (“Lookalike Audiences”). Following the creation of Custom Audiences and any Lookalike Audiences, Discord will share the outcome thereof with you.

Section 3: Data Sharing Obligations

  1. Additional Warranties; Indemnification

You agree, represent and warrant that the provision of Customer Data to Discord complies with the requirements of Applicable Law. More specifically, you agree, represent and warrant to: (i) exclude any sensitive personal information or special category personal data as defined under Applicable Data Protection Laws from the Customer Data; (ii) exclude any Personal Data relating to users under the age of 13 or the applicable age of consent under Applicable Law in the jurisdiction where such data was collected, whichever is greater, from the Customer Data; (iii) obtain and maintain all necessary and legally compliant legal bases as set out in Data Privacy Laws, rights and licenses from end users necessary for Discord to process the Customer Data; (iv) communicate any exercise of Data Subject rights of your end users contained in the Customer Data such as rectification, erasure or restriction of processing to Discord, unless this proves impossible or involves disproportionate effort; and (v) in your privacy notice disclose to its end user that their Personal Data is shared with third parties for processing.

  1. Provision of Customer Data.

You will provide Customer Data as mutually agreed by the Parties in writing (email shall suffice) during the Term. The specific format and method of Customer Data transfer shall be mutually agreed upon by the Parties in writing prior to any transfer, or as otherwise through means made available by Discord, such as an API or online environment.

  1. Discord Restrictions. Discord will: (a) delete or de-identify Customer Data that does not match a Discord user account after the matching process is complete; (b) not permit other advertisers to use your Custom Audiences to target ads to Discord users, unless expressly approved by you in writing; and (c) not share Customer Data or Custom Audiences with third parties except for: (i) service providers as necessary to perform the matching process to create Custom Audiences; and (ii) as required by applicable laws or regulations.

Section 4: Data Protection Obligations

For the collection of Customer Data and the provision of such Customer Data to Discord, you act as an independent Controller and are solely responsible and liable for compliance with Applicable Data Protection Laws.

Discord acts as a Processor on your behalf solely for the matching of Customer Data. The Parties agree that Discord will process such Customer Data pursuant to the Data Processing Agreement (Discord as a Processor) available here support.discord.com, which is incorporated by this reference and made part of this Agreement.

Discord remains an independent Controller with respect to the processing of Discord User Data.

Section 5: Data Retention and Deletion

Discord shall retain Customer Data only as necessary to provide the Custom Audiences Services, and will delete the Customer Data promptly, after the creation of the Custom Audience, upon termination of this Agreement, or upon your written request. Discord may retain Customer Data only as required by law, with notice to you where permitted, maintaining confidentiality and limiting use to legal compliance purposes.

  • will not, without Partner’s prior written consent or as otherwise described in this Agreement or the applicable Applicable Product Terms, combine Personal Data with any other data or attempt to link, identify, or otherwise create a relationship between Data and other data.
  1. Compliance with Data Privacy Laws.
  1. Each Party shall comply with its respective obligations under the Data Privacy Laws in respect of Personal Data Processed pursuant to this Agreement.
  1. Personal Data Processing Requirements. Discord will:

  1. ensure that the persons it authorizes to Process Personal Data have committed themselves to confidentiality or are under an appropriate statutory obligation of confidentiality.

  2. upon written request of Partner, assist Partner, taking into account the nature of the Processing, by appropriate technical and organisational measures and in so far as is possible, in the fulfillment of Partner’s obligations to respond to requests by Data Subjects for exercising their rights under Data Privacy Laws (such as rights to access or delete Personal Data).

  3. promptly notify Partner of (i) any Data Subject requests regarding the Processing of Personal Data under the Applicable Product Terms; or (ii) any Data Subject requests for access to or information about Discord’s Processing of Personal Data on Partner’s behalf, unless prohibited by Data Privacy Laws.

  4. at Partner’s request and expense, provide reasonable assistance to and cooperate with Partner in respect of any data protection impact assessments required in relation to the Processing of Personal Data pursuant to this Agreement.

  5. at Partner’s request and expense, provide reasonable assistance to and cooperate with Partner in respect of any consultation with regulatory authorities required in relation to the Processing of Personal Data pursuant to this Agreement.

  1. Data Security. Discord will implement appropriate administrative, technical, physical, and organizational measures to protect Personal Data, as set forth in Data Security Terms.

  2. Personal Data Breach. Discord will notify Partner promptly of any Personal Data Breach. In the event of a Personal Data Breach, Discord will assist Partner in Partner’s compliance with its Personal Data Breach notification related obligations. Discord will:

  1. Take steps to mitigate the effects of the Personal Data Breach and reduce the risk to Data Subjects whose Personal Data was involved; and

  2. Provide Partner with the following information:

  3. The nature of the Personal Data Breach, including, where possible, what happened, the categories and approximate number of Data Subjects concerned, and the categories and approximate number of Personal Data records concerned;

  1. The likely consequences of the Personal Data Breach; and

  2. Measures taken or proposed to be taken by Discord to address the Personal Data Breach, including, where appropriate, measures to mitigate its possible adverse effects.

  1. Subprocessors.

  1. Partner acknowledges and agrees that Discord has general authorisation to use Discord Affiliates and other subcontractors (“Subprocessors”) to Process Personal Data in accordance with the provisions within this Agreement and Data Privacy Laws. A current list of Discord’s Subprocessors relevant for this Agreement is in the attached Schedule 2, and Partner hereby consents to Discord’s use of such Subprocessors.

  2. Where Discord sub-contracts any of its rights or obligations concerning Personal Data, including to any Affiliate, Discord will (i) enter into a written agreement with each Subprocessor that imposes obligations on the Subprocessor that are no less onerous than those imposed on Discord under this Agreement; and (ii) where any Subprocessor fails to fulfill its obligations under the written agreement, Discord will remain liable for the performance of such Subprocessor’s obligations thereunder or breach thereof.

  3. Discord shall notify Partner if it adds or removes Subprocessors at least 30 days prior to any such changes. In the event Partner objects to a new subcontractor, Discord will use reasonable efforts to make available to Partner a change in the services or recommend a commercially reasonable change to Partner’s use of the services to avoid Processing of Personal Data by the objected-to subcontractor without unreasonably burdening Partner.

  1. International Data Transfers.

  1. Partner acknowledges and agrees that Discord may Process or transfer any Personal Data in or to a territory other than the territory in which the Personal Data was first collected under the Applicable Product Terms, including as set out in Schedule 2. Discord will take all such measures as are necessary to ensure that any such Processing or transfer is in compliance with Data Privacy Laws.

  2. Transfer Mechanisms. To the extent that a transfer of Personal Data from Partner to Discord constitutes a Restricted Transfer to a country which does not benefit from an absolute adequacy decision under the Data Privacy Laws, the following shall apply, as applicable:

  3. Data Transfers Subject to a Data Privacy Framework. For transfers of Personal Data from Partner to Discord in the US, Discord is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, the UK extension to the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and the Swiss-US Data Privacy Framework (collectively the “Alternative Transfer Mechanisms”) and the Alternative Transfer Mechanisms constitute the valid transfer mechanism. Notwithstanding the above, if a court of competent jurisdiction or supervisory authority orders that the Alternative Transfer Mechanism cannot be relied on to lawfully transfer Personal Data to the United States, then the Parties agree that the data transfer mechanisms in Sections 8.b.ii-iv., shall apply.

  1. EU Data Transfers. If Section 8(b)(i) does not apply, then with respect to Personal Data subject to the EU GDPR, the Partner and Discord agree to comply with the EU SCCs which shall form part of this Agreement, and take precedence over the rest of this Agreement as set forth in the EU SCC, and shall be completed as follows:
  • Discord acts as Partner’s Processor, therefore Module Two of the EU SCCs shall apply.
  • Clause 7 (the optional docking clause) is not included.
  • Under Clause 9 (Use of subprocessors), the parties select Option 2 (General written authorization). The initial list of subprocessors is set forth below in Schedule 2 of this Agreement, and Discord shall update that list and inform Partner in writing at least 30 business days in advance of any intended additions or replacements of subprocessors.
  • Under Clause 11 (Redress), the optional requirement that data subjects be permitted to lodge a complaint with an independent dispute resolution body does not apply.
  • Under Clause 17 (Governing law), the parties choose Option 1 (the law of an EU Member State that allows for third-party beneficiary rights). The parties select the law of The Netherlands. All procedures will be conducted in English.
  • Under Clause 18 (Choice of forum and jurisdiction), the parties select the courts in the City of Amsterdam, The Netherlands.
  • Annexes I and II of the EU SCCs are set forth in Schedule 3 of the Agreement.
  • Annex III of the EU SCCs (List of subprocessors) is set forth in Schedule 2.
  • By entering into this Agreement, the Parties are deemed to be signing the EU SCCs.
  1. UK Data Transfers. With respect to Personal Data subject to the UK GDPR, the Partner and Discord agree to comply with the UK SCCs which shall form part of this Agreement and take precedence over the rest of this Agreement as set forth in the UK SCCs. Undefined capitalized terms used in this provision shall mean the definitions in the UK SCCs. As permitted by clause 17 of the UK SCCs, the Parties agree to change the format of the information set out in Part 1 of the UK SCCs so that:
  • Table 1 of the UK SCCs: The Parties’ details shall be the Parties and their Affiliates to the extent any of them is involved in such transfer, including those set forth in Schedule 3. The Key Contact shall be the contacts set forth in Schedule 3.
  • Table 2 of the UK SCCs: The UK SCCs shall be appended to the EU SCCs as referenced above in Section 8(b)(ii).
  • Table 3 of the UK SCCs: Annex 1A, 1B, II, and III shall be set forth in Schedule 3.
  • Table 4 of the UK SCCs: A party may end this Agreement as set out in Section 19 of the UK SCCs.
  • By entering into this Agreement, the Parties are deemed to be signing the UK SCCs and its applicable Tables and Appendix Information.
  1. Swiss Data Transfers. With respect to Personal Data transferred from Switzerland for which the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (“FADP”) (and not the law in any European Economic Area jurisdiction) governs the international nature of the transfer, the EU SCCs shall apply and shall be deemed to have the following differences to the extent required by the FADP as follows:
  • References to the GDPR in the EU SCCs are to be understood as references to the FADP insofar as the data transfers are subject exclusively to the FADP and not to the GDPR.
  • The term “member state” in the EU SCCs shall not be interpreted in such a way as to exclude data subjects in Switzerland from the possibility of suing for their rights in their place of habitual residence (Switzerland) in accordance with Clause 18(c) of the EU SCCs.
  • References to personal data in the EU SCCs also refer to data about identifiable legal entities until the entry into force of revisions to the FADP that eliminate this broader scope.
  • Under Annex I(C) of the EU SCCs (Competent supervisory authority): where the transfer is subject exclusively to the FADP and not the GDPR, the supervisory authority is the Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner, and where the transfer is subject to both the FADP and the GDPR, the supervisory authority is the Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner insofar as the transfer is governed by the FADP, and the supervisory authority is as set forth in the EU SCCs insofar as the transfer is governed by the GDPR.

  1. Audit, Compliance and Remediation. Discord will make available to Partner information reasonably necessary to demonstrate compliance with this DPA and will allow for and contribute to audits conducted by Partner or another auditor (at Partner’s sole cost and expense) designated by Partner on reasonable notice by Partner and no more frequently than once every 12 months. Partner shall conduct audits during standard working hours and use all reasonable endeavours to minimise disruption to Discord.

  2. Return or Destruction of Personal Data. Except to the extent required otherwise by Data Privacy Laws, Discord will, at the choice of Partner, return to Partner and/or securely destroy all Personal Data upon (a) written request of Partner or (b) termination of the Applicable Product Terms. Except to the extent prohibited by Data Privacy Laws, Discord will inform Partner if it is not able to return or delete any Data.

  3. Term. The effective date of this Agreement is the date of the latest signature of a Party. This Agreement shall remain in force for the duration of the Applicable Product Terms and for long as Discord processes Personal Data.

  4. Survival. The provisions of this Agreement survive the termination or expiration of the Applicable Product Terms for so long as Discord or its subcontractors Process any Personal Data.

Data Security Terms

Effective Date: September 18, 2026

These Data Security Terms apply where Discord Processes Personal Data received from or on behalf of a partner under Applicable Product Terms, whether Discord acts as a Processor or as a Controller of such Personal Data. ‘Applicable Product Terms’ means the Discord terms, policies, or ordering documents governing the product or service under which the Personal Data is provided to Discord. Capitalized terms used but not defined in these Data Security Terms have the meanings given in the Applicable Product Terms. Discord will implement and maintain the following administrative, technical, physical, and organizational security measures for the Processing of such Personal Data:

  1. Discord has agreed to employ appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect against unauthorized or unlawful Processing of Data and against accidental loss or destruction of, or damage to, Personal Data (“Information Security Program”).

  2. Discord’s Information Security Program includes specific security requirements for its personnel and all subcontractors or agents who have access to Personal Data (“Data Personnel”). Discord’s security requirements cover the following areas:

  1. Information Security Policies and Standards. Discord will maintain information security policies, standards, and procedures. These policies, standards, and procedures shall be kept up to date, and revised whenever relevant changes are made to the information systems that use or store Personal Data. These policies, standards, and procedures shall be designed and implemented to:

  2. Prevent unauthorized persons from gaining physical access to Personal Data Processing systems (e.g. physical access controls);

  1. Prevent Personal Data Processing systems from being used without authorization (e.g. logical access control);

  2. Ensure that Personnel gain access only to such Personal Data as they are entitled to access (e.g. in accordance with their access rights) and that, in the course of Processing or use and after storage, Personal Data cannot be read, copied, modified or deleted without authorization (e.g. data access controls);

  3. Ensure that Personal Data cannot be read, copied, modified or deleted without authorization during electronic transmission, transport or storage, and that the recipients of any transfer of Personal Data by means of data transmission facilities can be established and verified (e.g. data transfer controls); and

  4. Ensure that all systems that Process Personal Data are the subject of a vulnerability management program that includes without limitation internal and external vulnerability scanning with risk rating findings and formal remediation plans to address any identified vulnerabilities.

  1. Physical Security. Discord will maintain commercially reasonable security systems at all Discord sites at which an information system that uses or stores Personal Data is located (“Processing Locations”) and will reasonably restrict access to such Processing Locations or require that Processing Locations have implemented reasonable restrictions to access.

  2. Organizational Security. Discord will maintain information security policies and procedures addressing:

  3. Data Classification. Policies and procedures to classify sensitive information assets, clarify security responsibilities, and promote awareness for all employees have been implemented and are maintained.

  1. Incident Response. All Personal Data security incidents are managed in accordance with appropriate incident response procedures.

  2. Network Security. Discord maintains commercially reasonable information security policies and procedures addressing network security.

  1. Access Control (Governance).

  2. Discord governs access to information systems that Process Personal Data.

  1. Only authorized Discord staff can grant, modify or revoke access to an information system that Processes Personal Data.

  2. Discord implements commercially reasonable physical and technical safeguards to create and protect passwords.

  1. Virus and Malware Controls. Discord protects Personal Data from malicious code and will install and maintain anti-virus and malware protection software on any system that handles Personal Data.

  2. Personnel.

  3. Discord has implemented and maintains a security awareness program to train all employees about their security obligations. This program includes training about data classification obligations, physical security controls, security practices, and security incident reporting.

  1. Personnel who have access to Personal Data strictly follow established security policies and procedures. Disciplinary process is applied if Personnel who have access to Personal Data fail to adhere to relevant policies and procedures.

  2. Discord shall take reasonable steps to ensure the reliability of any employee, agent or contractor who may Process Personal Data.

Discord Advertising IAB Addendum

Updated May 12, 2026

This Discord Advertising IAB Addendum (this “Discord Addendum”), which amends and supplements the IAB STANDARD TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR INTERNET ADVERTISING FOR MEDIA BUYS ONE YEAR OR LESS VERSION 3.0 (the “IAB Terms” and collectively with this Discord Addendum, the “Campaign Terms”), governs and forms a part of any applicable insertion order (the “IO”) signed by and between Discord Inc. (“Media Company”) and the advertiser designated on an IO (“Advertiser”), or, if applicable, Advertiser’s agency designated on an IO (“Agency”). The terms of this Discord Addendum will control over and fully supersede any similar, conflicting, inconsistent or overlapping terms in the IAB Terms or other parts of an IO; however, if an IO expressly states that certain terms set forth in the IO are intended to supersede the terms of this Discord Addendum, then, in the event of conflict, those terms of the applicable IO will control only for that IO and only to the extent of such conflict. Any purchase order terms, “clickthrough” or other online agreements, or other similar documents made available to Media Company by Advertiser or Agency are hereby rejected by Media Company and will not apply to any Quest. Capitalized terms used but not defined herein will have the meanings given to such terms in the IAB Terms.

Where Advertiser is purchasing directly from Media Company, (i) Section 2 and any references to Agency herein will be deemed deleted and will not apply; and (ii) all references in the IAB Terms to Agency, will be deemed to be references to Advertiser.

  1. Quest Terms.

  1. Quests. Media Company will implement a promotional campaign on its platform (the “Discord Platform”) for Advertiser’s applicable property designated on an IO (the “Advertiser Property”) where eligible users of the Discord Platform will be able to complete certain agreed-upon tasks relating to the Advertiser Property and earn certain agreed-upon rewards (“Rewards”), as further detailed in an applicable IO (each such campaign, a “Quest”).

  2. Quest T&Cs. Media Company will, in consultation with Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, establish the specific terms and requirements for users governing each Quest (“Quest T&Cs”), and will publish the Quest T&Cs to users in connection with such Quest. The Quest T&Cs will address, at a minimum (i) user eligibility requirements and any criteria and tasks that must be satisfied by a user in order to receive a Reward; (ii) the nature of the applicable Reward, including whether the Reward will be supplied by Media Company (each, a “Media Company Reward”) or Advertiser (each, an “Advertiser Reward”); and (iv) any other terms, conditions and limitations pertaining to the redemption and use of the Reward.

  3. Advertiser Rewards. Unless otherwise indicated on an IO, the Reward will be an Advertiser Reward approved by Media Company and either the Advertiser or Agency, as applicable. For any Quest with an Advertiser Reward: (i) reasonably in advance of the applicable flight dates for a Quest, the parties will agree in writing (email to suffice) on and implement the fulfillment and redemption mechanics for the Advertiser Reward, which may consist of the delivery to Media Company of a sufficient number of redemption codes for users to redeem for Advertiser Rewards; (ii) Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, will ensure that the Advertiser Reward and the redemption process is consistent with the Quest T&Cs; and (iii) in the event of any fulfillment or redemption issues (including, without limitation, insufficient or defective redemption codes) in connection with a Quest, Media Company may suspend such Quest until such issues are resolved. For clarity, Advertiser is solely responsible for the Advertiser Rewards and any associated fraud, losses, or other issues in connection with such Advertiser Rewards.

  4. Media Company Rewards. For any Quest where the applicable IO indicates there will be a Media Company Reward, Media Company will (i) ensure that such Media Company Reward and redemption process is consistent with the Quest T&Cs; and (ii) will have responsibility (unless otherwise agreed in the IO) and control over the design and creation of such Media Company Reward. Media Company will obtain Advertiser’s or Agency’s approval (not to be unreasonably withheld) for any Media Company Reward that contains or is derived from Advertising Materials. Media Company Rewards may not be available to users in certain regions where not supported by the Discord Platform. Advertiser and Agency may not terminate for convenience any Quest with (i) a Media Company Reward that contains or is derived from Advertising Materials (“Custom Reward”) or (ii) any other custom Media Company Reward created specifically for the Quest. Where there is a Custom Reward, Advertiser, or Agency on behalf of Advertiser, grants Discord a worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual license in and to the Custom Reward to provide it to Discord Nitro users.

  5. Advertiser Marks License.

  6. Advertiser and Agency hereby grant Media Company a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use and display Advertiser’s name, designated trademarks and associated logos, and any names, trademarks or logos associated with the Advertiser Property (the “Advertiser Marks”) in connection with the implementation of a Quest, the performance of Media Company’s obligations under the Campaign Terms and any IO, or as otherwise approved in writing by Advertiser or Agency.

  1. All goodwill and improved reputation generated by Media Company’s use of the Advertiser Marks inures to the exclusive benefit of Advertiser. Media Company will use the Advertiser Marks in a manner consistent with any branding guidelines provided by Advertiser to Media Company in writing.

  1. Advertising Materials. Advertiser and Agency hereby grant Media Company a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use, display, adapt, translate, modify, copy, publicly perform, transmit and distribute the Advertising Materials in connection with the implementation or promotion of a Quest, the performance of Media Company’s obligations under the Campaign Terms or as otherwise approved by Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, including, without limitation, in connection with the development, distribution and making available of applicable Media Company Rewards containing or derived from such Advertising Materials. The licenses set forth herein are sublicensable by Media Company to its affiliates, agents, and subcontractors in connection with Media Company performance hereunder (and, with respect to Media Company Rewards containing or derived from Advertising Materials, to end users who claim any such Media Company Rewards in connection with a Quest). Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, will, at its own cost and expense, obtain all necessary licenses, consents, approvals and permissions from any third party required for Media Company to exercise its rights under the foregoing license. For purposes of the Campaign Terms, “Advertising Materials” means any content, materials, copy, branding, images, names, audio, music, video, artwork, designs, descriptions, specifications, and other elements made available by Advertiser or Agency to Media Company for use in connection with a Quest, including, without limitation, any elements, materials, assets or intellectual property from the Advertiser Property.

  2. Cooperation. Media Company’s ability to implement the Quest and its obligations under the Campaign Terms and any IO (including, without limitation, the ability to meet the applicable timeframes and schedules for a Quest as specified in an IO) will be contingent upon the timely provision of cooperation from Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, in connection with the Quest, which cooperation includes, without limitation, providing any redemption codes, Advertising Materials and/or Advertiser Rewards as required by Media Company with sufficient lead time for the applicable Quest, compliance with applicable Policies or other campaign and asset specifications, and timely feedback, reviews and approvals for any items and matters requiring approval or input in connection with a Quest. Advertiser and Agency will adhere to any Policies and other agreed upon timeframes, campaign specifications, and development schedules in connection with the foregoing. Media Company will not be liable or responsible for any delays or issues caused by Advertiser’s or Agency’s failure or delay in providing such cooperation.

  3. Quest Prompts. Media Company will be responsible for developing, producing, and displaying prompts or notifications promoting the availability of a Quest (“Quest Prompts”) to certain users on applicable surfaces within the Discord Platform. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, Media Company will have ultimate authority and control over the content, placement, frequency, delivery, timing and accompanying disclosures in connection with all Quest Prompts on the Discord Platform. Media Company reserves the right to suspend or cancel the targeting, personalization, and/or delivery of Quest Prompts in connection with any Quest.

  4. Reporting. For each Quest, Media Company will provide summary reports to Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, regarding certain estimated performance metrics, insights and KPIs within a reasonable timeframe after the midpoint and end date of such Quest. The information in such reports may be used by Advertiser solely for its own internal business purposes but will otherwise be considered Media Company’s Confidential Information.

  5. Estimates. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, any impression or reach numbers, impression-related commitments, targeting parameters, geographies or estimates provided on an IO and any information provided in connection with any report delivered by Media Company with respect to any Quest are provided by Media Company solely on an “AS IS” basis as estimates for informational purposes based on the data reasonably available to Media Company and are not guaranteed or considered binding by the parties in connection with any Quest. Media Company will not be liable (or required to offer any makegood) for any errors, shortfalls, inaccuracies or omissions in connection with any of the foregoing.

  1. Agency Authority. Agency represents, warrants and covenants that it has obtained and will maintain all consents, approvals and authorizations from Advertiser necessary for Agency to (i) bind Advertiser to the Campaign Terms and any IO, act on behalf of Advertiser and otherwise comply with its obligations in connection with the Campaign Terms and any IO, including, without limitation, with respect to (a) the execution of any IOs on Advertiser’s behalf, (b) the ability to pay Media Company for any Quest; (c) the ability to share Advertiser’s Confidential Information with Media Company; and (c) the management and provision of any and all approvals, feedback and reviews in connection with the Campaign Terms and any IO (e.g., the review and approval of Rewards and other Quest elements, press releases, promotional materials, or creative assets); and (ii) grant the licenses set forth in the Campaign Terms and any IO, including, without limitation, any such licenses to Advertiser Marks and Advertising Materials set forth herein. Media Company will be entitled to rely on any documents executed, instructions provided or approvals granted by Agency on an Advertiser’s behalf in connection with the Campaign Terms and any IO. Agency will indemnify and hold Media Company harmless from and against any losses or unpaid obligations under any IOs arising from Agency’s violation of this Section.

  2. Taxes. Unless otherwise stated in an IO, Media Company’s fees do not include any direct or indirect local, state, federal or foreign taxes, levies, duties or similar governmental assessments of any nature, including value-added, use, sales or withholding taxes collected by any jurisdiction. Each party is responsible for all of its own business taxes (including, but not limited to, net income, gross receipts, franchise, or other similar business taxes) arising as a result of or in connection with any IO. Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, is responsible for self-assessing any transaction taxes (e.g. sales tax, VAT, GST or similar taxes) due with respect to any IO. Media Company will collect, and Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, will pay any applicable transaction taxes if Media Company determines that it has a duty to collect such taxes. Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, is responsible for any transaction taxes on user rewards redeemed outside of the Discord Platform. For transaction tax purposes, Quests will be treated as services related to promotional advertising campaigns. To the extent withholding tax is required by applicable law, Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, will be responsible for collecting and remitting such taxes to the appropriate tax authorities. Additionally, Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, will provide Media Company an original receipt or documentation from the tax authority for the withholding tax payments.

  3. Beta Products

Where an IO designates a product or ad format as an experiment, alpha, beta or similar designation (collectively referred to as “Beta”) the following terms apply in addition to and, to the extent of any conflict, supersede the applicable product terms: no deliverable is guaranteed, no makegood is owed, the product is provided AS IS and AS AVAILABLE without warranty of any kind, and Media Company may modify or discontinue the Beta product at any time with or without notice and without liability. Beta products may have additional product-specific terms or requirements as set forth on the applicable IO or otherwise communicated in writing (email to suffice).

  1. Amendments to IAB Terms.

  1. General Acknowledgements. The parties acknowledge and agree that: (i) Quests are treated as flat-fee based Deliverables delivered on the Discord Platform for purposes of the IAB Terms; (ii) the terms of the IAB Terms relating to inventory availability, delivery schedule, ad placement and positioning, use of collected data, and reporting will be superseded and governed by the applicable terms of Section 1 of this Discord Addendum and any IO; and (iii) Quests do not use or involve any Third Party Ad Server and any associated terms in the IAB Terms do not apply.

  2. Specific Amendments.

  3. Section X(b) of the IAB Terms is hereby amended to add the following new subclauses (iv) and (v):

“(iv) allegations that the Advertising Materials or Advertiser Marks infringe, misappropriate or otherwise violate any intellectual property rights of a third party; or (v) Advertiser Rewards, including, without limitation, any claims from users that Advertiser Rewards were misleading or inaccurate or that they were not properly fulfilled.”

  1. Section XI of the IAB Terms is hereby amended and restated as follows:

“Excluding Agency’s, Advertiser’s, and Media Company’s respective indemnification obligations under the Campaign Terms, damages that result from a breach of Section XII, or intentional misconduct by Agency, Advertiser, or Media Company, in no event will any party be liable (i) for any consequential, indirect, incidental, punitive, special, or exemplary damages whatsoever or any damages for loss of profits, business interruption, loss of information, and the like, incurred by another party arising out of an IO, even if such party has been advised of the possibility of such damages; or (ii) in the aggregate in connection with these Campaign Terms or the IO in excess of the amount paid or payable by Agency or Advertiser to Media Company hereunder.”

  1. For purposes of Section XIV(d) of the IAB Terms, the choice of law governing any IO will be the State of New York without reference to its choice of law rules, and all claims, legal proceedings or litigations arising in connection with the Campaign Terms will be brought solely in state and federal courts located in New York City.

  2. Section XIV.e of the IAB Terms is hereby amended and restated as follows:

“All notices of termination or breach must be in English, in writing and addressed to the other party’s legal department (with a copy to any contact listed on an IO). The email address for notices being sent to the Media Company legal department is legal.notices@discordapp.com. All other notices must be in English, in writing (including email) and addressed to the other party’s applicable notice information designated on an IO. Notice will be treated as given on receipt, as verified by written or automated receipt or by electronic log (as applicable).”
