How to Report the Location of Materials for Copyright and Trademark Claims

This article provides details on how to report the location of different content types to Discord for alleged copyright and trademark violations. Using the formats detailed in this article allows the Discord team to review your claim efficiently and effectively, so please use them!

Do not mislead Discord’s support teams. Do not make false or malicious reports to our Legal Response or other customer support teams, send multiple reports about the same issue, or ask a group of users to report the same content or issue. Repeated violations of this guideline may result in account warnings or other penalties.

What this article covers:

  • Where to file a copyright or trademark claim
  • How to report a user profile or server element
  • How to report a live stream
  • How to report a message
  • How to report a message attachment
  • How to report an emoji or sticker

Where to file a copyright or trademark claim

For information on how to file your claim of alleged copyright or trademark infringement, please refer to the Discord Copyright & IP Policy here.

In order for our team to review efficiently and effectively, we will need specific formats of information to locate the allegedly infringing material depending on your claim and content type.

Note: Please review the sections before submitting your request.

How to report a user profile or server element

Please provide the following information:

  1. The User or Server ID number

  2. Identify the specific allegedly infringing element(s), for example:

  • Profile avatar
  • Server icon
  • Server banner
  • Server discovery splash
  • Server invite splash

How to report a live stream

Please provide the server ID and the channel ID where the alleged infringement is occurring in the following format:

discordapp.com

If you are able to provide any evidence you have collected regarding the alleged live stream infringement(s), it may assist us in taking action against the allegedly infringing channel(s) or server(s).

How to report a message

Please provide the server ID, channel ID and message ID in the following format:

discordapp.com

How to report a message attachment

Please report the direct link to the attachment, which will appear in the below format:

cdn.discordapp.com

To get the Message Link on iOS, hold down on the Message, then select “Copy Message Link.”

On Android, hold down on the Message, then select “Copy Message Link.”

On desktop/browser, “right-click” on the Message, and select “Copy Message Link.”

How to report an emoji or sticker

Please provide the server ID and the emoji or sticker link.

To find the emoji or sticker link, right click on the emoji or sticker, select ‘Copy Image Address’, and paste the resulting URL into your request. The resulting URL should match the below formats:

cdn.discordapp.com

media.discordapp.net

Monetization Policy

Effective: 5/5/2024

Last Updated: 03/01/2024

Discord believes in giving users the ability to support themselves through monetization. In order to be eligible for monetization on Discord, all users, creators, developers, and their content, servers, and apps must abide by the requirements and restrictions outlined below.

This Monetization Policy applies to all of Discord’s user monetization features, including Server Subscriptions, App Subscriptions, and Server Shop. Monetizing users are responsible for the content they are monetizing, this means they must follow all applicable laws and regulations, providing honest content descriptions, and monetizing safely and responsibly. Please check our policies regularly as we may update these policies from time to time and continued use of Discord’s user monetization features after such updates go into effect means you accept and agree to those updates.

In addition to this Policy, monetizing users must adhere to Discord’s Terms of Service, Monetization Terms, Community Guidelines, and all the policies in our Help Center governing use of our services. Capitalized terms not otherwise defined herein have the meaning assigned to them in the Monetization Terms. For clarity, the term “including” as used herein means “including without limitation”. Additionally, examples provided herein are for convenience, and should not be construed to limit the applicability of this Policy.

Monetized Content Policy

You May Not Monetize Content Associated With Any Of The Following:

  1. Intellectual property of other rights holders without written permission.

  2. Impersonation, unless it is clearly labeled as parody or satire.

  • Labels of parody or satire must be clearly visible to users and to Discord at all times.
  1. Sexually explicit content, whether hosted on Discord or linked from other services.
  • Content may not contain nudity, explicit sexual acts, or content created for the purpose of sexual gratification or arousal.
  • Exceptions for non-sexual nudity may be made for context that is educational, artistic, or newsworthy at Discord’s sole discretion.

  1. Facilitation, solicitation of, or participation in online dating.

  2. Political candidates, campaign teams, political parties, elected or appointed government officials, and/or partisan political activity.

  3. Exploitation of tragedy, hardship, or turmoil.

  • This includes, for example, participating in financially manipulative behavior such as price gouging and inducing artificial scarcity of necessities.

  1. Monetization where the stated purpose of monetization is to support a charitable endeavor.

  2. Promotion of pharmaceutical goods, drugs, and unsafe health practices.

  • This includes claims of medicinal benefit from supplements that have not been approved by the FDA or similar regulatory body.
  • Telemedicine and telehealth offerings.

  1. Promotion or solicitation of endangering behaviors or activities to yourself, others, or animals.

  2. Primary purpose of marketing, advertising, or promotional benefit of the app or of a third party, such as:

    • Third party servers,
    • Applications,
    • Businesses, or services.

  3. Facilitation of gambling or gambling-adjacent activities such as:

    • Simulated casinos and their games,
    • Gambling discussions,
    • Gambling advice,
    • Community management of gambling operations.

  4. Distribution, manufacturing, sale, or promotion of sales of lethal weapons or explosives and their regulated accessories.

  5. Promotion or encouragement of alcohol, tobacco, and other drugs such as:

    • Drug paraphernalia,
    • Displaying characters that are under the influence,
    • Depicting under age drinking,
    • Simulated alcohol games,
    • Alcohol branding,
    • Depictions of hard drug use.

  6. Deceptive, misleading, or manipulative financial practices such as:

    • Multi-level marketing schemes,
    • Financial scams,
    • Fraudulent behavior.

  7. Facilitation of financial asset transfers or securities ownership.

  8. Malware and Software Downloads

    • Spyware,
    • Stalkerware,
    • Illegal hacking devices,
    • Phishing links,
    • Software that is deceptive or compromises user safety.

  9. Inappropriate or distasteful content.

    • Content that is inflammatory, demeaning, dangerous, misleading, or excessively violent such as:
      • Misrepresentative or manipulated content,
      • Graphic imagery and realistic displays of crime, violence, physical trauma, execution,
      • Content meant to shock or scare,
      • Disgusting imagery of guts, gore, sexual fluids, human or animal waste.

  10. Profanity or vulgarity,

    • Including obscene uses of symbols, emojis, or gestures,
    • Emojis or gestures which contain implicit or explicit vulgarity.

Eligibility Policies

In Order to Monetize on Discord, Your Account Must Meet the Following Requirements

We look at a number of safety and security signals to determine eligibility. This is not an exhaustive list, but examples that we offer for transparency and ease of understanding:

  1. You must be 18 years or older.

  2. Your account must be in good standing. Good standing includes but is not limited to:

    • You are not actively violating any of Discord’s Terms or Guidelines.
    • Your account has not received a safety violation in the past 30 days.
    • Your account has not been flagged for suspicious activity usually reserved for safety, abuse, and fraud cases.
    • No outstanding dues or unpaid charges owed to Discord.

  3. You must have your email verified.

  4. You must have Two-Factor Authentication enabled. Please note, you cannot remove 2FA when you have published server subscription tiers in your servers.

In Order to be Eligible for Premium Apps, Your App Must Meet the Following Requirements

  1. Your app must be verified.

  2. Your app must not have had an ownership transfer in the last 30 days, all app ownership transfers must be reviewed and approved by Discord.

  3. Your app may not be bought or sold without Discord’s approval.

  4. Your app must be in good standing. Good standing includes but is not limited to:

    • Your app has not received a safety violation in the past 30 days.
    • Your app has not been flagged for suspicious activity usually reserved for safety, abuse, and fraud cases.
    • Your app is not actively violating Discord’s Developer Terms of Service and Policy.
In Order to be Eligible for Server Monetization, Your Server Must Meet the Following Requirements

  1. The majority of your server’s membership and activity is not composed of bots or inactive accounts.

  2. Your server must not have had a server ownership transfer in the last 30 days without Discord’s approval. All monetized server transfers will go through a Safety review.

  3. Your server must not be bought or sold without Discord’s approval.

  4. Your server must be in good standing. Good standing includes but is not limited to:

    • Your server has not received a safety violation in the past 30 days.
    • Your server has not been flagged for suspicious activity usually reserved for safety, abuse, and fraud cases.

Payments

Once you’ve created your Offering, users will be able to see and purchase it through your community. Discord provides users with access to the perks you provide directly through the services and allows users to pay for these offerings through Discord. Discord may assist you with managing payments issues such as fraud, chargebacks, and resolution of payments disputes with assistance from you.

All user payments for Offerings will be remitted to Discord through our authorized third-party payment gateways (each, a “Payment Gateway”). To be eligible to receive payouts, you’ll need to create an account with a third-party payout provider made available to you on Discord (“Payout Provider”). When you create an account with a Payout Provider, you may be entering into a direct relationship with that Payout Provider. If you will be entering into a direct relationship with the Payout Provider, we will present their applicable terms to you. Please review those terms closely. You will not be eligible to receive a payout until our Payout Provider has provisioned your account. Eligible payouts will be provided within forty five (45) days after the end of each calendar month. For example, for Offerings purchased in January, you will receive payouts within 45 days after January 31st. All payouts will be made via the payment method that you link through our Payout Provider. You can choose any payout currency offered by a Payout Provider, but the Payout Provider may charge a conversion fee. You must have a minimum balance of $100.00 to be eligible to receive your first payout, and a minimum balance of $25 for any subsequent payouts that you are eligible to receive. You can see payout status and other information in your Discord Server Settings by going to Payments under Premium Memberships.

You will be deemed to have accepted the accuracy of any payout from Discord hereunder unless you notify Discord of a dispute by contacting us no later than 90 days after the date of the applicable payout from Discord to you.

We try to provide timely access to your funds, but you may occasionally experience delays in accessing your funds. We or our Payout Providers may also block or hold payouts for violations of our Terms (see “Restrictions” section below), for compliance reasons, including collecting tax reporting information, or if we anticipate a high volume of refunds or chargebacks on your Offerings. When payouts are delayed or blocked we try to communicate the reason to you promptly. It is your responsibility to make sure that the contact information associated with your Discord account is up to date and that your bank account information is accurate. If you have questions about a payouts block, please reach out to us. In order to protect you, we may block users’ payments if we believe them to be fraudulent.

Sometimes activities like refunds or chargebacks will mean that you owe money to Discord in excess of the amount we have agreed to pay out to you. You agree that we may off-set or discount, as applicable, any amounts owed to Discord against future payments owed to you or collect payment or reimbursement from you by any other lawful means. If a User initiates a chargeback in connection with the purchase of an Offering, you agree to provide timely information to Discord to assist in any chargeback investigation. You understand that the failure to provide information on the requested timeline could adversely impact the outcome of a chargeback investigation, up to complete forfeiture of the chargeback amounts. You are solely responsible for any forfeited chargeback amounts, chargeback fees, payments or fines imposed by credit and debit card networks or other payment method providers that arise out of your conduct or your Offering.

If you are based in the United States:

You appoint Discord as a payment collection agent. Discord acts as your payment collection agent solely for the limited purpose of accepting and processing payments from users purchasing your Offering. Because Discord acts as your payment collection agent, you understand that payment made by a user through Discord will be considered the same as a payment made directly to you, and you will provide the offering in the agreed-upon manner as if you received the payment directly from the user. Fees

These updates reflect changes in the legal landscape and provide new information on the steps you should take in case you have a dispute and the arbitrators available to you depending on where you live.
  • Updated Paid Services Terms. We’ve clarified and added new language on Discord Orbs that covers how you can earn, redeem, and hold Orbs on your account, including what happens to your Orbs if your account is terminated or suspended. We’re also introducing backup payment methods to help keep your subscriptions running smoothly. If your primary payment method fails, we may automatically charge an alternate payment method you have on file, with controls to let you opt out if you prefer. Additionally, we know policy updates can raise questions, so we’ve provided some Q&As for some things you might be wondering about here. Thanks for reading!

Usernames and Trademark Crossroads

We recently announced changes to how usernames and display names will work on Discord. For more information on the philosophy behind this update to usernames, you can read a message from our co-founder about why we’re changing things up now.

You may ask yourself, “What if I want to incorporate my brand’s trademark into my username but it is already in use by another account?” That is a great question, and hopefully the reason you are reading this article right now, because we have an answer!

We encourage trademark holders to use a server as the home of their brand on Discord. Servers are the space where community happens on Discord. Whether that’s an organic group of friends playing games together, or customers and fans coming together to celebrate their love of an artist, brand or product, servers are where mutual experiences are shared by like-minded communities.

Discord usernames, however, are how users express themselves and choose to be known within their communities, or amongst their friends. For many Discord users, their username reflects a personal choice, not necessarily a desire to trade on the username for commercial purposes.

For these reasons, the mere use of a word or phrase in a username that might have trademark protections does not mean the username is an automatic infringement of a trademark.

Of course, Discord respects the trademark rights of others. We expect the same of our users, and take appropriate actions when presented with valid complaints. If you believe an account is in fact engaged in commerce or is trading on their username in a way which suggests they are the holder of your trademark, you can notify us by filing a report using the trademark complaint form.

If you submit a trademark complaint regarding a username, please identify specific activity carried out by the reported account indicating that the username is engaged in commerce or traded on in a misleading manner which suggests they are acting as the holder of your trademark. You can find information on how to identify specific channel ID(s) and message ID(s) in this article.

Discord will not take action on a complaint for trademark infringement regarding a username if a complaint fails to identify any of the above conduct. If you encounter a user who is impersonating an individual, group, or organization in a deceptive or harmful way, you may also report this behavior to Discord using the in-app reporting flow. Please note that you will need to report the specific message where this deceptive or harmful impersonation is taking place.

What are Avatar Decorations?

Avatar Decorations let you customize and style your avatar on Discord! You can buy and collect all kinds of decorations from the Shop. Purchased decorations are yours to keep so you can add all kinds of pizazz to your avatar and profile aesthetic whenever you want.

Discord Nitro subscribers get exclusive perks with Avatar Decorations through Nitro Quests! Learn more about extended decoration access and other benefits in our Nitro Quest Perks article.

How can I collect an Avatar Decoration?

Desktop/Browser

Avatar Decorations can be found and purchased in the Shop.

Option 1

  1. Navigate to your Direct Messages list by selecting the Discord app icon in the upper-left corner.

  2. Then, press the Shop tab [] to the right of the server list to enter the Shop!

Option 2

  1. To access your User Settings, select the cogwheel icon [] in the lower-left corner of the app, then navigate to the Profiles section.

  2. While there, you will see the banner to the Shop where you can select Check it out. You can also select Change Decoration and select the Shop icon [].

  3. Once directed to the Shop, you can preview and buy Avatar Decorations to add to your collection and wear whenever you’d like.

Purchased Avatar Decorations are yours to keep and can be used at any time! Items available for purchase in the Shop will change periodically.

Mobile

  1. To navigate to the Shop on your mobile device, head over to your User Profile by selecting your avatar icon in the lower-right corner.

  2. Then, tap the Shop icon [] icon in the upper-right corner.

  3. This will direct you to the Shop where you can preview and buy Avatar Decorations.

How to Apply an Avatar Decoration to My Profile

Desktop/Browser

  1. On the desktop app or web app, head into your User Settings by selecting the cogwheel [].

  2. Once redirected to your User Settings, select the Profiles tab to view your profile settings.

  3. Then, press the Change Decorations button to open the Edit Avatar Decoration selection menu.

  4. Once you have chosen the Avatar Decoration you would like, select Apply to add the decoration to your avatar.

  5. After you apply an Avatar Decoration, you will need to confirm your changes by selecting Save Changes.

If you have multiple per-server profiles, you can wear a different Avatar Decoration for each one to add a unique touch in each of your servers. You can find out more here.

Mobile

  1. On your mobile device, head into your User Settings by tapping your avatar.

  2. From here, select Edit Profile. This will navigate you to the Profile page where you can tap Avatar Decoration to navigate to the Change Decoration page. You can also tap on your avatar and select the Change Decoration option instead.

  3. After arriving at the Change Decoration page and select the desired Avatar Decoration you would like to apply.

  4. Once you’ve found an Avatar Decoration you want to use, tap Apply then Save in the upper-right corner to confirm your changes.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Who can currently access the Shop and buy and use Avatar Decorations?

A: The Shop is available to all Discord users. If you are also a Nitro member, you will have special member pricing on eligible purchases within the Shop!

Q: How do I get a discount on Avatar Decorations in the Shop?

A: Only Nitro members have access to special member pricing in the Shop. You can find more information about Nitro here.

Q: I already have an Avatar Decoration that is part of the Shop Bundle. Why can’t I purchase the Shop Bundle to get the profile effect?

A: Shop Bundles offer a discounted price on two items from the same collection. However, these bundles are only available if you haven’t purchased any of the items included. If you already own one or both items, the bundle will be marked as partially or fully owned, and you won’t be able to purchase the remaining item(s) at a discounted rate. In this case, you’ll need to buy the remaining item individually.

Q: Is localized pricing available for Avatar Decorations?

A: Localized pricing is available for some Avatar Decorations purchases and gifts. You should see at checkout whether localized pricing is available. Otherwise, the purchase will default to USD ($). You can learn more about localized pricing here.

Q: Do I keep the Avatar Decorations I’ve purchased?

A: Yes, any decorations you’ve purchased are yours to keep and use anytime, even without an active Nitro subscription.

Q: Do I get to keep the DISXCORE decorations I’ve collected?

A: The Nitro exclusive DISXCORE decorations can be collected by Nitro members, but require an active Nitro subscription to use. If you decide to cancel your Nitro subscription, the decorations will remain in your collection but you won’t be able to use them.

Q: I thought Avatar Decorations used to be free for Nitro members. Why do I have to buy them now?

A: Previously, Avatar Decorations would only be freely available for Nitro members to use for a limited time and then they would disappear, which would leave a lot of folks sad. A lot of you also told us our decorations needed more variety.

Now Avatar Decorations are designed to be yours to keep and use anytime when you buy them. We’ve also been working hard to make Avatar Decorations better than before, with even more charming and fun designs, higher quality animations and effects, and more styles to choose from.

As a friendly reminder, if you’re a Nitro member, you can collect the 3 bonus DISXCORE Avatar Decorations from the Shop! Discord users with Nitro trial subscriptions do not have access to DISXCORE profile effects.

Q: Can I refund an Avatar Decoration I’ve purchased?

A: No, Avatar Decorations are non-refundable. You can learn more about our Refund Policy here.

Q: How often do you add new decorations?

A: We don’t have specific details related to when new decorations become available, but our team is hard at work to make sure we continue to bring new and fun styles to your hands.

Avatar

Discord Profile Badges: What Each Badge Means

Learn what each Discord profile badge means and how it’s unlocked, from the Discord Nitro badge to legacy badges that are no longer available.

Want to learn more? To learn how to open your Badge Directory, check badge rarity, and hide or reorder your badges, visit How to Manage Your Discord Profile Badges.

Current Badges

These badges can currently be unlocked. Details for each one are also available in your Badge Directory.

Account Age Badge

Example of Account Age Badge

The Account Age badge reflects how long your account has existed. It unlocks once your account is a year old and evolves as your account gets older. Once you unlock a level, you won’t lose it or drop back to a lower level. The badge evolves as time goes on.

Game Time Badge

Example of Game Time Badge

The Game Time badge reflects the total time you’ve spent playing games that Discord can detect. Time across all detected games counts toward the same total, and the badge evolves as that total grows. Unfortunately, games you play on consoles, like Xbox or PlayStation, don’t count toward the Game Time badge, since only the Discord desktop app can detect games. Game Time includes time played on or after December 8, 2025. Badge progress may take some time to reflect your recent activity.

To count progress toward these badges, turn on Use data to personalize my Discord experience. Check Data Used to Personalize Discord for details on how to enable this setting.

Game Variety Badge

Example of Game Variety Badge

The Game Variety badge reflects how many different games you’ve played that Discord recognizes. The badge evolves as that number grows.

Discord recognizes most desktop games automatically, though some very small games may not be detected. Some platforms are tracked as a single game. For example, playing different experiences in Roblox or Fortnite counts as one game.

Games you play on consoles, like Xbox or PlayStation, don’t count toward the Game Variety badge. This badge only tracks games detected by the Discord desktop app. Badge progress may take some time to reflect your recent activity.

To count progress toward these badges, turn on Use data to personalize my Discord experience. Check Data Used to Personalize Discord for details on how to enable this setting.

Gifting Badge

Example of Gifting Badge

The Gifting badge reflects the gifts you’ve sent on Discord. Every gift you’ve sent counts toward this badge, and it evolves as you send more Nitro or Shop gifts.

Example of Evolving Gift Badges

Nitro Badge

Example of Nitro Badge

If you see this badge on an account, it means that they’re subscribed to Nitro! Anyone subscribed to Nitro, Nitro Classic, or Nitro Basic has the Discord Nitro badge on their profile.

This badge evolves the longer you stay subscribed. Hover over the badge to see the subscription date and how long someone has been subscribed.

Learn more about everything included with a subscription in our Nitro FAQ.

Orbs Badge

Example of Orbs Badge

You can purchase the Orbs badge from the Orbs shop to display on your profile. For more information about Discord Orbs and how they work, visit our Discord Orbs FAQ.

Quests Badge

Example of Discord Quests Badge

The Discord Quests badge is for those who have completed a Quest! Quests let you discover games, earn rewards, and stream gameplay to friends. When you complete a Quest, the Discord Quests badge is added to your profile. For more information, visit our Discord Quests FAQ.

Server Boosting Badge

Example of Server Boosting Badge

This pink badge represents a user who directly supports one of their favorite servers through Server Boosting. Hover over the Server Boosting badge to see how long someone has been boosting.

This badge evolves based on how long you’ve been boosting without a pause.

Example of Evolving Server Boost Badges

Note: If you stop boosting, or you’re no longer boosting any servers, your boosting streak and badge reset to the first level. If you boost multiple servers, your badge always reflects your longest Server Boost streak.

You can learn more about Server Boosting in our Server Boosting FAQ.

Streaming Badge

Example of Streaming Badge

The Streaming badge reflects the time you’ve spent sharing your screen with others. Time counts whenever you’re sharing your screen with at least one other person in the call.

This badge only tracks streaming done on the Discord desktop app. The Streaming badge includes screen sharing on or after January 1, 2024. Badge progress may take some time to reflect your recent activity.

To count progress toward these badges, turn on Use data to personalize my Discord experience. Check Data Used to Personalize Discord for details on how to enable this setting.

Legacy Badges

Legacy badges can no longer be unlocked, but if you already earned one, it stays with your account. These badges reflect programs and events from Discord’s earlier days.

Early Supporter Badge

Example of Early Supporter Badge

Before there were two styles of Discord Nitro, there was a legacy version of Nitro Classic. After expanding our Nitro offerings, we granted the Early Supporter badge to anyone who supported us in the early years of Discord as a thank you gift!

Anyone who purchased Nitro at any point before Wednesday, October 10th, 2018 received this badge. Learn more about this badge in our Legacy Nitro Classic FAQ.

HypeSquad Events Badge

Example of HypeSquad Events Badge

Along with the HypeSquad House badges, there was also a HypeSquad Events badge. Users earned this badge by attending an event in the name of HypeSquad. Event Coordinators ran the events themselves, such as organizing a university club or planning a LAN event.

HypeSquad House Badges

Example of HypeSquad House Badges

In the past, you could earn a HypeSquad House badge by taking a quiz in Discord that sorted you into one of three houses. The quiz is no longer available.

Last Meadow Online Badge

Example of Last Meadow Online Badge

From April 1, 2026 to April 7, 2026, you could play Last Meadow Online to earn the Last Meadow Online badge. Hovering over the badge displays your level progression in the game. Learn more about the game in our Last Meadow Online announcement.

Legacy Username Badge

Example of Legacy Username Badge

The Legacy Username badge lets other users know that you’ve kept your old username and discriminator. Learn more in our New Usernames and Display Names article.

Moderator Program Alumni Badge

Example of Moderator Program Alumni Badge

Long ago, we granted the Certified Discord Moderator badge to those who were part of our moderation programs. These users received the badge to show they’d mastered the Moderator Academy courses and were active participants in our moderator program ecosystem.

The badge has since evolved into the Moderator Program Alumni badge, as a way to thank everyone who was part of our moderator ecosystem before Thursday, December 1st, 2022. To learn more about moderating on Discord, check out our Safety Center’s Moderation page.

Partnered Server Owner Badge

Example of Partnered Server Owner Badge

Designed for active and engaged communities, the Partner Program distinguished the best servers out there. The Partnered Server Owner badge was given to owners of thriving communities and creators who showed an authentic enthusiasm for Discord.

Other Badges You Might See

Bug Hunter Badge

Example of Bug Hunter Badge

A mastermind of QA testing and detective work, the Bug Hunter badge is awarded to the most hard-working members of the Bug Hunter community. There’s even a Golden Bug Hunter badge for those who reach the highest hunter level by going above and beyond!

Example of Golden Bug Hunter Badge

To earn this badge, you’ll need to actively participate in the Discord Testers community.

Note: Submitting a bug through our Support Portal won’t count toward earning the badge.

If you run into a bug or want to learn more about the Discord Testers program, visit our Discord Testers article.

Discord Staff Badge

Example of Discord Staff Badge

If you ever run into someone with the Discord Staff badge, this person spends most of their week at Discord HQ, thinking of the next best thing to improve your Discord experience and dreaming of when the office is going to get a soft-serve machine. (When are we getting that soft-serve machine, btw?)

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Do console games count toward the Game Time or Game Variety badges?

A: Not at this time. These badges only count games detected by the Discord desktop app, so games played on consoles like Xbox or PlayStation aren’t included.

Q: Can I earn the Game Time, Game Variety, or Streaming badges on mobile?

A: No. These badges can only be unlocked and leveled up using the Discord desktop app.

Q: Why isn’t my badge progress updating?

A: Badge progress may take some time to reflect your recent activity. If your progress still does not update, confirm that you are using the Discord desktop app and that the Use data to personalize my Discord experience setting is enabled. For instructions on enabling this setting, see Data Used to Personalize Discord.

Once you earn a badge, it appears in your Badge Directory along with details about how it was earned. To learn how to hide or reorder the badges on your profile, see How to Manage Your Discord Profile Badges.

How to Manage Your Discord Profile Badges

Profile badges are the small icons on your profile that show off what you’ve done on Discord, from boosting servers to completing Quests. This article explains where to find your badges, what badge rarity means, and how to choose which badges appear on your profile.

What this article covers:

  • The Badge Directory
    • How to Open the Badge Directory
  • Badge Rarity
  • Managing Your Badges
    • Display Slots
    • Hiding a Badge
    • Reordering Your Badges
  • Frequently Asked Questions Want to learn more?

To learn what each badge means, visit Discord Profile Badges: What Each Badge Means.

The Badge Directory

The Badge Directory is your home base for profile badges. It shows you everything in one place:

  • The badges you’ve already unlocked
  • The badges that are available to earn
  • How to earn each badge Example of Your Badges Within the Badge Directory

You can also learn about badges you spot on other people’s profiles. Hover a badge on someone’s profile to see more about it. Select each to find out how to earn it yourself.

Badge Directory Viewed From Another User’s Profile

How to Open the Badge Directory

Option 1: From a desktop or mobile profile

  1. Open your profile or someone else’s profile.

  2. Select any badge (the icons next to the username) to open the Badge Directory.

If you’re on your own Edit Profile screen, selecting a badge opens the Badge Customization panel instead. From there, select View Badges to go to the Badge Directory.

Opening the Badge Customization Panel from Edit Profile

Option 2: From the desktop account popout

  1. Select the You Bar at the bottom of the left sidebar.

  2. Select Badges to open the Badge Directory.

Navigating to the Badges tab from You Bar

Option 3: From the mobile You Bar

  1. Tap the You Bar at the bottom of the app.

  2. Tap the row of badges below your username to open the Badge Directory.

Important: Badge Directory on mobile is currently an experiment and is only available to a small number of mobile users at this time.

Badge Rarity

Every badge has a rarity: Common, Rare, Epic, or Mythic. Rarity shows how likely you are to come across other users with that badge on Discord. You’ll see Common badges often, while Mythic badges are held by very few people.

Some badges evolve, which means they level up as you reach new milestones. Each level of an evolving badge can have its own rarity, so the same badge might be Common at its first level and Mythic at its highest.

Example of Evolving Account Age Badges

Note: Badge rarity may change over time as more or fewer people earn a badge.

Tip: You can check any badge’s rarity in the Badge Directory, or by selecting a badge on your profile or a friend’s profile. While arranging your badges, you can also hover over a badge, open the menu, and select View Badge Details.

Viewing Badge Details While Arranging Badges

Managing Your Badges

Once you’ve earned a few badges, you can choose how they appear on your profile. Everyone can hide badges, and Nitro subscribers can also reorder them.

Note: Hiding and reordering badges is available on desktop, browser, and mobile.

Display Slots

Your profile displays up to six badges in its display slots. New badges that you earn and badges that you level up will be placed into your badge display slots by default. Additional badges that you’ve earned are kept in your Badge Directory, so visitors to your profile can still see everything you’ve unlocked.

Example of Display Slots on a Profile

Hiding a Badge

You can hide eligible badges you’ve earned so they don’t appear on your profile.

Note: If you’re a Nitro subscriber, your Nitro badge always stays visible to help others understand your profile’s Nitro perks. You can still reorder it and hide your other badges.

On Desktop and Browser

  1. Select the You Bar at the bottom of the left sidebar. Then, navigate to Edit Profile.

  2. Select your Badges in the profile editor.

  3. Select Customize Your Badges.

  4. Hover over the badge you want to hide and select the three-dot menu.

  5. Select Hide Badge.

  6. Select Save to confirm.

Hiding a Badge on Desktop and Browser

Hidden badges move to the end of the row and show a small hidden icon so you can find and unhide them later. Other users won’t see hidden badges on your profile.

Tip: You can also open the Badge Customization panel from the You Bar. Select your avatar at the bottom of the left sidebar, then press Badges.

On Mobile

  1. Tap the You Bar at the bottom of the app.

  2. Tap Edit Profile.

  3. Tap Badges to open the Badge Customization panel.

  4. Long press the badge you want to hide.

  5. Tap Hide Badge.

  6. Tap Save to confirm.

Hiding a Badge on Mobile

The badge moves to the end of the row and shows a small hidden icon, so you can still find it in this view later.

Reordering Your Badges

Note: Reordering badges is only available to Nitro subscribers.

As a Nitro subscriber, you can rearrange your badges to choose which ones fill your six display slots.

On Desktop and Browser

  1. Select the You Bar at the bottom of the left sidebar. Then, navigate to Edit Profile.

  2. Select your Badges to open the Badge Customization panel.

  3. Select and drag a Badge to a new spot.

Reordering Badges on Desktop and Browser

Tip: You can also open the Badge Customization panel from the You Bar. Select your avatar at the bottom of the left sidebar, then press Badges.

Reordering Badges from You Bar > Badges

On Mobile

  1. Tap the You Bar at the bottom of the app.

  2. Tap Edit Profile.

  3. Tap Badges to open Customize your badges.

  4. Press and hold a Badge, then drag it to a new spot.

  5. Tap Save to confirm your changes.

Reordering Badges on Mobile

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can I remove a badge from my account?

A: Badges can’t be removed from your account, but you can hide any badge so it doesn’t appear on your profile. See Hiding a Badge above.

Q: Can I move my badges to a different account?

A: No. Profile badges are non-transferable and stay with the account that earned them.

Q: What happens to my badge order if my Nitro subscription ends?

A: If your Nitro subscription ends, your custom badge order will no longer apply. Your badges will go back to the default order shown for users without Nitro.

Q: Why don’t I see a badge I just earned in my display slots?

A: Newly earned badges automatically move to the front of your display slots, so they should appear on your profile right away. If you don’t see a badge you expected, try restarting or refreshing your Discord app.

If it still doesn’t appear, you may not have met all the requirements to earn it yet. Check Discord Profile Badges: What Each Badge Means for details on how to earn each badge.

Q: Can I hide my Nitro badge?

A: No, Nitro badges are always visible. Nitro badges let others know why your profile looks the way it does, from animated avatars to custom emojis in your status. You can still reorder your badges and hide other badges.

Q: Will Discord add new badges?

A: New badges may be added over time. When they are, you’ll find them in your Badge Directory.

To learn what each badge means, visit Discord Profile Badges: What Each Badge Means.

What Are Profile Effects?

Profile effects are unique and snazzy animated effects that play on your profile when someone views your profile. In the Shop, you can buy and collect a variety of effects that’ll let you personalize and decorate your Discord profile and wow your profile admirers! Purchased effects are yours to keep and apply to your profile whenever you want.

How Can I Collect A Profile Effect?

Desktop/Browser

You can head over to the Shop to preview and purchase profile effects!

Option 1

  1. Navigate to your Direct Messages list by selecting the Discord app icon in the upper-left corner.

  2. Then, press the Shop tab [] to the right of the server list to enter the Shop!

Option 2

  1. To access your User Settings, select the cogwheel icon [] in the lower-left corner of the app, then navigate to the Profiles section.

  2. Once there, you will see the banner to the Shop where you can select Check it out. You can also select Change Effect and select the Shop icon [].

.

  1. Once directed to the Shop, you can preview and buy profile effects to add to your collection.

Purchased profile effects are yours to keep and can be used at any time! Items available for purchase in the Shop will change periodically.

Mobile

  1. To navigate to the Shop on your mobile device, head over to your User Profile by selecting your avatar icon in the lower-right corner.

  2. Then, tap the Shop icon [] icon in the upper-right corner.

  3. This will direct you to the Shop where you can preview and buy profile effects.

How Do I Apply A Profile Effect To My Profile?

Desktop/Browser

  1. On the desktop app or web app, head into your User Settings by selecting the cogwheel [].

  2. Once directed to your User Settings, select the Profiles tab to view your profile settings.

  3. Then, press the Change Effect button to open the Add Profile Effect selection menu.

  4. Once you have chosen the profile effect you would like, select Apply to add the effect to your profile.

  5. After you apply a profile effect, you will need to confirm your changes by selecting Save Changes.

If you have multiple per-server profiles, you can wear a different profile effect for each one to add a unique touch in each of your servers. You can find out more here.

Mobile

  1. On your mobile device, head into your User Settings by tapping your avatar.

  2. From here, select Edit Profile. This will navigate you to the Profile page where you can tap Profile Effects to navigate to the Add Profile Effect page.

  3. In the Add Profile Effect menu, select the desired profile effect you would like to apply.

  4. Once you’ve found the profile effect you would like to use, tap Apply then Save in the upper-right corner to confirm your changes.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Who can currently access the Shop and buy and use profile effects?

A: A: The Shop is available to all Discord users. If you are also a Nitro member, you will have special member pricing on eligible purchases within the Shop!

Q: How do I get a discount on profile effects in the Shop?

A: Only Nitro members have access to special member pricing in the Shop. You can find more information about Nitro here.

Q: I already have a profile effect that is part of the Shop Bundle. Why can’t I purchase the Shop Bundle to get the avatar decoration?

A: Shop Bundles offer a discounted price on two items from the same collection. However, these bundles are only available if you haven’t purchased any of the items included. If you already own one or both items, the bundle will be marked as partially or fully owned, and you won’t be able to purchase the remaining item(s) at a discounted rate. In this case, you’ll need to buy the remaining item individually.

Q: Is localized pricing available for profile effects?

A: Localized pricing is available for some profile effect purchases and gifts. You should see at checkout whether localized pricing is available. Otherwise, the purchase will default to USD ($). You can learn more about localized pricing here.

Q: Do I keep the profile effects I’ve purchased?

A: Yes, any profile effects you’ve purchased are yours to keep and use anytime, even without an active Nitro subscription.

Q: Can I refund a profile effect I’ve purchased?

A: No, profile effects are non-refundable. You can learn more about our Refund Policy here.

Q: Do I get to keep the DISXCORE profile effects I’ve collected?

A: The Nitro exclusive DISXCORE profile effects can be freely collected by Nitro members, but require an active Nitro subscription to use. If you decide to cancel your Nitro subscription, the effects will remain in your collection but you won’t be able to use them. Discord users with Nitro trial subscriptions do not have access to DISXCORE profile effects.

Q: Can profile effects be turned off? I don’t want to see them.

A: If you’re trying to completely disable any profile effects from animating within the app, you’ll need to go User Settings > Accessibility > Enable Reduced Motion. Toggling this on will prevent any effects from animating, including other users’.

Profile Privacy Setting on Discord

With Profile Privacy setting, you can control who has access to your profile details on Discord.

What this article covers:

  • What is Profile Privacy setting?
  • How to Update Your Profile Privacy Setting
    • Desktop/Browser
    • Mobile
  • Profile Privacy Setting for the Teen Age Group
  • How Does This Affect Activity Sharing Setting
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What is Profile Privacy setting?

Profile Privacy setting lets you control who sees your full profile. You can choose from options like just your friends to friends and everyone in your servers. This setting can be accessed from desktop, browser, and mobile devices.

Profile Privacy setting will hide the following information:

  • Custom Status

  • Pronouns

  • Badges

  • Connected accounts

  • Bio

  • Widgets

  • Wishlists When Profile Privacy setting is enabled, the following is still visible on your profile:

  • Avatar

  • Banner

  • Display name

  • Username

  • Server tag

  • Account age

  • Mutual friends and servers

Example of a private profile as seen by someone who isn’t a friend, showing a lock icon and limited info

How to Update Your Profile Privacy setting

Desktop/Browser

  1. Select the cogwheel [] in the bottom-left corner to access your User Settings.

  2. Navigate to the Data & Privacy tab and scroll down to the Profile Privacy setting section.

Profile Privacy Settings in Data & Privacy Settings Page
  1. Here you can choose between the following options:
  • Friends & All Servers: Your full profile will be visible to your friends and members of any servers you join.
  • Friends & Small Servers Only: Your full profile will be visible to your friends and members of any servers you join with 200 or fewer members.
  • Friends Only: Your profile will be visible to your friends only.
  1. After selecting your preferred setting from the list above, your preference will be automatically saved.
Mobile

  1. Tap You Bar at the bottom of the screen.

  2. Your profile will open, showing your avatar, username, and status.

  3. To access Settings, tap the cogwheel [] in the upper-right corner of your profile.

  4. Navigate to Data & Privacy and then scroll down until you see Profile Privacy setting.

  5. Here you can choose between the following options:

  • Friends & All Servers: Your full profile will be visible to your friends and members of any servers you join.
  • Friends & Small Servers Only: Your full profile will be visible to your friends and members of any servers you join with 200 or fewer members.
  • Friends Only: Your profile will be visible to your friends only.
  1. Tap on the setting you’d like to choose and then navigate out of your Settings to save.
Navigating to Profile Privacy Settings on Mobile

Profile Privacy Setting for the Teen Age Group

As part of our additional teen safety protections, we have standard profile privacy settings for users in the teen age group. You can change this setting at any time, you don’t have to be in the adult age group.

Users in the teen age group: Start with their profile set Friends & Small Servers. This means their full profile details will only be visible to their friends and members of any small servers (< 200 members) they join, not members of all shared servers.

Users in the adult age group or users who are unconfirmed: Start with their profile set to Friends & All Servers everywhere.

Note: Teen safety protections may vary slightly depending on where you live, as some regions have specific requirements under local regulation. For region-specific information, see our directory here.

Note: You’re always in control. You can update your Profile Privacy setting whenever you like in User Settings > Data & Privacy > Profile Privacy. You don’t have to be an adult to make a change.

How Does This Affect Activity Sharing Setting

Profile Privacy setting and Activity Sharing are separate settings, but they work together to give you consistent control over your visibility on Discord.

When you change your Profile Privacy setting, you’ll be prompted to update your Activity Sharing setting to match. For example, if you set your Profile Privacy setting to Friends Only, Discord will ask if you’d like to restrict your Activity Sharing to Friends Only as well. You can choose to update both settings at once, or decline and manage them independently.

Stop sharing activity too? Window Prompt

You can review and adjust your Activity Sharing setting at any time in User Settings > Activity Privacy. To learn more, see Activity Sharing on Discord.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Am I required to age assure in order to change this setting?

A: No. You can change this setting at any time in your Data & Privacy > Profile Privacy.

Q: If my profile is private, can people still send me friend requests?

A: Yes. Making your profile private does not affect your ability to receive friend requests. Others can still send you a friend request even if they can’t see your full profile details.

Q: If my profile is private, can people still send me DMs?

A: Yes. You may control who can DM you through your Content & Social settings. Your profile privacy does not affect this setting.

Q: How does the Profile Privacy setting work for server moderators?

A: Moderators see the same profile information as any other member of your shared server — they don’t get special access to details you’ve made private.

Moderators keep all their existing community management tools that they need to keep their communities safe. Username, display name, account age, and mutual server info stay visible.

Profile Widgets FAQ

Widgets are customizable sections on your Profile Board that allow you to showcase your interests to other users, enabling you to express your identity in different ways. Discover how to personalize your profile, rearrange Widgets, and share your interests with others.

What this article covers:

  • What are Widgets?
    • Game Stats Widgets
  • How to Add Widgets to Your Profile Board
    • In Profile Board
    • In Profiles Tab
  • Managing Widgets on your Profile Board
    • Reordering a Widget
    • Removing a Game from a Widget

What are Widgets?

The Profile Board is a surface on the user profile that allows users to express different aspects of their personalities. Widgets are customizable sections on your Profile Board that allow you to showcase your interests to other users, enabling you to express your identity in different ways.

There are currently five types of Widgets you can add to the Board:

  • Favorite Game: Highlight your ultimate favorite game with an optional short description about why you love it.
  • Currently Playing: Share up to 5 games you’re currently playing, with optional tags to give more information about how you play.
  • Want to Play: Display up to 20 games on your wishlist that you’re interested in trying in the future.
  • Games I’ve Played: Showcase up to 20 games from your gaming history.
  • Game Stats: Showcase your stats, achievements, and progress from supported games. Currently available for select See Game Stats Widgets below for details on supported games and how it works. Each Widget type allows you to select games from our database and personalize how they appear on your profile. If you can’t find a specific game, don’t worry– we’re actively expanding our games database!
Widgets in Your Profile Board
Game Stats Widgets

Game Stats Widgets are currently available for games such as Marvel Rivals, Wuthering Waves, and Arknights: Endfield.

Once you add the Game Stats Widget, you will be prompted to Account Link with the game. This may take you to a web page where you can select a character to display. After you’ve linked your account, your Game Stats Widget updates automatically with your in-game stats. For steps on adding a Game Stats Widget to your profile, see How to Add Widgets to Your Profile Board below.

Example of Game Stats Widgets (top) and a Marvel Rivals Game Stats Widget (bottom)

How to Add Widgets to Your Profile Board

Note: Widgets are currently only available on desktop or browser and won’t appear on mobile for you or anyone viewing your profile. Some users may also have special privacy settings for Widgets.

You can add Widgets to your profile in your Profile Board and in your User Settings > Profiles tab.

In Profile Board

  1. Press your avatar icon in the bottom-left corner of the app, then select your avatar again to open your profile.

  2. Choose any Widgets you want to add to your Profile Board. Select a Widget and press the Add game button in the upper-right corner. You can also add games from the Suggested for you section.

  3. Once finished, press Save to confirm your changes!

Adding a Widget Directly in Your Profile
In Profiles Tab

  1. Navigate to User Settings by pressing the cogwheel icon [].

  2. Select the Profiles tab and scroll to Profile Widgets.

  3. Press Add Widgets to begin customizing your profile.

  4. Choose from any available Widgets. Simply select a Widget and press the Add game button in the upper-right corner. You can also add games from the Suggested for you section.

  5. Once finished, press Save to confirm your changes!

Adding a Widget through Profiles Tab

Managing Widgets on your Profile Board

Reordering a Widget

Hold and drag a Widget to reorder it.

Example of Reordering a Widget
Removing a Game from a Widget

To remove a game from a Widget, hover over the game and select the Remove Game icon [].

Example of Removing a Game in a Widget
Removing an Entire Widget

To remove an entire Widget, press the Widget menu icon [] and select Remove Widget. A confirmation pop-up will appear where you must verify that you want to remove the Widget.

Example of Removing an Entire Widget

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Who can see my Widgets?

A: Your Widgets are visible to anyone who can view your Discord profile, including friends and server members where you share mutual servers.

Note: Widgets are currently only available on desktop or browser and won’t appear on mobile for you or anyone viewing your profile. Some users may also have special privacy settings for Widgets.

Q: Can I add the same game to multiple Widgets?

A: Yes, you can feature the same game across different Widget types. For example, a game could appear in both Currently Playing and Favorite Game Widgets.

Q: What if I can’t find a specific game in the database?

A: Currently, there are limitations on the games which can be added to Widgets. We’re working on expanding our database to give you more options.

Q: How many Widgets can I add to my Profile Board?

A: You can add one Widget of each type (e.g. Favorite Game, Currently Playing, Want to Play, Games I’ve Played).

Q: Do Widgets work on mobile?

A: Currently, Widgets are only available to edit and view on desktop and browser versions of Discord.

Q: Can I hide specific Widgets from certain people?

A: No, Widget visibility follows your general profile privacy settings. You cannot selectively hide individual Widgets from specific users.

Q: Do Widgets show my real-time gaming activity?

A: No, Widgets display manually curated game lists. They don’t automatically update based on your current Discord activity status. However, real-time gaming activity is shown in the Activity tab.

Wishlist FAQ

Want to make gift-giving easier for your friends? Wishlist lets you save your favorite Shop items directly to your Discord profile, so you (and your friends too!) can keep track of exactly what you want.

What is Wishlist?

Important: Wishlist is available to all users on desktop and browser. On mobile, it’s currently an experimental feature available to a limited number of users.

Wishlist helps you curate a collection of Shop items you’d love to receive from your Discord community. When you add items to your Wishlist, they appear on your profile where friends can easily browse and gift them to you.

Note: Items you already own, Orb exclusive items, and bundles cannot be added to your wishlist.

Adding Items to Your Wishlist

Ready to start building your Wishlist? Here are two easy ways to add items:

From the Shop

Browse the Shop and hover over any item card to see the Wishlist button or visit an item’s details page and press the Wishlist button to add it.

Adding Shop Items to Your Wishlist from the Shop Tab
From Your Profile

  1. Press your avatar icon in the bottom-left corner, then select your avatar again to open your full profile.

  2. Select the Wishlist tab, then press Add item in the upper-right corner.

  3. You’ll be taken to the Shop where you can browse items. Press the Wishlist button on any item you’d like to add.

Adding Shop Items to Your Wishlist from Your Profile

Managing Your Wishlist

Removing Items

Changed your mind about an item? No problem—you can remove items from your Wishlist anytime.

From the Shop

Browse to the item in the Shop and press the Wishlist button again to remove it.

Removing Items to Your Wishlist in the Shop Tab

From Your Profile

  1. Open your Profile and go to the Wishlist tab.

  2. Find the item you want to remove.

  3. Press the Wishlist button in the upper-right corner of the item card.

Removing Items to Your Wishlist in Your Profile Board
Privacy Settings

Your Wishlist is public by default so friends can easily see what to gift you. If you’d prefer to keep your Wishlist private, you can adjust your privacy settings.

  1. Open your Profile and navigate to the Wishlist tab.

  2. Press the ellipsis icon [] in the upper-right area of your Wishlist.

  3. Toggle Public Wishlist off to make your Wishlist private.

Note: When your Wishlist is private, only you can see it. Friends won’t be able to view which items you’ve saved.

Public Wishlist Toggle

Gifting Shop Items from a Friend’s Wishlist

Want to surprise someone special? You can browse your friends’ Wishlists and send them gifts directly from their profile. It’s the perfect way to celebrate birthdays, special occasions, or just show appreciation to your community members.

Finding a Friend’s Wishlist

Through the Full Profile

  1. Right-click your friend’s avatar anywhere in Discord—from a server, direct message (DM), or your friends list.

  2. Select Profile to open their full profile.

  3. Navigate to the Wishlist tab —you’ll see all the items they’ve saved.

Viewing a Friend’s Wishlist from Their Profile

Note: You can only view Wishlists that are set to public. If you don’t see a Wishlist tab on someone’s profile, they may have set their Wishlist to private or haven’t created a Wishlist yet.

Through a User’s Profile in a Direct Message

  1. Open a direct message with the friend you want to send a gift to.

  2. In their Profile, you’ll see the Wishlist section.

  3. Select an item or view their full Wishlist to browse all their saved items and select the perfect gift.

Viewing a Wishlist from Your Friend’s DM Profile

Through the Gift Icon in a Direct Message

  1. Open a direct message with the friend you want to send a gift to.

  2. Press the gift icon [] located to the far right in the chat bar.

  3. Browse their Wishlist in the Send a Gift window—you’ll see all the items they’ve saved, making it easy to choose the perfect gift.

Viewing a Friend’s Wishlist within Send a Gift Window
Sending a Shop Gift

Once you’ve found the perfect item on your friend’s Wishlist, sending it is simple!

  1. Select the item you want to gift from their Wishlist or select the Send Gift button.

  2. Add a personal message, a sound effect, and an emoji confetti (all optional) to make your gift extra special.

Example of Sending a Gift from a Friend’s Wishlist
  1. Press Next, then complete the purchase to send it on its way.
Next Button

Your friend will receive a direct message about their gift, and the item wil be marked with a checkmark on their Wishlist since they now own it!

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: I can’t find my Wishlist on my profile. How do I see it?

A: To view your Wishlist, open your full Discord profile by selecting your avatar in the bottom-left corner, then selecting your avatar again. Once your profile opens, select the Wishlist tab to see all your saved items.

Q: How many items can I add to my Wishlist?

A: Currently, there’s no set limit to the number of items you can add to your Wishlist. Add as many favorites as you’d like!

Q: Can I reorder items on my Wishlist?

A: Items appear on your Wishlist in the order you added them, with the most recent additions showing first. You can’t manually reorder items, but you can remove and re-add items to change their position.

Q: What types of items can I add to my Wishlist?

A: You can add most Shop items including avatar decorations, profile effects, and themes. However, items you already own, Orb-exclusive items, and bundles cannot be added to your Wishlist.

Q: Is Wishlist available on mobile?

A: Wishlist is currently available on desktop and browser only. We’re testing the feature before expanding to mobile platforms.

Q: Can friends see when I add items to my Wishlist?

A: No, adding items to your Wishlist is private. Friends can see your Wishlist when they visit your profile (if it’s set to public), but they won’t receive notifications when you add new items.

Q: What happens to my Wishlist items if I receive them as a gift?

A: When someone gifts you an item from your Wishlist, it’s automatically removed from your Wishlist since you now own it. This helps keep your Wishlist up to date!

Q: Will I know if someone views my Wishlist?

A: No, there’s no notification when someone views your Wishlist. Friends can browse your Wishlist privately to find the perfect gift for you.

Q: If I make my Wishlist private, can I still add items to it?

A: Yes! You can continue adding and managing items on your Wishlist even when it’s set to private. Only the visibility to others changes.

Q: Can I hide specific items on my Wishlist while keeping it public?

A: No, Wishlist privacy is all-or-nothing. If your Wishlist is public, all items on it are visible. If you want to keep certain items private, you’ll need to remove them or set your entire Wishlist to private.

Q: Can I gift someone an item that’s not on their Wishlist?

A: Yes! You can gift any Shop item to friends, not just items from their Wishlist. The Wishlist simply makes it easier to know what they’d love to receive.

Q: What if I accidentally send a gift to the wrong person?

A: Shop gift purchases are final and cannot be refunded or transferred. Double-check the recipient before completing your purchase. Please visit our Refund Policy for more information.

Q: Can someone regift an item I sent them?

A: No, items cannot be regifted. Once received, items are bound to that account.

Q: How long does this promotion run for?

A: WAND Pro subscribers and users can claim Discord Nitro promo between April 28, 2026 (12:00PM ET) to April 28, 2027 (12:00PM ET). The promotion must be redeemed by May 28, 2027 (11:59PM ET).

After May 28, 2027 (11:59PM ET), WAND Pro subscribers and users will no longer be able to redeem this promotion.

Q: How long does the Discord Nitro promotion last for?

A: You must redeem the Nitro promotion by May 28, 2027 (11:59PM ET).

If a code has not been redeemed to the Discord account by May 28, 2027 (11:59PM ET), it will expire and you will no longer be able to have Discord Nitro.

Q: Are all WAND users eligible for this promotion?

A: WAND pro users are eligible as long as it’s a non-trial account.

Eligibility for the Promotion

Q: Who can claim this promotion from their WAND account?

A: WAND pro users can claim this promotion.

Q: Who can redeem this Nitro trial to their Discord account?

A: Users who have never had an active Nitro subscription on their Discord accounts are eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion.

Additionally, users who previously had a Discord Nitro subscription and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscription in the past 12 months are ineligible.

This promotion is not available in the following regions: Syria, Ukraine, Russia, Iran, and North Korea. If you receive an “Unknown Gift Code” error during the claim/redemption process, you are not eligible to redeem this promotion. You can learn more at this Help Center article.

Q: What if I’m a current or previous Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or a Server Boost subscription? Can I also take part in this promotion?

A: If you previously had a Discord Nitro subscription at any point on your accounts and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscription in the past 12 months, you are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

If you have had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting subscription active on your account and you’ve never had a Nitro subscription, you will be able to redeem this promotion and replace it with the Nitro subscription.

HOWEVER, please note: By choosing to activate this trial, you will lose any features associated with your current subscriptions, and you will not receive a refund for any remaining value on your current subscription.

At the end of the promotion period, you’ll be converted to a paying Nitro subscription per month unless you cancel your subscription.

Payment Info and Subscription Questions

Q: Why do I need to submit my payment info to redeem Nitro?

A: Because Nitro is a subscription plan, at the end of your trial, we will start your first billing cycle so you can continue to enjoy Nitro on Discord.

However, you can cancel the Nitro subscription at any time before the end of the trial.

Q: Why do I see a temporary hold/charge on my account when this is supposed to be a free promotion?

A: Just to clarify, this Nitro promotion is free, however, there will be a temporary hold placed on the payment method upon activating the promotion. This is to help Discord confirm the payment method works as expected and to prevent the use of fraudulent payment methods. This charge will appear in your Discord transaction history, and it may appear as a hold on your payment method.

We immediately reverse the temporary hold, and you’ll see that reflected in your Discord transaction history. Your bank may take longer to remove the hold from your payment method.

Note: Banks will usually remove the temporary hold from your account within a few business days.

If your Discord transaction history does not show the hold released after 5 business days, please let us know at dis.gd, and our support team will be able to investigate this issue further.

Potential Errors and Other Issues

Q: I see a “Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already” error, that means that the Discord account you’re trying to redeem this promotion on currently has a Nitro subscription so it is ineligible for this Nitro promotion.

Please make sure you’re logged into the account that you want to redeem this promotion on.

Q: I see a “Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub!” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub” error, that means that you’ve previously subscribed to Nitro on your Discord account and you won’t be able to redeem this perk.

If you have never subscribed to Nitro, please submit a ticket through our support system: dis.gd and our support team will be able to investigate further.

Be sure to include your full Discord ID and email address tied to your Discord account.

Q: I see a “This gift has already been claimed” error when I try to claim my Nitro promo.

A: If you are seeing a “This gift has been claimed already” error, that means that the Nitro promo has already been used and cannot be used again. You may need to double check if you’ve claimed this promo on another Discord account.

Unfortunately, once the promo has been claimed, the promo cannot be re-enabled, and the Nitro cannot be transferred from one account to another.

Q: I see a “Wait a Second…Looks like this code didn’t work.” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Wait a Second…Looks like this code didn’t work.” error, that means that the promo is invalid.

Please note that our support team is unable to intervene if you are given an invalid promo and we will not be able to provide a new promo.

Q: I see a “Looks like something went wrong” error when I click on “Next”.

A: There are several reasons why you may be seeing this error:

  • You are ineligible for this promotion
  • The promotion is invalid
  • The promotion has reached the maximum number of claims
  • The link is invalid Please note that the Discord support team is not able to assist if you run into this error when attempting to redeem. See the list above for possible reasons why your account may be ineligible or otherwise unable to redeem this promotion.

Q: I see a “Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption” error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you’re seeing a “Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption” error, that means that the payment method you’ve selected to cover the temporary $1 hold cannot be used for that purpose.

Please keep in mind that prepaid payment methods, such as Gcash, cannot be used to cover temporary holds due to the nature of how prepaid payment methods function.

For more information on temporary holds, please check out this article!

Q: I see a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error, that means the maximum limit for claims of this promotion has been reached and this promotion can no longer be claimed. If you have claimed this Nitro promotion, you are still able to redeem it to your Discord account!

Please note that the support team is unable to assist you if you run into this error and we are not able to increase the limit of claims.

Q: I see a “Looks like your email isn’t verified. Make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift.”

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like your email isn’t verified, make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift” error, you are trying to redeem this Nitro promotion on a Discord account with an email that hasn’t been verified yet.

You can check out this support article on how to resend the email verification for your Discord account. If you need help setting up your Discord account, you can read our Getting Started article.

Q: Can WAND Pro subscribers who claimed a Nitro code request a refund before their next renewal?

A: No, WAND Pro subscribers who have claimed a Nitro code are not eligible for a refund until their next renewal.

Q: I’m having trouble with my WAND account.

A: Reach out to WAND’s support team: support@WAND.com

Payment Info and Subscription Questions

Q: Why do I need to submit my payment info to redeem Nitro?

A: Because Nitro is a subscription plan, at the end of your 1 month trial, we will start your first billing cycle so you can continue to enjoy Nitro on Discord.

However, you can cancel the Nitro subscription at any time before the end of the 1 month.

Q: Why do I see a temporary hold/charge on my account when this is supposed to be a free promotion?

A: Just to clarify, this Nitro promotion is free, however, there will be a temporary hold placed on the payment method upon activating the promotion. This is to help Discord confirm the payment method works as expected and to prevent the use of fraudulent payment methods. This charge will appear in your Discord transaction history, and it may appear as a hold on your payment method.

We immediately reverse the temporary hold, and you’ll see that reflected in your Discord transaction history. Your bank may take longer to remove the hold from your payment method.

Note: Banks will usually remove the temporary hold from your account within a few business days.

If your Discord transaction history does not show the hold released after 5 business days, please let us know at dis.gd, and our support team will be able to investigate this issue further.

Potential Errors and Other Issues

Q: I see a “Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already” error, that means that the Discord account you’re trying to redeem this promotion on currently has a Nitro subscription so it is ineligible for this Nitro promotion.

Please make sure you’re logged into the account that you want to redeem this promotion on.

Q: I see a “Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub!” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub” error, that means that you’ve previously subscribed to Nitro on your Discord account and you won’t be able to redeem this 1 month perk.

If you have never subscribed to Nitro, please submit a ticket through our support system: dis.gd and our support team will be able to investigate further.

Be sure to include your full Discord ID and email address tied to your Discord account.

Q: I see a “This gift has already been claimed” error when I try to claim my Nitro promo.

A: If you are seeing a “This gift has been claimed already” error, that means that the Nitro promo has already been used and cannot be used again. You may need to double check if you’ve claimed this promo on another Discord account.

Unfortunately, once the promo has been claimed, the promo cannot be re-enabled, and the Nitro cannot be transferred from one account to another.

Q: I see a “Wait a Second…Looks like this code didn’t work.” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Wait a Second…Looks like this code didn’t work.” error, that means that the promo is invalid.

Please note that our support team is unable to intervene if you are given an invalid promo and we will not be able to provide a new promo.

Q: I see a “Looks like something went wrong” error when I click on “Next”.

A: There are several reasons why you may be seeing this error:

  • You are ineligible for this promotion
  • The promotion is invalid
  • The promotion has reached the maximum number of claims
  • The link is invalid Please note that the Discord support team is not able to assist if you run into this error when attempting to redeem. See the list above for possible reasons why your account may be ineligible or otherwise unable to redeem this promotion.

Q: I see a “Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption” error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you’re seeing a “Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption” error, that means that the payment method you’ve selected to cover the temporary $1 hold cannot be used for that purpose.

Please keep in mind that prepaid payment methods, such as Gcash, cannot be used to cover temporary holds due to the nature of how prepaid payment methods function.

For more information on temporary holds, please check out this article!

Q: I see a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error, that means the maximum limit for claims of this promotion has been reached and this promotion can no longer be claimed. If you have claimed this Nitro promotion, you are still able to redeem it to your Discord account!

Please note that the support team is unable to assist you if you run into this error and we are not able to increase the limit of claims.

Q: I see a “Looks like your email isn’t verified. Make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift.”

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like your email isn’t verified, make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift” error, you are trying to redeem this Nitro promotion on a Discord account with an email that hasn’t been verified yet.

You can check out this support article on how to resend the email verification for your Discord account. If you need help setting up your Discord account, you can read our Getting Started article.

Q: What should I do if I’m experiencing issues with my Drop.com purchase?

A: Contact Drop.com’s support team directly through helpdesk.drop.com for assistance with any purchase-related issues.

What is Discord Nitro?

Discord Nitro is our Subscription plan that gives you access to special perks that’ll make your time on Discord as fun as ever! Personalize and enhance your experience with popular perks like HD streaming, 500MB file uploads, profile and avatar customizations, 2 free Server Boosts, and more:

What is Elgato?

Elgato is a world leader in online audiovisual technology, empowering content creators and digital professionals to transform their ideas into immersive, impactful experiences. From award-winning cameras, microphones, and lighting to control surfaces, capture cards, and studio mounts, Elgato sets industry benchmarks that shape the status quo of digital storytelling. Backed by parent company CORSAIR (Nasdaq: CRSR), the brand leverages a strong global distribution network and consistent product innovation to deliver sustained growth. A trusted name in a rapidly expanding market, Elgato drives value for both creators and investors through its commitment to excellence and forward-thinking strategy.

Q: How long does this promotion run for?
