Eligibility for the Promotion

Q: Who can claim this promotion from their GOG account?

A: GOG users with marketing consent who purchase one or more games for a final gross amount of at least $10 (or local equivalent) paid at checkout during GOG’s 18th Anniversary Sale, running from October 28th, 2026 (3PM CET) to November 5th, 2026 (9AM CET).

Q: Who can redeem this Nitro trial to their Discord account?

A: Users who have never had an active Nitro subscription on their Discord accounts are eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion.

Additionally, users who previously had a Discord Nitro subscription and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscription in the past 12 months are ineligible.

This promotion is not available in the following regions: Syria, Ukraine, Russia, Iran, and North Korea. If you receive an “Unknown Gift Code” error during the claim/redemption process, you are not eligible to redeem this promotion. You can learn more at this Help Center article.

Q: What if I’m a current or previous Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or a Server Boost subscription? Can I also take part in this promotion?

A: If you previously had a Discord Nitro subscription at any point on your accounts and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscription in the past 12 months, you are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

If you have had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting subscription active on your account and you’ve never had a Nitro subscription, you will be able to redeem this promotion and replace it with the 1 month Nitro subscription.

Important: By choosing to activate this 1 month trial, you will lose any features associated with your current subscriptions, and you will not receive a refund for any remaining value on your current subscription.

At the end of the promotion period, you’ll be converted to a paying Nitro subscription per month unless you cancel your subscription.

Payment Info and Subscription Questions

Q: Why do I need to submit my payment info to redeem Nitro?

A: Because Nitro is a subscription plan, at the end of your 1 month trial, we will start your first billing cycle so you can continue to enjoy Nitro on Discord.

However, you can cancel the Nitro subscription at any time before the end of the 1 month.

Q: Why do I see a temporary hold/charge on my account when this is supposed to be a free promotion?

A: Just to clarify, this Nitro promotion is free, however, there will be a temporary hold placed on the payment method upon activating the promotion. This is to help Discord confirm the payment method works as expected and to prevent the use of fraudulent payment methods. This charge will appear in your Discord transaction history, and it may appear as a hold on your payment method.

We immediately reverse the temporary hold, and you’ll see that reflected in your Discord transaction history. Your bank may take longer to remove the hold from your payment method.

Note: Banks will usually remove the temporary hold from your account within a few business days.

If your Discord transaction history does not show the hold released after 5 business days, please let us know at dis.gd, and our support team will be able to investigate this issue further.

Potential Errors and Other Issues

Q: What if I didn’t receive an email from GOG with the Nitro promo link, even if I’m a GOG customer or GOG Galaxy user?

A: In order to receive an email from GOG with the Nitro promo link, you must be a GOG customer or GOG Galaxy user who has made a qualifying purchase during GOG’s 18th Anniversary Sale.

Additionally, make sure that you’ve opted to receive marketing emails from GOG. If you’ve unsubscribed, you sadly won’t be able to see this offer.

If you believe you are eligible for the promotion, contact GOG’s support team: support.gog.com

Q: I see a Sad Trombone error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo link.

A: Would you happen to be entering this Nitro promo link from the promotion into the Discord Gift Inventory or as a link within Discord chat?

If so, this is the incorrect method for redeeming the Nitro promo link, and you will see an error when attempting to redeem the promotion.

In order to successfully claim this promotion, try opening up an incognito browser and then copy and pasting the promotion link into your browser’s address bar (also known as a location bar or URL bar).

Alternatively, in the Discord Gift Inventory, enter only your unique 24-digit code from the Nitro promotion link in the following format: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX

Q: I see a “Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo link.

A: If you’re seeing an “Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already” error, that means that the Discord account you’re trying to redeem this promotion on currently has a Nitro subscription so it is ineligible for this Nitro promotion.

Please make sure you’re logged into the account that you want to redeem this promotion on. Or you can give the promotion link to a friend who hasn’t had Nitro before.

Q: I see a “Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub!” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo link.

A: If you’re seeing a “Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub” error, that means that you’ve previously subscribed to Nitro on your Discord account in the past 12 months and you won’t be able to redeem this 1 month perk. However, this promo link can be gifted to a friend.

If you have never subscribed to Nitro, please submit a ticket through our support system: dis.gd and our support team will be able to investigate further.

Be sure to include your full Discord ID and email address tied to your Discord account.

Q: I see a “This gift has already been redeemed” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo link.

A: If you are seeing a “This gift has been redeemed already” error, that means that the Nitro promo link has already been used and cannot be used again. You may need to double check if you’ve redeemed this promo link on another Discord account.

In particular, if you redeemed this promo link using your mobile device, double check the browser on your mobile device and see which Discord account you are currently logged into.

Unfortunately, once the promo link has been redeemed, the promo link cannot be re-enabled, and the Nitro cannot be transferred from one account to another.

Q: I see a “Wait a Second…Looks like this code didn’t work.” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo link.

A: If you’re seeing a “Wait a Second…Looks like this code didn’t work.” error, that means that the promo link is invalid. If you’ve copy and pasted this link, we recommend you double check the link you were given once more and make sure it exactly matches the link sent to your email.

If you received this link from a friend, double check with your friend on the exact link to make sure that it matches the link in their email.

Please note that our support team is unable to intervene if you or a friend has been given an invalid promo link and we will not be able to provide a new promo link.

Q: I see a “Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption” error when trying to redeem my promo link!

A: If you’re seeing a “Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption” error, that means that the payment method you’ve selected to cover the temporary $1 hold cannot be used for that purpose.

Please keep in mind that prepaid payment methods, such as Gcash, cannot be used to cover temporary holds due to the nature of how prepaid payment methods function.

For more information on temporary holds, please check out this article!

Q: I’m having trouble with my GOG purchase or GOG Galaxy account.

A: Reach out to GOG’s support team: support.gog.com

Supporting thousands of popular games, ExitLag operates on a subscription model and offers a free trial period so users can experience its effectiveness before purchasing.

Payment Info and Membership Questions

Q: Why do I need to submit my payment info to redeem Nitro?

A: Because Nitro is a membership plan, at the end of your 1 month trial, we will start your first billing cycle so you can continue to enjoy Nitro on Discord.

However, you can cancel the Nitro membership at any time before the end of the 1 month.

Q: Why do I see a temporary hold/charge on my account when this is supposed to be a trial promotion?

A: Just to clarify, this Nitro promotion is a trial, however, there will be a temporary hold placed on the payment method upon activating the promotion. This is to help Discord confirm the payment method works as expected and to prevent the use of fraudulent payment methods. This charge will appear in your Discord transaction history, and it may appear as a hold on your payment method.

We immediately reverse the temporary hold, and you’ll see that reflected in your Discord transaction history. Your bank may take longer to remove the hold from your payment method.

Note: Banks will usually remove the temporary hold from your account within a few business days.

Potential Errors and Other Issues

Q: I see a “Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already” error, that means that the Discord account you’re trying to redeem this promotion on currently has a Nitro membership so it is ineligible for this Nitro promotion.

Please make sure you’re logged into the account that you want to redeem this promotion on.

Q: I see a “Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub!” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub” error, that means that you’ve previously subscribed to Nitro on your Discord account and you won’t be able to redeem this 1 month perk.

If you have never subscribed to Nitro, please submit a ticket through our support system: dis.gd and our support team will be able to investigate further.

Be sure to include your full Discord ID and email address tied to your Discord account

Q: I see a “Looks like this gift has already been claimed” error when I try to claim my Nitro promo.

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like this gift has already been claimed” error, that means that the Nitro promo has already been used and cannot be used again. You may need to double check if you’ve claimed this promo on another Discord account.

Unfortunately, once the promo has been claimed, the promo cannot be re-enabled, and the Nitro cannot be transferred from one account to another.

Q: I see a “Wait a Second…Looks like this code didn’t work.” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Wait a Second…Looks like this code didn’t work.” error, that means that the promo is invalid.

Please note that our support team is unable to intervene if you are given an invalid promo and we will not be able to provide a new promo.

Q: I see a “Looks like something went wrong” error.

A: There are several reasons why you may be seeing this error:

  • You are ineligible for this promotion
  • The promotion is invalid
  • The promotion has reached the maximum number of claims
  • The link is invalid Please note that the Discord support team is not able to assist if you run into this error when attempting to redeem. See the list above for possible reasons why your account may be ineligible or otherwise unable to redeem this promotion.

Q: I see a “Wait a Second…Looks like this code didn’t work.” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo link.

A: If you’re seeing an “Wait a Second…Looks like this code didn’t work.” error, that means that the link is invalid. If you’ve copy and pasted this link, we recommend you double check the link you were given once more and make sure it exactly matches the link in your SteelSeries account.

If you received this link from a friend, double check with your friend on the exact link to make sure that it matches the link in their SteelSeries account.

Please note that our support team is unable to intervene if your friend has given an invalid link and we will not be able to provide a new link.

Q: I see a “Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption” error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you’re seeing a “Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption” error, that means that the payment method you’ve selected to cover the temporary $1 hold cannot be used for that purpose.

Please keep in mind that prepaid payment methods, such as Gcash, cannot be used to cover temporary holds due to the nature of how prepaid payment methods function.

For more information on temporary holds, please check out this article!

Q: I see a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error, that means the maximum limit for claims of this promotion has been reached and this promotion can no longer be claimed. If you have claimed this Nitro promotion, you are still able to redeem it to your Discord account!

Please note that the support team is unable to assist you if you run into this error and we are not able to increase the limit of claims.

Q: I see a “Looks like your email isn’t verified. Make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift.”

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like your email isn’t verified, make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift” error, you are trying to redeem this Nitro promotion on a Discord account with an email that hasn’t been verified yet.

You can check out this support article on how to resend the email verification for your Discord account. If you need help setting up your Discord account, you can read our Getting Started article.

Q: I’m having trouble with my SteelSeries or KontrolFreek order/account.

A: For assistance with SteelSeries or KontrolFreek orders and accounts, contact their support teams directly:

  • SteelSeries Support: support.steelseries.com
  • KontrolFreek Support: support.kontrolfreek.com

Payment Info and Subscription Questions

Q: Why do I need to submit my payment info to redeem Nitro?

A: Because Nitro is a membership plan, at the end of your 3-month trial, we will start your first billing cycle so you can continue to enjoy Nitro on Discord. However, you can cancel the Nitro membership at any time before the end of the 3 months.

Q: Why do I see a temporary hold/charge on my account when this is supposed to be a free promotion?

A: Just to clarify, this Nitro promotion is free, however, there will be a temporary hold placed on the payment method upon activating the promotion. This is to help Discord confirm the payment method works as expected and to prevent the use of fraudulent payment methods. This charge will appear in your Discord transaction history, and it may appear as a hold on your payment method. We immediately reverse the temporary hold, and you’ll see that reflected in your Discord transaction history. Your bank may take longer to remove the hold from your payment method.

Note: Banks will usually remove the temporary hold from your account within a few business days. If your Discord transaction history does not show the hold released after 5 business days, please let us know at dis.gd, and our support team will be able to investigate this issue further.

Potential Errors and Other Issues

Q: What if I don’t see the Nitro promo in the T-Life app, even if I’m a T-Mobile member?

A: To claim in the T-Life app, you must be a qualifying T-Mobile or Metro by T-Mobile and have the T-Life app. If you believe you are eligible for the promotion, contact T-Mobile’s support team through using the following link: https://www.t-mobile.com/support

Q: I see a “Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already” error, that means that the Discord account you’re trying to redeem this promotion on currently has a Nitro membership so it is ineligible for this Nitro promotion. Please make sure you’re logged into the account that you want to redeem this promotion on.

Q: I see a “Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub!” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub” error, that means that you’ve previously subscribed to Nitro on your Discord account and you won’t be able to redeem this 3 month perk. If you have never subscribed to Nitro, please submit a ticket through our support system: dis.gd and our support team will be able to investigate further. Be sure to include your full Discord ID and email address tied to your Discord account.

Q: I see a “This gift has already been claimed” error when I try to claim my Nitro promo.

A: If you are seeing a “This gift has been claimed already” error, that means that the Nitro promo has already been used and cannot be used again. You may need to double check if you’ve claimed this promo on another Discord account. Unfortunately, once the promo has been claimed, the promo cannot be re-enabled, and the Nitro cannot be transferred from one account to another.

Q: I see a “Wait a Second…Looks like this code didn’t work.” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Wait a Second…Looks like this code didn’t work.” error, that means that the promo is invalid. Please note that our support team is unable to intervene if you are given an invalid promo and we will not be able to provide a new promo.

Q: I see a “Looks like something went wrong” error when I click on “Next”.

A: There are several reasons why you may be seeing this error:

  • You are ineligible for this promotion
  • The promotion is invalid
  • The promotion has reached the maximum number of claims
  • The link is invalid Please note that the Discord support team is not able to assist if you run into this error when attempting to redeem. See the list above for possible reasons why your account may be ineligible or otherwise unable to redeem this promotion.

Q: I see a “Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption” error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you’re seeing a “Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption” error, that means that the payment method you’ve selected to cover the temporary $1 hold cannot be used for that purpose. Please keep in mind that prepaid payment methods, such as Gcash, cannot be used to cover temporary holds due to the nature of how prepaid payment methods function. For more information on temporary holds, please check out this article!

Q: I see a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error, that means the maximum limit for claims of this promotion has been reached and this promotion can no longer be claimed. If you have claimed this Nitro promotion, you are still able to redeem it to your Discord account! Please note that the support team is unable to assist you if you run into this error and we are not able to increase the limit of claims.

Q: I see a “Looks like your email isn’t verified. Make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift.”

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like your email isn’t verified, make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift” error, you are trying to redeem this Nitro promotion on a Discord account with an email that hasn’t been verified yet. You can check out this support article on how to resend the email verification for your Discord account. If you need help setting up your Discord account, you can read our Getting Started article.

A: Reach out to T-Mobile’s support team through the following link - https://www.t-mobile.com/support

How do I redeem the Nitro Trial on my Discord Account?

Once you have claimed the promo, you’ll now need to officially redeem this promo on your Discord account. You must redeem this Nitro trial by December 5, 2025.

Eligibility for Redeeming the Nitro Trial

This promotion is only available in the US and Puerto Rico where Discord Nitro and eligible Best Buy products are available. If you receive an “Unknown Gift Code” error during the claim/redemption process, you are not eligible to redeem this promotion. You can learn more at this Help Center article.

Users who have had an active Nitro membership or Nitro trial in the last 12 months are not eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion.

Users who have had a Discord Nitro membership at any point on their accounts and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic membership in the past 12 months are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

If a user has had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting membership active on their account and they’ve never had a Nitro membership, redeeming this promotion will override that membership.

Users who have already claimed a gift from this promotion are not eligible to claim further gifts from this promotion.

Step by Step Redeem Instructions

If you’re eligible and ready to redeem this Nitro membership on your own Discord account, you can follow these steps below to redeem the promo.

NOTE:

  • Before redeeming Nitro, make sure you are logged in your own Discord account.

  • If you accidentally redeemed the Nitro promo on an account that is not yours, we are unable to provide you with another promo.

Step 1 - Logging into Discord

  • If you’re not already logged into Discord in your browser, you will then be automatically redirected to either: Register for a New Account

If you don’t have an account, you can directly register a new Discord account

Login to your Account

If you already have a Discord account, you can login to your account using your email and password or using QR code login

Step 2 - Claiming your promotion gift

Once you have logged in to your account, head over to your User Settings by selecting the cogwheel [] in the lower left corner.

While there, select Gift Inventory.

Then, enter the gift code in the Redeem Code box and press Redeem. You can find your unique gift code on the following:

  • For in-store purchases: Look for the Nitro offer code at the bottom of your receipt.
  • For online purchases: Check your email for the Nitro offer code. Afterwards, you will see a message appear below the box stating: “This looks like a promotion code. Click here to redeem.” Press Click here and follow the next prompts to redeem your Nitro promo trial.

You can share this gift with a friend as long as the promo code has not been redeemed. Once the code is claimed, the account you are currently logged in as will receive this gift and it cannot be transferred to another user. Please ensure you are logged into the correct account before redeeming the gift or sharing the promo code with a friend.

Step 3 - Redeeming your promotion gift

Review the details of the promotion then press on Next. Please note: if you switch to a different account at this step, you will not be able to claim and redeem the promotion on the account you switched to.

Make sure your payment information is accurate. If your Discord account does not have your payment information, please fill out your payment details. You will not be charged until the free trial ends and the membership renews.

When you’ve filled out all the necessary information and you’re ready to redeem this promotion, press the confirmation button.

Step 4 - Membership Now Activated

After accepting the promo to your account, you’ll now be automatically redirected to your Subscriptions tab in your User Settings to see your newly activated Nitro membership on your account.

What if I am an Active Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting Member?

Just to clarify - if you have had a Discord Nitro membership at any point on your account and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic membership in the past 12 months, you are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

So long as you have had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting membership active on your account and you’ve never had a Nitro membership, you will be able to redeem this promotion and replace it with the 1 month Nitro membership.

HOWEVER, please note: By choosing to activate this 1 month trial, you will lose any features associated with your current memberships, and you will not receive a refund for any remaining value on your current membership.

At the end of the promotion period, you’ll be converted to a paying Nitro membership per month unless you cancel your membership.

Frequently Asked Questions

Promotion Details

Q: How long does this promotion run for?

A: Best Buy Digital customers can purchase eligible Best Buy products starting on November 6, 2024, and redeem it in your Discord account by December 5, 2026.

Q: How long does the Discord Nitro promotion last for?

A: You must redeem the Nitro promotion by December 5, 2026.

If a code has not been redeemed to the Discord account by December 5, 2026, it will expire and you will no longer be able to have 1 month of Discord Nitro.

Eligibility for the Promotion

Q: Who can claim this promotion with their Best Buy purchase?

A: To redeem your Nitro promo, simply purchase an eligible Best Buy product. You will find the Nitro promo offer code on the following:

  • For in-store purchases: Look for the Nitro offer code at the bottom of your receipt.
  • For online purchases: Check your email for the Nitro offer code. Q: Who can redeem this Nitro trial to their Discord account?

A: Users who have never had an active Nitro membership on their Discord accounts are eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion.

Additionally, users who previously had a Discord Nitro membership and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic membership in the past 12 months are ineligible.

This promotion is only available in the US and Puerto Rico where Discord Nitro and eligible Best Buy products are available.This promotion is only available in certain regions. If you receive an “Unknown Gift Code” error during the claim/redemption process, you are not eligible to redeem this promotion. You can learn more at this Help Center article.

Q: What if I’m a current or previous Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or a Server Boost membership? Can I also take part in this promotion?

A: If you previously had a Discord Nitro membership at any point on your accounts and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic membership in the past 12 months, you are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

If you have had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting membership active on your account and you’ve never had a Nitro membership, you will be able to redeem this promotion and replace it with the 1 month Nitro membership.

HOWEVER, please note: By choosing to activate this 1 month trial, you will lose any features associated with your current memberships, and you will not receive a refund for any remaining value on your current membership.

At the end of the promotion period, you’ll be converted to a paying Nitro membership per month unless you cancel your membership.

Payment Info and Membership Questions

Q: Why do I need to submit my payment info to redeem Nitro?

A: Because Nitro is a membership plan, at the end of your 1 month trial, we will start your first billing cycle so you can continue to enjoy Nitro on Discord.

However, you can cancel the Nitro membership at any time before the end of the 1 month.

Q: Why do I see a temporary hold/charge on my account when this is supposed to be a free promotion?

A: Just to clarify, this Nitro promotion is free, however, there will be a temporary hold placed on the payment method upon activating the promotion. This is to help Discord confirm the payment method works as expected and to prevent the use of fraudulent payment methods. This charge will appear in your Discord transaction history, and it may appear as a hold on your payment method.

We immediately reverse the temporary hold, and you’ll see that reflected in your Discord transaction history. Your bank may take longer to remove the hold from your payment method.

NOTE: Banks will usually remove the temporary hold from your account within a few business days.

If your Discord transaction history does not show the hold released after 5 business days, please let us know at dis.gd, and our support team will be able to investigate this issue further.

Potential Errors and Other Issues

Q: I see a “Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already” error, that means that the Discord account you’re trying to redeem this promotion on currently has a Nitro membership so it is ineligible for this Nitro promotion.

Please make sure you’re logged into the account that you want to redeem this promotion on.

Q: I see a “Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub!” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub” error, that means that you’ve previously subscribed to Nitro on your Discord account and you won’t be able to redeem this 1 month perk.

If you have never subscribed to Nitro, please submit a ticket through our support system: dis.gd and our support team will be able to investigate further.

Be sure to include your full Discord ID and email address tied to your Discord account

Q: I see a “This gift has already been claimed” error when I try to claim my Nitro promo.

A: If you are seeing a “This gift has been claimed already” error, that means that the Nitro promo has already been used and cannot be used again. You may need to double check if you’ve claimed this promo on another Discord account.

Unfortunately, once the promo has been claimed, the promo cannot be re-enabled, and the Nitro cannot be transferred from one account to another.

Q: I see a “Wait a Second…Looks like this code didn’t work.” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Wait a Second…Looks like this code didn’t work.” error, that means that the promo is invalid.

Please note that our support team is unable to intervene if you are given an invalid promo and we will not be able to provide a new promo.

Q: I see a “Looks like something went wrong” error when I click on “Next”.

A: There are several reasons why you may be seeing this error:

  • You are ineligible for this promotion
  • The promotion is invalid
  • The promotion has reached the maximum number of claims
  • The link is invalid Please note that the Discord support team is not able to assist if you run into this error when attempting to redeem. See the list above for possible reasons why your account may be ineligible or otherwise unable to redeem this promotion.

Q: I see a “Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption” error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you’re seeing a “Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption” error, that means that the payment method you’ve selected to cover the temporary $1 hold cannot be used for that purpose.

Please keep in mind that prepaid payment methods, such as Gcash, cannot be used to cover temporary holds due to the nature of how prepaid payment methods function.

For more information on temporary holds, please check out this article!

Q: I see a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error, that means the maximum limit for claims of this promotion has been reached and this promotion can no longer be claimed. If you have claimed this Nitro promotion, you are still able to redeem it to your Discord account!

Please note that the support team is unable to assist you if you run into this error and we are not able to increase the limit of claims.

Q: I see a “Looks like your email isn’t verified. Make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift.”

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like your email isn’t verified, make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift” error, you are trying to redeem this Nitro promotion on a Discord account with an email that hasn’t been verified yet.

You can check out this support article on how to resend the email verification for your Discord account. If you need help setting up your Discord account, you can read our Getting Started article.

Q: What should I do if I’m experiencing issues with my Best Buy purchase?

A: Log into your MyBBY account to resend the redemption email or press “Redeem Now.” If you need further assistance, contact Best Buy support at 1-888-BESTBUY (1-888-237-8289).

Discord Nitro Logitech Discount

Level up your gaming setup with an exclusive Logitech discount, available just for Discord Nitro members! Read on to find out how to take advantage of this special offer.

What is the Nitro Logitech Discount?

As a Nitro subscriber, you’ll get one new discount code each month that you’re subscribed to Nitro:

  • 30% off purchases at the Logitech store (excluding new products and PRO Series lines)
  • 5% off new products for the first 6 months that the product is available. Limited to 1 discount per customer. Important: To receive your code, you must use the desktop app. Nitro Basic and Nitro Classic are not eligible.

How it Works

The following details apply to this promotional offer:

  • Code details and restrictions: Discount codes are valid on most items in each store, including sale items, with no blackout dates. Please note that the Logitech 30% off code excludes new products, the new Pro X2 Superstrike mouse and PRO Series Simulation lines, and is limited to 3 items per order.
  • For new products and PRO series simulation gear items, a 5% discount is available on new products for the first 6 months following a product’s release (limited to 1 use per customer). The PRO series simulation gear discount is rolling out to all users in the upcoming days.
  • Immediate availability: Codes become available to eligible users as soon as you subscribe to Nitro and must be claimed in your Nitro Home.
  • Fresh codes monthly: Each calendar month, you can claim a new discount code as long as your Nitro subscription remains active.
  • Code expiration: The code expiration dates can be found in the app. Codes will always expire on that date, no matter when they were granted.
  • No code stacking: Only one code can be used per transaction. Note: If you cancel your Nitro subscription, you can still use any previously claimed discount codes until they expire, but you won’t receive new codes until you resubscribe.

Eligibility Requirements

You are eligible:

  • With an active Discord Nitro subscription

  • If you’re located in a region that Logitech ships to (see Logitech regions for details) You are not eligible if:

  • You’re using a Nitro gift, or using Nitro Credits without a Nitro subscription.

  • You are a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscriber. Note: For new Nitro members, once you unlock a discount code, you will not be eligible for a refund on your Nitro subscription. See our Refund Policy for more details.

  2. Press the Nitro Home tab to navigate to the Nitro page.

Logitech Discount Card

Unlock Rewards button

Unlock Code button in Logitech Discounts window

Using Your Discount Code

After claiming your discount code, here’s how to use it on the Logitech:

  • Add items to your cart
  • Proceed to checkout
  • Enter your discount code in the promo code field
  • Complete your purchase with the discount applied

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What happens to my discount code if I cancel my Nitro subscription?

A: Any codes you’ve already claimed will remain valid until their expiration date, but you won’t receive new codes unless you resubscribe to Nitro.

Q: Where can I find the expiration date for my discount code?

A: The expiration date for each discount will appear on the discount card once you press Unlock Code in the Available Offers window.

Please note that the 30% off code excludes new products, the Pro X2 Superstrike mouse, and PRO Series Simulation items, and is limited to 3 items per order. However, a 5% discount code can be applied to new products and PRO Series Simulation products during the first six months following a product’s release.

Q: Is there a limit to how many times I can use my discount code?

A: Each discount code can be used once, and you can only use one code per transaction on each website. However, you’ll receive a new code each month your Nitro subscription is active.

Q: When exactly do new codes become available?

A: New discount codes become available at the beginning of each calendar month for active Nitro members.

Q: Can I use my code on any device?

Discord Nitro Offers & Promotions: Eligibility Guide

This article covers eligibility, terms, and current offers for Discord Nitro promotional offers.

What this article covers:

  • Offer Eligibility
  • How to Check if You’re Eligible
  • Eligible Subscription Types
  • Offer Terms
  • Available Offers
    • Discord Nitro Free Shop Item
    • Discord Nitro Mobile Orb Drop
  • Frequently Asked Questions

Offer Eligibility

Note: Offers are currently available only on the Discord desktop app and in a web browser, unless otherwise specified.

Discord runs Nitro offers and promotions from time to time. Eligibility depends on a range of factors, including your region, subscription status, and other criteria specific to each offer.

To check if you’re eligible for an offer, select the Nitro tab in the Discord desktop app (via the Direct Messages button in the top left, or User Settings > Nitro). If you’re eligible, you’ll see one or more of the following:

  • A banner or notification in the Nitro tab
  • An in-app message directing you to claim the offer For most offers, if you don’t see one in the Nitro tab, you’re not currently eligible, and support isn’t able to manually add offers or change eligibility.

Some promotions, like Game Shop promotions for Nitro subscribers, appear on other surfaces and can have their own eligibility requirements; see that promotion’s entry in the Available Offers section below, and the Game Shops FAQ for details.

Note: Eligibility can change while an offer is running. If you qualify today, check back regularly, as offers are tied to real-time criteria and may adjust over time. Similarly, if you don’t see an offer right now, you may become eligible later in the offer period.

How to Check if You’re Eligible

Follow these steps to see if you currently qualify for a Nitro offer.

  1. Update your Discord desktop app to the latest version. Some offers only appear on the latest version.

  2. Select the Direct Messages button in the top left, then select the Nitro tab. You can also get here through User Settings > Nitro.

Note: This offer flow is only available on the Discord desktop app and browser.

Nitro Tab
  1. Look for a promotional offer box in the Nitro tab, like the example below.
Example of a Nitro offer banner in the Nitro tab

These steps cover offers that appear in the Nitro tab. Some promotions, like Game Shop promotions for Nitro subscribers, appear on other surfaces; for those, check the promotion’s entry in the Available Offers section below and the Game Shops FAQ for details.

Eligible Subscription Types

To qualify for any of the offers below, eligible users must purchase Nitro (Monthly or Yearly) and pay through the Nitro tab on Desktop or web. The following subscription types do not qualify to receive the offer, even if you’re eligible:

  • Nitro Credit: purchased in the Shop with Orbs.
  • Nitro Gifts: includes both sending and receiving a Nitro gift.
  • Trials: these offers require an upfront payment, and trials don’t qualify.
  • Referral or Share Nitro Trials: subscriptions started through a referral trial or Share Nitro trial.
  • Nitro Classic or Basic: offers are valid only on paid Nitro standard subscriptions.
  • Upgrades from Classic/Basic > Nitro: only direct subscriptions to Nitro are eligible.
  • Recent subscribers: if you’ve had an active Nitro subscription within the last 30 days (including trials.)
  • Other Promotions/Discounts: if you subscribe to Nitro via other promotions such as discounts, you’re not eligible for these offers.

Offer Terms

  • Duration: Offers are limited-time and may change or end at any time without notice.
  • Combining offers: Offers can’t be combined with other offers unless explicitly stated in that offer’s entry below.
  • Account eligibility: Offers are only valid on the Discord account where you’re eligible. Redeeming on a different account or transferring an offer isn’t supported.
  • Regional availability: Availability varies by offer. Some offers aren’t available in certain countries or regions; specific restrictions for a live offer are noted in its entry below.
  • Discord’s discretion: Discord determines eligibility and reserves the right to limit, modify, or cancel an offer if we detect abuse, fraud, or a violation of our platform terms or policies.
  • Reward terms: Rewards granted through a Nitro offer, like bonus Orbs or Nitro subscription time, are subject to their standard terms and Refund Policy.
  • Refund eligibility: If you’ve redeemed or received any promotional items from Discord or a Discord partner promotion within 5 days of your Nitro membership renewing or becoming a new subscriber, you won’t be eligible for a Nitro refund.
  • Cash value: Offers have no cash value and aren’t redeemable for cash.
  • Unmet eligibility: If you don’t meet the eligibility criteria for an offer, any associated reward won’t be applied to your account, even if you complete the qualifying action (for example, subscribing to Nitro).
  • Redemption deadlines: If a promotional benefit requires you to redeem or activate it rather than being applied automatically, the offer may include a date by which you must do so.

Available Offers

Discord Nitro Free Shop Item
  • Offer type: Unlock a free Shop item with your Nitro subscription purchase
  • Duration: This offer is available for a limited time. Check the Nitro tab (via the Direct Messages button in the top left, or User Settings > Nitro) to see if you’re eligible.
  • What you get: A free Shop item for you to pick from the Shop. Bundles and Collaborations are not included.
  • Terms: Available to a limited number of eligible users. Eligible users see a banner in the Nitro tab on desktop. Requires subscribing to Nitro (Monthly or Yearly) during the offer window. Free Shop item will be added on successful subscription, and you will need to redeem it in the Shop by 9/11. If you don’t meet eligibility, the item won’t be applied to your account. Bundles and Collaborations are not included in this promo.
Discord Nitro Mobile Orb Drop
  • Offer type: Get bonus Orbs when you subscribe to Nitro on mobile during the campaign period.
  • Platforms: This offer is only available on the Discord mobile app (iOS and Android).
  • Duration: This offer is available from October 7, 2026 through October 14, 2026 (4PM PT).
  • What you get: A bonus drop of Orbs added to your account after you subscribe to an eligible Nitro subscription.
  • Terms: Requires subscribing to Nitro (Monthly or Yearly) through the Discord mobile app during the offer window. Only new subscribers, meaning you haven’t had an active Nitro subscription within the last 30 days, are eligible for the bonus. Once you subscribe, the bonus Orbs are added to your account automatically, with no separate claim step required. You aren’t eligible if you already received Orbs from an earlier Nitro Orbs promotion.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: I heard about an offer from a friend or on social media, but I don’t see it in my app. What’s wrong?

A: Nothing’s wrong on your end. Offers are based on specific eligibility criteria, so they don’t reach everyone at the same time, or at all. To confirm whether you’re eligible, check the Nitro tab (via the Direct Messages button in the top left, or User Settings > Nitro).

Q: Why did I stop seeing an offer I saw yesterday?

A: Offers can be time-limited or capped, and eligibility can shift while an offer is running. If the banner’s no longer showing up, the offer isn’t available to you anymore, and it may have been removed from the Available Offers section above.

Q: Can support add me to an offer or make an exception?

A: Eligibility is determined automatically based on each offer’s eligibility criteria, so support isn’t able to add users to an offer or make exceptions.

Q: I’m eligible for an offer. Where do I redeem it?

A: Head to the Nitro tab where you saw the banner and follow the on-screen steps. The Available Offers section above has the offer type and duration for reference, but redemption happens directly in-app.

Q: Does an offer I claim expire?

A: It depends on the offer. Check the duration listed for that offer in the Available Offers section above. Orbs added to your account don’t expire.

Q: I think I should be eligible but I’m not seeing the offer. Can you check my account?

A: Individual eligibility decisions come from each offer’s eligibility criteria, so our support team isn’t able to review or adjust them on a case-by-case basis.

Discord Nitro September 2025 New Look Offer

Looking to enhance your Discord profile? From September 18 to September 30, 2025, Discord Nitro members can claim a limited-edition, Nitro-exclusive profile bundle! Whether you already have Nitro or you are thinking about subscribing, read on to learn how to get and use these unique items.

Promotion Summary

Important: This offer is rolling out gradually, starting September 18, 2025. Most users will begin seeing it on September 23, 2025. If it’s not available for you yet, check back in a few days or review our eligibility conditions below to make sure you’re eligible.

Offer Details: Get an exclusive profile bundle, including an Avatar Decoration, Profile Effect, and Nameplate when you sign up for, upgrade to, or have Nitro Monthly or Nitro Yearly by September 30, 2025 (11:59 PM PT).

This offer also applies to upgrades from Nitro Basic and Nitro Classic to Nitro. The items in this bundle can only be used with an active Nitro membership. If you choose to end your membership, you cannot use the items, but they will be waiting for you when you resubscribe.

Note: This offer is only available through the Discord desktop app and browser. To claim your offer, please update Discord to the latest version and complete the redemption process using the desktop app.

Nitro Jet Fuel Profile Bundle: Jet Ring Avatar Decoration, Blast Off Profile Effect, and Jet Stream Nameplate

Important: Eligible existing and new Nitro members will have to claim the profile bundle by September 30, 2025 (11:59 PM PT). After this date, they will no longer be available.

Eligibility

To be eligible for this offer, you must meet one of the following criteria:

  • Discord users who have an active Nitro membership

  • Discord users who have subscribed to a Nitro membership

  • Discord users who have upgraded from Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic to a Nitro membership

  • Discord users currently using an active Nitro trial or offer You are not eligible for this offer if you meet any of the following:

  • Users on Nitro credits who do not also have an active membership to Nitro

  • Nitro Basic or Nitro Classic subscribers Regional availability: This offer is only available in certain regions. If you do not see the offer in your app, you are not eligible for this offer.

Deadline for Claiming Promo: Sign up for Nitro Monthly or Nitro Yearly by September 30, 2025 (11:59 PM PT) to be eligible for this offer.

Important: You must claim your profile bundle by September 30, 2025 (11:59 PM PT). After this deadline, it will no longer be available.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Are these profile bundle items temporary, or can I keep using them as long as I want after I claim them?

A: Once you claim them, the items are yours to keep. But you’ll need an active Nitro subscription to use them on your profile. If your Nitro ends, you won’t lose them, but you’ll need to resubscribe to use them again.

Q: Why don’t I see this offer in my Discord app?

A: If you don’t see any offer details on your Nitro tab on desktop or browser, it is because you do not meet the eligibility criteria, or it is not available to you yet.

This offer is rolling out gradually, starting September 18, 2025. Most users will begin seeing it on September 23, 2025. If it’s not available for you yet, check back in a few days.

Q: I’m a current Nitro member. Am I eligible to get the exclusive profile bundle?

A: Yes, you are eligible for this offer. Refer here to learn more about the eligibility criteria.

Q: Where can I find my new exclusive profile bundle items and how do I apply them?

A: On desktop or browser, navigate to User Settings > Profiles. Then, press either Change Decoration, Change Nameplate, or Change Profile Effect. You’ll see the Exclusive to Nitro section in each category where you can apply your items.

Q: Do I need Nitro to use one of the exclusive profile bundle items I received in this offer?

A: Yes, you will need an active Nitro membership to use the exclusive profile bundle items as it’s considered exclusive to Nitro.

Q: What happens to the exclusive profile bundle items from this offer if I cancel my Nitro membership?

A: Your claimed exclusive profile bundle items will remain in your account, but become unavailable for use until you re-subscribe to Nitro.

Q: How do I cancel my Nitro membership?

A: You can cancel anytime in Discord by visiting Settings > Subscriptions, for more information visit How to Cancel Your Nitro Subscription.

Q: If I upgrade my membership from Nitro Basic or Nitro Classic to Nitro, can I receive this offer?

A: Yes, this offer applies for upgrades from Nitro Basic or Classic to Nitro.

Q: I’ve already claimed and redeemed a Discord Nitro free trial or discount offer. Can I still access this promo?

A: Yes! If you claimed a Discord Nitro free trial or discount during this campaign period, you can still claim the exclusive profile bundle items by following these steps.

Q: If I have Nitro credit in my account, can I apply it to this offer?

A: Yes, most users with Nitro credits can claim this offer. Your eligible credits will automatically apply at checkout.

Users who cannot claim this offer are those currently using Nitro credits and do not also have an active, paid Nitro membership. If this applies to you, you’ll need to wait until your credits expire before you can become eligible. Learn more about eligibility here.

Note:

  • Eligible credits from previous memberships will automatically apply at checkout.
  • Credits from different Nitro tiers (ex: Nitro Classic) may not apply to this specific offer
  • Having credits in your account does not affect your eligibility - eligibility is determined by whether you have established a paid Nitro membership. Q: I purchased a Nitro membership during the offer period, but I’d like to request a refund. What are the steps?

A: Before requesting a refund, please review our Refund Policy to ensure that your purchase is eligible for a refund.

If you’d like to proceed, please send in a ticket specifying that you’d like a refund for your Nitro purchase to our support team here: dis.gd/billing and our agents will be happy to assist you.

Please note that if your refund is issued, you will lose any promotional value or discounts associated with the purchase.

Discord Nitro SteelSeries Discount

Discord Nitro members can enjoy an exclusive discount on SteelSeries gaming gear! This new offer gives you access to special discounts on SteelSeries and KontrolFreek products to enhance your gaming setup. Read more about the offer below.

What this article covers:

  • What is the SteelSeries Nitro Discount?
  • How it Works
  • Eligibility Requirements
  • How to Access Your SteelSeries Discount
  • Using Your Discount Code
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What is the Nitro SteelSeries Discount?

As a Nitro subscriber, you’ll get one new discount code per retailer available each month that you’re subscribed to Nitro:

  • 15% off purchases at the SteelSeries store (minimum $20 purchase required, limit 3 items)
  • 20% off purchases at KontrolFreek Important: To receive your code, you must use the desktop app. Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic are not eligible.

How it Works

The following details apply to this promotional offer:

  • Minimum purchase requirements: You must make a minimum subtotal purchase of $20 to use your discount at SteelSeries. There is no minimum purchase requirement for KontrolFreek.
  • Code details and restrictions: Discount codes are valid on most items in each store, including all sale items, with no blackout dates. Please note that the SteelSeries code cannot be applied to the Arctis Nova Elite, Blemished Boxes, and is limited to 3 items per order.
  • Immediate availability: Codes become available to eligible users as soon as you subscribe to Nitro and must be claimed in your Nitro Home.
  • Fresh codes monthly: Each calendar month, you can claim a new discount code as long as your Nitro subscription remains active.
  • Code expiration: The code expiration dates can be found in the app. Codes will always expire on that date, no matter when they were granted.
  • No code stacking: Only one code can be used per transaction. Note: If you cancel your Nitro subscription, you can still use any previously claimed discount codes until they expire, but you won’t receive new codes until you resubscribe.

Eligibility Requirements

You are eligible:

  • With an active Discord Nitro subscription

  • If you’re located in a region that SteelSeries ships to (see SteelSeries regions for details) You are not eligible if:

  • You’re using a Nitro gift, or using Nitro Credits without a Nitro subscription.

  • You are a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscriber. Note: For new Nitro members, once you unlock a discount code, you will not be eligible for a refund on your Nitro subscription. See our Refund Policy for more details.

How to Access Your SteelSeries Discount

  1. On desktop or browser. select the Direct Messages icon [] in the upper-left corner.

  2. Press the Nitro tab to navigate to the Nitro page.

Direct Messages Icon (Left) and Nitro Tab (Right)
  1. Locate and select the SteelSeries x KontrolFreek Discounts card under the What’s New? section.
SteelSeries x KontrolFreek Discounts Card
  1. Press Take me there to open the Available Offers window and see your available discounts.
Take me there Button
  1. Select Unlock Code for your preferred discount to reveal your code—you can copy it immediately or return to view it later.
Unlock Code button in Available Offers window

Using Your Discount Code

After claiming your discount code, here’s how to use it on the SteelSeries or KontrolFreek website:

  • Visit the SteelSeries store or KontrolFreek website
  • Add items to your cart (minimum $20 purchase required on SteelSeries.com)
  • Proceed to checkout
  • Enter your discount code in the promo code field
  • Complete your purchase with the discount applied

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What happens to my discount code if I cancel my Nitro subscription?

A: Any codes you’ve already claimed will remain valid until their expiration date, but you won’t receive new codes unless you resubscribe to Nitro.

Q: Where can I find the expiration date for my discount code?

A: The expiration date for each discount will appear on the discount card once you press Unlock Code in the Available Offers window.

Q: Are there any restrictions on the products I can purchase with the discount?

A: The SteelSeries code cannot be used to purchase the Arctis Nova Elite or Blemished Boxes. Otherwise, the discounts apply to everything else on SteelSeries and KontrolFreek online stores. This includes sale items and there are no blackout periods.

Q: Is there a limit to how many times I can use my discount code?

A: Each discount code can be used once, and you can only use one code per transaction on each website. However, you’ll receive a new code each month your Nitro subscription is active.

Q: When exactly do new codes become available?

A: New discount codes become available at the beginning of each calendar month for active Nitro members.

Q: Can I use my code on any device?

A: Yes! Once you receive your code through the Discord desktop app, you can copy it and redeem it at the appropriate webstore on any device of your choice.

Q: Why does my discount code show as “unavailable”?

A: We’re currently experiencing issues generating discount codes. Our team is working to resolve this, and no action is needed on your end. Check back later to claim your code!

Unavailable Discount Code

Q: Why isn’t my discount code working?

A: If you’re experiencing issues with your SteelSeries or KontrolFreek discount code, contact their support teams directly:

  • SteelSeries Support: support.steelseries.com
  • KontrolFreek Support: support.kontrolfreek.com Q: I think I found a bug. How do I report it?

A: If you’re experiencing technical issues or suspect you’ve encountered a bug, please reach out to Discord Support for help. We can investigate and assist you further.

EGS Megasale 2026 x Discord Nitro

Starting from May 14, 2026 (11AM ET) to June 11, 2026 (11AM ET), Epic Game Store members can claim 1 month of Discord Nitro from the Epic Games Store. Learn below about how you can claim Discord Nitro.

Promotion Summary

Offer Details: 1 month of Discord Nitro

Who is Eligible: Users who have had an active Nitro subscription or Nitro trial in the last 12 months are not eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion.

Note: This promotion is not eligible in the following regions: Syria, Russia, Turkey, Iran, North Korea, Zaporizhzhia, Kherson, Donetsk, and Luhansk. You can learn more at this Help Center article.

Users who have had a Discord Nitro subscription at any point on their accounts and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscription in the past 12 months are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

If a user has had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting subscription active on their account and they’ve never had a Nitro subscription, redeeming this promotion will override that subscription.

We will not be able to refund any leftover subscription time from those, and the user will be forfeiting the remainder of the existing subscription when activating the 1 month Nitro trial.

Users who have already claimed a gift from this promotion are not eligible to claim further gifts from this promotion.

Requirements: Epic Game Store members can claim the 1 month of Nitro starting May 14, 2026, and redeem it in your Discord account by July 11, 2026 (2:59PM ET).

Subscription: After the 1 month trial period, your Nitro subscription will convert to a monthly recurring subscription, and Discord will bill your payment method for per month until you cancel it. You can cancel at any time in your Discord User Settings.

How do I claim the Nitro Promo from my Epic Games Store account?

Important: In order to claim this Nitro trial promotion, you must have an Epic Games Store account.

  1. Head over to the Epic Game Store app from May 14, 2026 (11AM ET) to June 11, 2026 (11AM ET) and you should see the Nitro trial promotion on the homepage.

  2. Press on the promotion to get started on redeeming Nitro.

  3. Then, check your email tied to your Epic Games Store account to find an email from the Epic Games Store about this promotion. Try searching for “Nitro” in your email inbox!

Important: Please make sure the email address associated with your Epic Games Store account is current and correct! Allow for up to 24 hours for email delivery and check your spam folder.

  1. Once you have found the email, follow the prompts to claim the Nitro trial and you’ll be automatically redirected to a browser window to redeem the promotion.

The unique promotion link will look like this: discord.com

How do I redeem the Nitro Trial on my Discord Account?

Once you have claimed the promo, you’ll now need to officially redeem this promo on your Discord account. You must redeem this Nitro trial by July 11, 2026 (2:59PM ET).

Eligibility for Redeeming the Nitro Trial

Note: This promotion is not eligible in the following regions: Syria, Russia, Turkey, Iran, North Korea, Zaporizhzhia, Kherson, Donetsk, and Luhansk. If you receive an “Unknown Gift Code” error during the claim/redemption process, you are not eligible to redeem this promotion. You can learn more at this Help Center article.

Users who have had an active Nitro subscription or Nitro trial in the last 12 months are not eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion.

Users who have had a Discord Nitro subscription at any point on their accounts and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscription in the past 12 months are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

If a user has had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting subscription active on their account and they’ve never had a Nitro subscription, redeeming this promotion will override that subscription.

Users who have already claimed a gift from this promotion are not eligible to claim further gifts from this promotion.

Step by Step Redeem Instructions

If you’re eligible and ready to redeem this Nitro subscription on your own Discord account, you can follow these steps below to redeem the promo.

Note:

  • Before redeeming Nitro, make sure you are logged in your own Discord account.

  • If you accidentally redeemed the Nitro promo on an account that is not yours, we are unable to provide you with another promo.

Step 1 - Pressing the Promo Link/Copying and Pasting into your Browser Window

  • Start by directly pressing the promotion link or copying and pasting the promotion link into your browser window. Note: If you’re redeeming this Nitro promo link in the Discord Gift Inventory, enter only your unique 24-digit code from the Nitro promotion link in the following format: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX

Step 2 - Logging into Discord

  • If you’re not already logged into Discord in your browser, you will then be automatically redirected to either: Register for a New Account

If you don’t have an account, you can directly register a new Discord account

Login to your Account

If you already have a Discord account, you can login to your account using your email and password or using QR code login

Create an account Page (Left) and Login page (Right)

Step 3 - Confirming the Correct Account and Payment Method

  • Once you have logged into your Discord account, you’ll see a new message asking you to confirm that you are accepting the Nitro subscription on the correct Discord account.
    • You’ll see a notice saying: “You are accepting this gift as _________”
  • If your Discord account does not have your payment information, you’ll be asked to fill out your payment details. (Note: You will not be charged until the free trial ends and the subscription renews)
  • When you’ve filled out all the necessary information and you’re ready to redeem this promotion, press the “Accept Gift” button. Note: If you’re logged into the incorrect Discord account, press the “Wrong account” button to login to the other account.

Step 4 - Subscription Now Activated

  • After accepting the promo to your account, you’ll now be automatically redirected to your Subscriptions tab in your User Settings to see your newly activated Nitro subscription on your account.
What if I am an Active Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting Subscriber?

Just to clarify - if you have had a Discord Nitro subscription at any point on your account and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscription in the past 12 months, you are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

So long as you have had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting subscription active on your account and you’ve never had a Nitro subscription, you will be able to redeem this promotion and replace it with the 1 month Nitro subscription.

Important: By choosing to activate this 1 month trial, you will lose any features associated with your current subscriptions, and you will not receive a refund for any remaining value on your current subscription.

At the end of the promotion period, you’ll be converted to a paying Nitro subscription per month unless you cancel your subscription.

How do I share my Code with a Friend?

If you’re unable to redeem the Nitro subscription link, you can share this link with a friend to use instead.

After you press on and open the promotion link, you can directly copy the promotion URL link in the new page and send it to a friend. We recommend sending the link in a private direct message. Make sure your friend redeems the code by July 11, 2026 (2:59PM ET).

If a code has not been redeemed to the Discord account by July 11, 2026 (2:59PM ET) it will expire and you will no longer be able to have 1 month of Discord Nitro.

Eligibility for the Promotion

Q: Who can claim this promotion?

A: You must have an Epic Games Store account to claim this promotion through an email sent from the Epic Games Store to your email associated with your Epic Games Store account.

Q: Who can redeem this Nitro trial to their Discord account?

A: Users who have never had an active Nitro subscription on their Discord accounts are eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion.

Additionally, users who previously had a Discord Nitro subscription and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscription in the past 12 months are ineligible.

This promotion is not eligible in the following regions: Syria, Russia, Turkey, Iran, North Korea, Zaporizhzhia, Kherson, Donetsk, and Luhansk. If you receive an “Unknown Gift Code” error during the claim/redemption process, you are not eligible to redeem this promotion. You can learn more at this Help Center article.

Q: What if I’m a current or previous Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or a Server Boost subscription? Can I also take part in this promotion?

A: If you previously had a Discord Nitro subscription at any point on your accounts and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscription in the past 12 months, you are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

If you have had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting subscription active on your account and you’ve never had a Nitro subscription, you will be able to redeem this promotion and replace it with the 1 month Nitro subscription.

Important: By choosing to activate this 1 month trial, you will lose any features associated with your current subscriptions, and you will not receive a refund for any remaining value on your current subscription.

At the end of the promotion period, you’ll be converted to a paying Nitro subscription per month unless you cancel your subscription.

Payment Info and Subscription Questions

Q: Why do I need to submit my payment info to redeem Nitro?

A: Because Nitro is a subscription plan, at the end of your 1 month trial, we will start your first billing cycle so you can continue to enjoy Nitro on Discord.

However, you can cancel the Nitro subscription at any time before the end of the 1 month.

Q: Why do I see a temporary hold/charge on my account when this is supposed to be a free promotion?

A: Just to clarify, this Nitro promotion is free, however, there will be a temporary hold placed on the payment method upon activating the promotion. This is to help Discord confirm the payment method works as expected and to prevent the use of fraudulent payment methods. This charge will appear in your Discord transaction history, and it may appear as a hold on your payment method.

We immediately reverse the temporary hold, and you’ll see that reflected in your Discord transaction history. Your bank may take longer to remove the hold from your payment method.

Note: Banks will usually remove the temporary hold from your account within a few business days.

If your Discord transaction history does not show the hold released after 5 business days, please let us know at dis.gd, and our support team will be able to investigate this issue further.

Potential Errors and Other Issues

Q: What if I didn’t receive an email from Epic Games Store with the Nitro promo link, even if I have an Epic Games Store account?

A: In order to receive an email from Epic Games Store with the Nitro promo link, you must have an Epic Games Store account.

Additionally, make sure that you’ve opted to receive marketing emails from the Epic Games Store. If you’ve unsubscribed, you sadly won’t be able to see this offer.

If you believe you are eligible for the promotion, contact Epic Games Store’s support team: epicgames.com

Q: I see a Sad Trombone error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo link.

A: Would you happen to be entering this Nitro promo link from the promotion into the Discord Gift Inventory or as a link within Discord chat?

If so, this is the incorrect method for redeeming the Nitro promo link, and you will see an error when attempting to redeem the promotion.

In order to successfully claim this promotion, enter only your unique 24-digit code from the Nitro promotion link in the following format: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.

Q: I see a “Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Oh no! It looks like you have Nitro already” error, that means that the Discord account you’re trying to redeem this promotion on currently has a Nitro subscription so it is ineligible for this Nitro promotion.

Please make sure you’re logged into the account that you want to redeem this promotion on. Or you can give the promotion link to a friend who hasn’t had Nitro before.

Q: I see a “Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub!” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Sorry, looks like you’ve already had a Nitro sub” error, that means that you’ve previously subscribed to Nitro on your Discord account and you won’t be able to redeem this 1 month perk.

If you have never subscribed to Nitro, please submit a ticket through our support system: dis.gd and our support team will be able to investigate further.

Be sure to include your full Discord ID and email address tied to your Discord account.

Q: I see a “Looks like this gift has already been claimed” error when I try to claim my Nitro promo.

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like this gift has already been claimed” error, that means that the Nitro promo has already been used and cannot be used again. You may need to double check if you’ve claimed this promo on another Discord account.

In particular, if you redeem this promo link using your mobile device, double check the browser on your mobile device and see which Discord account you are currently logged into.

Unfortunately, once the promo link has been redeemed, the promo link cannot be re-enabled, and the Nitro cannot be transferred from one account to another.

Q: I see a “Wait a Second…Looks like this code didn’t work.” error when I try to redeem my Nitro promo.

A: If you’re seeing an “Wait a Second…Looks like this code didn’t work.” error, that means that the link is invalid. If you’ve copy and pasted this link, we recommend you double check the link you were given once more and make sure it exactly matches the link sent to your email.

If you received this link from a friend, double check with your friend on the exact link to make sure that it matches the link in their email.

Please note that our support team is unable to intervene if your friend has given an invalid link and we will not be able to provide a new link.

Q: I see a “Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption” error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you’re seeing a “Sorry, This Payment Source Cannot Be Used for Redemption” error, that means that the payment method you’ve selected to cover the temporary $1 hold cannot be used for that purpose.

Please keep in mind that prepaid payment methods, such as Gcash, cannot be used to cover temporary holds due to the nature of how prepaid payment methods function.

For more information on temporary holds, please check out this article!

Q: I see a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error when trying to redeem my promo!

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like this promotion has reached its maximum number of claims” error, that means the maximum limit for claims of this promotion has been reached and this promotion can no longer be claimed. If you have claimed this Nitro promotion, you are still able to redeem it to your Discord account!

Please note that the support team is unable to assist you if you run into this error and we are not able to increase the limit of claims.

Q: I see a “Looks like your email isn’t verified. Make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift.”

A: If you are seeing a “Looks like your email isn’t verified, make sure to verify your email before claiming this gift” error, you are trying to redeem this Nitro promotion on a Discord account with an email that hasn’t been verified yet.

You can check out this support article on how to resend the email verification for your Discord account. If you need help setting up your Discord account, you can read our Getting Started article.

Q: I’m having trouble with my Epic Games Store account.

A: Reach out to Epic Games Store’s support team: epicgames.com.

Free Nitro Trial for May 2025

Free Nitro? We got you! Eligible users will enjoy all the cool Nitro perks for one week—no payment method required. Whether you’re new to Nitro or just curious about what the perks can do, we’ll guide you through everything included in this limited-time offer.
